articleTitle: Radiological Imaging Techniques Using Dwt Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: When medical pictures are compressed, valuable information is extracted from the data they contain that is crucial for clinicians to understand clinically. The purpose of the notion of image compression is to enhance the picture content by compressing two images, such as MRI and CT scans, in order to provide doctors accurate and helpful information for their clinical care. In this project, two medical photos were combined using the Discrete Wavelet Transforms (DWT) approach to separate the functional and anatomical images. The compressed picture has no colour alterations and both additional spatial attributes and functional information. According to experimental data, discrete wavelet transformations provide the highest compression performance.

articleTitle: Enhancing Water Efficiency and Crop Yield in Agriculture Sector using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: IoT based smart irrigation system highlights the fundamental concept and benefits of employing IoT technology in irrigation practices. The integration of IoT with irrigation systems enables efficient water management and improves crop productivity while conserving water resources. The abstract outlines a smart irrigation system's key components and functionalities, emphasizing the use of sensors, connectivity, data analytic, and automated decision-making algorithms. The smart irrigation system provides several benefits, including water conservation, reduced labor efforts, and improved crop yield. Irrigation water use can be efficiently monitored and managed, resulting in significant water savings. The system's automation also eliminates the need for manual intervention, lowering labour costs and improving operational effectiveness. The technology makes sure that the optimum amount of water is given to the plants at the right time, improving crop quality and output. Furthermore, the abstract may touch upon the scalability of smart irrigation systems. These systems can be implemented in various agricultural settings, ranging from small-scale gardens to large commercial farms. The flexibility and adaptability of IoT technology make it possible to integrate additional features such as remote monitoring, mobile applications, and cloud-based data storage, further enhancing the capabilities and convenience of the system.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Early Detection of Diabetes Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus, commonly called diabetes, is characterized by insufficient insulin production and abnormalities in blood glucose levels, leading to various complications affecting vital organs such as the heart, nerves, and eyes. Leveraging advancements in healthcare technology, this study explores the application of machine learning algorithms to identify significant features associated with diabetes. This study aims to make a model programmed to identify diabetes in its initial phases to be pre-cautious and provide early treatment using machine literacy algorithms. Four machine literacy algorithms, specifically Logistic Regression (LR), KNN, SVM, and Random Forest (RF), are employed in this study to make predictive assessments of diabetes at its initial stages. The experimental analysis involves utilizing the PIDD (Pima Indian Diabetes Database), which originates from NIDDK (National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases). These algorithms’ performance evaluation has been conducted using a variety of demography measures similar to perceptivity (recall), perfection, F-score, particularity, and delicacy. Experimental findings demonstrate that RF achieved the topmost precision of 83.6 with a ROC score of 87 and surpassed the performance of other machine literacy algorithms.

articleTitle: Arduino-Based Real-Time Obstacle Detection in Vehicles Using Proximity Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Vehicle collision is currently one of the major problems for fatal traffic accidents where people lose their lives. To avoid this issue, intelligent vehicles pay more attention to people. The current anti-collision vehicles are lacking with the black path follower, and it is a high risk of loss of human lives. To overcome these challenges, an Arduino-based anti-collision device is suggested to reduce the count of accidents to avoid head-to-back vehicle collisions. Nowadays, one of the evolving technologies in the automotive sector is detecting obstacles using anti-collision vehicle systems. In the automobile sector, an anti-collision system is a safety system that automatically prevents collision among cars and objects. In this work, a microcontroller-based automated car anti-collision system is proposed. The proposed system is skilled at spotting obstacles using a precise distance sensor, alerting the driver when a collision is imminent, and automatically applying the brakes via an actuator, when necessary, without the driver's assistance. The proposed system will automatically stop the vehicle in case the driver avoids the collision as the system monitors the vehicle's condition continuously. This system can safeguard drivers from mishaps and lower accidental death rates because it is user-friendly and adaptable. This mechanism can be used in any automobile vehicle as it’s a prudent system.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based of Cardiac Attack Prediction Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The biggest cause of mortality in high-income nations right now is cardiovascular disease, and by 2030, it's expected to overtake all other causes of death worldwide. Cardiac disease, comprising ailments like coronary cardiac disease, hypertension, and stroke, continues to be the leading cause of mortality in the United States. Based on the updated 2017 Hypertension Clinical Practice Guidelines, the American Cardiac Association's 2019 update estimates that 46% of US adults, or 116.4 million individuals, have hypertension. According to 2016 statistics, a person passes away from a cardiovascular disease (CVD) every 38 seconds, resulting in 2,303 CVD-related fatalities per day. According to the same statistics, stroke causes roughly 389.4 fatalities per day as a critical cardiovascular event, with one stroke-related death happening every 3.70 minutes. It is crucial to create an early detection system for cardiac stroke symptoms in order to stop deaths and battle the rising prevalence of cardiac-related disorders, especially in younger people.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Decision Tree Models and M5P Models for Mobile Phone Price Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The aim of this article is to develop a predictive model for mobile prices using mobile specs, and to identify the machine learning technique that produces the most accurate price forecasts. Predictive Analytics involves utilizing archival data to make precise predictions about future occurrences. In this example, the cost of the mobile device is used to determine the category into which it falls. The Mobile Price Class dataset, which is available on the Kaggle data science community website, is one of the datasets that was used to train the prediction model. The cost of mobile devices is broken down into numerous categories in the present dataset. In order to find the most effective classification algorithm for forecasting future mobile price tiers, the model is trained using a variety of different classification methods, and evaluation measures such as accuracy, precision, and recall are then applied.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Privately Operated Blockchain Utilizing the Multichain Open Source Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the modern era of digital transformation, prominent technologies such as Augmented Reality (AR), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and blockchain have assumed a prominent role, fundamentally altering many facets of our everyday existence. Among the several innovations, blockchain emerges as a transformative breakthrough. Initially developed as a decentralized ledger for digital currency, the blockchain technology has undergone significant advancements, rendering it a versatile and potent instrument with wide-ranging applications spanning various sectors. This research paper explores the process of constructing a private blockchain utilizing the open-source Multichain technology. The ramifications of this blockchain technology extend well beyond its early implementations in the realm of finance. This technology exhibits substantial potential in the agrifood industry, specifically for the purposes of product life cycle management and the mitigation of counterfeiting activities. Blockchain technology offers a permanent, distributed, and verifiable database, which guarantees both transparency and security. Consequently, it has emerged as a crucial catalyst for innovation within various organizational contexts. The transformative potential of this phenomenon persists, leading to developments that propel society towards a future characterized by digital transformation.

articleTitle: Smart IOT Based Dustbin and Waste Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The increasing population leads to a significant generation of garbage, which requires effective waste management and disposal. Different types of waste, such as food waste, paper, plastic, metal, glass, construction waste, and hazardous materials, contribute to this issue. Developed countries have implemented various methods to address waste management, but developing nations must also take action due to the consequences associated with improper waste disposal. These consequences include unhygienic conditions, the spread of diseases, and pollution, which can negatively impact human life. To combat these problems, a smart IoT-based waste monitoring system. This system utilizes ultrasonic sensors, NodeMCU, servo motors, LCD screens, buzzers, I to C converter Module and LED bulbs to detect and display the garbage level in a dustbin. When the garbage reaches a specific threshold (around 85-90% full), the system activates a buzzer and LED bulb. It continuously sends signals and monitors the data online through ThinkSpeak. This smart waste monitoring system offers several benefits, including optimized waste collection schedules, prevention of overflowing bins, and improved resource allocation. By providing real-time monitoring and alerts, the system enhances waste management efficiency and contributes to a cleaner and healthier environment.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Algorithm for Identifying and Detecting Brain Glioma Tumors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The human brain is considered the most complex region of the body because it used to have biological elements and a number of neurons. When assessing its potential functionality, the investigation found that a healthy human's normal brain typically functions at 93\% of its potential. A brain tumour occurs when aberrant brain cells proliferate. Tumours can be classified into two categories: malignant and benign (non-cancerous). These are further classified into primary tumours, which start inside the brain, and secondary tumours, also known as brain metastasis tumours, which often spread from diseases outside the brain. The early discovery of malignant cells significantly impacts the treatment and patient recovery. On the other hand, diagnosing the disease typically goes through a lengthy, complicated procedure where a lot of money is also required. One of the most valuable approaches is MRI imaging, using which we can identify the various stages for the detection of tumours. Here, For the purpose of detecting brain tumours from MRI images, numerous feature extraction and classification techniques are also available. In this paper, the Convolutional Neural Network approach is used to detect early pituitary gland-based tumour disease in humans.

articleTitle: ESSS: Energy Saver Smart Shoes for Energy Harvesting using Multi-Sensors Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The development of energy-collecting shoes that operate on piezoelectricity is a significant step forward in the field of wearable electronics. During exercise, these shoes harvest energy from the surrounding environment to power fitness trackers, smart watches, and other electronic gadgets. Piezoelectric materials, when used in the soles of shoes, can convert the mechanical energy that is exerted into electrical energy. The piezoelectric material is subjected to pressure at each stage, which results in the generation of a negligible quantity of electrical energy. This energy can be stored, however, and then utilized to provide power to electronic devices. These energy-harvesting shoes feature many sensors, which contribute to the shoes' overall effectiveness. By adding a number of sensors, the footwear is able to harvest a greater amount of energy from walking, running, and jumping. Because of this breakthrough, the shoes can now collect and store more energy, making them superior power sources for electronics that are worn on the body. As a result, the research suggests that people should wear smart shoes that save energy. Using piezoelectric materials and modern sensor technologies, wearable electronic gadgets can be powered in a way that is both environmentally friendly and efficient.

articleTitle: 5G and IoT for Smart Stadium Operations for Enhancing Fan Experience and Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Smart stadiums improve visitors' experience and safety as 5G and IoT technology merge. Fans may enjoy immersive experiences and real-time updates on their mobile devices due to 5G's fast, low-latency connection. HD video streaming, AR upgrades, and in-seat food and beverage ordering have engaged and informed fans like never before. Personalizing fan experiences at smart stadiums relies on IoT sensors and devices. This sensor provides real-time game data, keeping audiences updated on the action. In the stadium, IoT-driven security solutions like face recognition and crowd monitoring keep fans secure as they enjoy their favorite events. In crises, 5G connection helps stadium workers and first responders communicate and coordinate, improving safety. In addition, real-time analytics using IoT data reveal fan behavior, preferences, and safety characteristics. Stadium operators use data to make informed choices, improving spectator experiences and safety. Intelligent stadiums use IoT-enabled environmental monitoring to optimize energy use and decrease carbon impact. Smart stadiums using 5G and IoT technology change sports and entertainment. These technologies improve the spectator experience and protect the safety and sustainability of modern venues, leaping ahead in technology and live events.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Clarity using Deep Dehazing Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Image dehazing is an imperative task in computer vision and research and development, it has various applications in many different sectors, including autonomous driving and surveillance. In proposed work, we present a different strategy for dehazing images using Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) and U-Net. Our proposed model consists of a U-Net-based network and a discriminator network that distinguishes the generated and actual image. The U-Net-based network receives an input image which is a hazy and generates output dehazed image, while the discriminator network is trained to differentiate between true and fake images. By using a Generative Adversarial Networks Sustainability, we can confirm that the output images are more realistic and visually pleasing, while the U-Net architecture helps preserve important details and structures in the image with research precision.

articleTitle: Visualizing Wellness: The Impact of Deep Learning on Healthcare Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Deep convolution networks have quickly established itself as the main method for deciphering medical pictures due to their widespread use. This extensive study examined almost 300 recent papers, mostly from the preceding year, that summarized the basic artificial intelligence ideas related to medical picture analysis. Applications of deep learning were explored in detail in a number of disciplines, including object recognition, picture grouping, classification, and registering. This book presents a succinct summary of studies conducted in the fields of neurological disorders, retinal cells, asthma, malignant scans, breasts, cardiovascular and cardiac pelvic, and nerve imaging. Study conducted concludes our assessment with a review of the state-of-the-art at this time, a thorough investigation of outstanding problems, and suggestions for further research. All areas, including computerized pathology, musculoskeletal, pulmonary, the heart, breasts, muscles and tendons, retinal, and neurology imaging, are summarized in a summary of current studies. This thorough review ends with an assessment of the field's current state, a critical analysis of ongoing issues, and specific suggestions for further research and development.

Author Keywords: Image Processing and Medical Image Analysis

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Investigating the Impact of Green HRM Practices in Sustainability of an Organization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: To develop sustainable practices in this industry, it is important to comprehend how green HRM practices influence employees' eco-friendly actions and businesses' green efficiency. Training programmes, employee input into environmental policy, and open lines of communication regarding sustainability objectives are just a few examples of the ways in which green HRM practices strive to increase workers' environmental understanding and engagement. Examining how well these procedures translate into true pro-environmental conduct among employees within an organization is essential. The study seeks to explore how Green Human Resource Management (GHRM) practices impact pro-environmental behavior and its subsequent effects on organizational green performance. Employees' pro-environmental actions and the relationships between organizational citizenship behavior for the environment (OCBE) and green work will also be studied. It provides an in-depth analysis of the ways in which GHRM practices may boost environmental results and speed up organizational green performance. Ontologies reflect the study’s constructions and sub-constructs and are utilized to power comparison analytics and context knowledge-based machine learning models.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach of Pneumonia Detection using Transfer Learning Models, RCNN and FAST RCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Computer vision can be used in health care for identifying diseases. The bacterial, fungal, or viral inflammation and fluid in one or both lungs are called pneumonia. Therefore, building a model for pneumonia detection is required through chest X-ray such that lung opacities on chest radiographs should be automatically detected by the algorithm. Pneumonia is diagnosed with the help of chest X-rays by qualified radiotherapists. Rarely, pneumonia can be mistaken with other diseases due to similarity of the symptoms. Therefore, designing a deep learning algorithm to detect pneumonia is accomplished by predicting the bounding box co-ordinates on lung opacities to direct the clinicians. The basic CNN model is designed for achieving this and can be tuned with different hyper parameters to achieve the best AUC score. Implementing the model and improving the performance through hyper-parameter tuning was done with transfer learning techniques such as RESNET, DENSENET, InceptionV3, U-Net and Mask-RCNN, Faster RCNN. Thus, an automated pneumonia detection mechanism will help in augmenting the efficacy of clinical decision making while reducing human interventions at the same time.

articleTitle: Optimized Vector Perturbation Precoding with 5G Networks and Levy Flights
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study introduces an innovative approach to enhance the performance of vector perturbation precoding techniques in 5G networks. Leveraging the concept of Levy flights, a type of random walk with heavy-tailed step length distributions, we propose an optimized vector perturbation precoding scheme. The proposed scheme aims to improve the trade-off between performance and complexity in multi-user MIMO systems by intelligently adjusting the perturbation vectors. Through extensive simulations, we demonstrate that the incorporation of Levy flights leads to substantial gains in terms of achievable throughput and spectral efficiency, thereby showcasing the effectiveness of the proposed approach in enhancing the overall performance of 5G networks.

articleTitle: Data Extraction, Attacks and Protection on Android Clipboard
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The Android clipboard acts as a buffer storage space for storing and enabling user’s convenience for data transfer between multiple applications. However, this utility becomes the potential target for exploitation by the attackers. The clipboard may contain many sensitive information, such as addresses, phone numbers, passwords, credit/debit card details, and some personal messages as well. In this paper, we evaluated and implemented common techniques used by attackers, such as JavaScript code injection, social media application based phishing attacks targeting data integrity, XSS (cross side scripting attacks) etc. Such attacks utilize the android system’s default behavior of open clipboard access to all applications. We also proposed a framework based on androguard for protection against such attacks. The study showed that the proposed system is effective in handling JavaScript based code injection attacks.

articleTitle: An Overview of Deployment of Information and Communications Technology (ICT) in Disaster Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Efficient disaster management necessitates the prompt and timely distribution of information to provide quick provision of emergency assistance to the affected population. The rapid growth of "information and communication technologies" has made it easy to acquire real-time information from many sources. The utilization of ICT in many phases of disaster management is being examined. The analysis includes an examination of current solutions as well as an investigation into the integration of developing ICT networks, services, and applications. Various evacuation techniques are being examined. Following a comparison of various ICT-based technologies, a model for evacuation is proposed.

articleTitle: Unconsciousness Detection Alarm for Driver Using Viola–Jones Object Detection Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Drowsy driving remains a significant cause of accidents, demanding the development of effective detection systems. This paper introduces a real-time drowsiness detection system for vehicles, incorporating an immobilizer to enhance safety. The system employs a camera to monitor driver drowsiness, detecting three levels of sleep and issuing audible alarms as needed. Furthermore, the system includes an SMS notification feature, alerting the driver's contacts with the driver's location details. In instances of severe drowsiness, a power lock activates, gradually slowing down and stopping the vehicle. This proposed system offers a robust solution to combat drowsy driving. Leveraging a binary classifier and advanced technologies, it accurately identifies and responds to driver drowsiness, thereby mitigating accidents and safeguarding both drivers and other road users.

articleTitle: An Interdisciplinary Approach for Evaluation of Green Building Index
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The green assessment of the buildings is a need of an hour as it determines the behavior of the structure against the environmental factors. As per the studies conducted and reported earlier, the old (existing) structures, which were built with less or no codal guidelines; responds negatively to the current environmental conditions. Also, with change in the climatic conditions and increase rate of carbon footprints, the structures need to assessed in such a manner that they must not harm the ecological balance of the society. This study is a stepping stone in achieving this objective with the help of computer – based application. The study is focusing on the determination of the Green Building Index of the structure by using the application of computational technique. The housing complex of eight high – rise structures located in Delhi – NCR region is considered for the application of the algorithm – based program for the determination of Green Building Index. The various parameters for the determination of Green Building Index are taken from the guidelines laid down by Indian Green Building Council (IGBC). On the basis of these guidelines, the index was given to the buildings. Also, unfavorable parameters were found out which are responsible for low rating of the buildings and an attempt is made to understand the possible reason behind the same.

articleTitle: Biometric Employee Identification Using Mobile Devices: ICT integration of Attendance Monitoring System (AMS) and Human Resource Information System (HRIS)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The integration of information and communication technology (ICT) has resulted in a dramatic change in the running and operations of organizations in a variety of areas, including HRM (Human Resource Management). In tandem with technology advancement, firms across several industries have used a variety of ICT solutions to improve the efficiency and productivity of HRM administrative activities. The use of ICT in improving the effectiveness of HRM administration is increasingly recognized as a critical aspect in achieving organizational success in this digitally driven era. HRIS is a software or web-based tool for entering, monitoring, and storing data. In this sense, employee job performance refers to an employee's contribution to their organization. Previous studies on this topic mostly focused on Sri Lanka's Western Province, particularly Colombo, whereas this study was undertaken in India.As experienced, COVID-19 has spread all over the world and has had a negative impact on the countries from both a social and an economic standpoint. In order to prevent the corona virus, people are required to maintain social distance, wear face masks, and stay away from biometric attendance systems. The current attendance system still has issues, including the` first being the lengthy lines in front of the attendance machine during peak hours and the inability of employees who work outside the office to log their presence. On the other hand, everyone has a mobile device, and they all come equipped with a finger scanner. The attendance system, which is connected to the payroll system and tools for human resource management, accepts input from coordinate GPS and finger scanners. In order to track the social distance between employees, a proposed system for biometric employee identification using mobile devices is described in this study. The goal of this study was to examine the aforementioned issue and determine the impact of ICT integration on the current attendance monitoring system (AMS) and human resource management system.

articleTitle: Reassessing Deep Learning in Time Series: Predicting Time with Foresight
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Machine learning relies heavily on time series forecasting, which has a wide range of uses, including although not limited to forecasting air quality, traffic patterns, and power use. Recent developments in deep training and matrix factorization models, however, have shown competitive performance and are emerging as alternatives. However, a fundamental disadvantage of these contemporary models over more established ones is their complexity. The Gradient Boosted Regression Tree, a well-known machine learning baseline, and popular deep learning models are compared in this work. We convert the time series forecast challenge into a window-based prediction issue, which is akin to (DNN) models. In addition, we design the GBRT model's input and output structure. In order to construct a single input instance to simulate a multi-output GBRT model, we concatenate the desired values with additional characteristics for each training window before flattening them. Using nine datasets, we undertake a thorough investigation and evaluate eight cutting-edge deep learning models recently presented at prestigious conferences. The findings show that a simple GBRT model performs much better than the state-of-the-art DNN models evaluated in this research thanks to the window-based input transformation.

Author Keywords: DNN and Temporal Regularized Matrix Factorization

articleTitle: An Exploratory Study on Fuzzy Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the present context, digitization revolutionizes the concept of decision-making and the digital imaging is one of the fastest emerging tools considered in the decision-making. It is the well-known fact in industrial applications, the extraction of direct information from human eyes is not considered as the practical one. The information is extracted using the medium called image processing which in general extract the raw data from the image and then converted into the important information using the processing method. Here, it is exaggeration to say that the smaller deviation in image attributes leads to failure in the extraction process. Therefore, it is pertinent to capture the attribute at micro level with utmost priority. For such micro-level consideration, the application of fuzzy-sets in the processing techniques supports in comprehension of the visual properties of the images and enhancing them to facilitate the extraction of useful information. The present study explores the existing models used in the processing and the limitations of the methods. In-addition, the study will report on the application of fuzzy-based image processing models which are far better than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Federated Learning and Decentralized IoT Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In an effort to lessen the difficulties caused by large-scale transfer of data on mobile phone networks, edge buffering tech has emerged as a result of the introduction of Internet of Things (IoT) apps by developers and carriers. Current optimization-based methods often struggle to adjust to changing circumstances. In order to solve these problems, most modern learning-based technologies are presented in a centralized way, which wastes network resources on refresher as well as data sharing. Study conducted present the Coordinated Deep Regeneration Edge Caching System (FADE) in the above setting. FADE enables decentralized cooperative development of a common prediction model among base stations. Base stations start local education with their initial sets of parameters and then upload almost perfect local circumstances to take part in international training sessions. Study conducted prove that convergence of FADE, displaying the intended convergence features. FADE demonstrates a considerable improvement over centralized deep training and reinforced approaches via trace-driven trials, resulting in a 92% decrease in performance deterioration and a mean 60% lower system costs. Especially, it outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in this field.

Author Keywords: FADE (Federated Deep renewal learning-based cooperating Edge caching)
QoS (Quality of Service) and System Payment

articleTitle: Enhancing Efficiency in Industrial Environments through IoT Connected Worker Solutions: Smart Wearable Technologies for the Workplace
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study investigates the integration of Internet of Things (IoT)-connected worker solutions with smart wearable technologies with the aim of enhancing efficiency and safety in industrial settings. The emergence of Industry 4.0 has necessitated the imperative to augment worker productivity while concurrently safeguarding their welfare. The proposed methodology utilises Internet of Things (IoT) devices to establish a networked environment, facilitating instantaneous surveillance and correspondence among labourers, equipment, and administrative frameworks. Smart wearable technologies, such as augmented reality (AR) glasses and wearables coupled with sensors, have a significant impact on equipping workers with valuable information, supporting their training, and improving their awareness of their surroundings. The integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology with smart wearables enables the utilization of data-driven decision-making processes, predictive maintenance strategies, and the adoption of proactive safety measures. By employing practical illustrations, we present evidence of the favorable effects that these technologies have on the optimization of industrial procedures, the mitigation of downtime, and the enhancement of overall operational efficacy. The results indicate that the adoption of IoT-connected worker solutions and smart wearables has the potential to bring about a fundamental change in the functioning of industrial environments. This can result in the development of a workplace that is not only safer and more productive, but also technologically advanced.

articleTitle: Hypothyreosis Prediction Using Feature Scaling Technique in ML
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In healthcare, early and accurate disease identification is essential for providing effective care. This factor is essential in disorders like thyroid conditions, which tends to be challenging to locate because its manifestations frequently resemble those of other illnesses. "Hypothyroidism" and "Hyperthyroidism" are the two kinds of thyroid illness. Hyperthyroidism arises when thyroid hormone secretion rises over the normal amount. When the gland that controls the thyroid is unable to create adequate hormones for itself, hypothyroidism, evolves, deteriorating bodily functions Elevated TSH, decreased FT4, increased body weight, decreased hunger, sluggish heart rate, lethargy, and slowed metabolism are the major symptoms. In this study, the LightGBM algorithm's feature scaling technique is used to predict hypothyroidism.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Generative AI Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Generative AI models have the potential to create a variety of new content based on training data. They are not only able to create textual content but also other multimedia content such as images, audio, video, etc. They have gained popularity in recent years as they have a major impact on various fields. They are used for several applications from text generation, image generation, and music composition to education, healthcare, and metaverse. Still, several challenges are faced while developing and applying these models i.e., trustworthiness, biased content, overfitting and regulatory concerns. In this paper, the comparative analysis of various generative AI models concerning different parameters is performed with respect to tools, frameworks, input, output, development authority, etc. In addition to these, Applications of different generative AI Models are discussed in various domains

articleTitle: Interpretable Melanoma Detection Utilizing Stacked Modeling Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A skin lesion is a region of the skin that has grown differently from the rest of the skin. A smaller version of the ISIC 2018 lesion dataset only has the two classifications of malignant and benign. The larger dataset has seven classes. While benign tumors are not carcinogenic, malignant tumors are. Malignant tumors are more capable of spreading throughout the body quickly and multiplying. For a patient to survive, it is crucial to find malignant skin lesions as soon as possible. Machine learning and deep learning models have become essential tools for spotting skin lesions. However, issues like picture occlusions and unbalanced datasets have made it difficult to achieve high accuracy. The interpretable technique for non-invasive cancer skin cancer detection presented in this research uses ensemble stack of algorithms for learning models and deep learning. The balanced photos of both kinds of facial moles make up the dataset employed to train the predictive models. Through crossover validation on the training set, predictions from these basic models aid in level one model training. Models using deep learning that have already been trained on ImageNet data are used for transfer learning. Each model’s performance is evaluated on an individual basis. The models based on deep learning are then put together in different ensembles and assessed. The research uses shapely adaptive explanations to generate heatmaps that emphasize the areas of the images that are most suggestive of the condition, improving interpretability. This strategy makes it easier for dermatologists to comprehend the model’s findings in a therapeutically useful way. curves are examples of evaluation measures. The study reveals the skin lesion categorization model that performs the best.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Multiclass Anomaly Detection in the IoT_GPS_Tracker Dataset: Unveiling Patterns for Enhanced Tracking Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This paper delves into the utilization of deep learning (DL) techniques for the task of multiclass anomaly detection within the "IoT_GPS_Tracker" dataset, resulting in an impressive overall accuracy of 94.72%. With a primary focus on discerning anomalies across diverse scenarios, our model employs a range of DL architectures to capture nuanced spatial-temporal relationships inherent in the data. Addressing challenges posed by the dynamic nature of IoT-generated information, the study not only attains high accuracy in anomaly detection but also contributes to a deeper comprehension of spatial dependencies. The implications extend to bolstering the accuracy of locationbased services, thereby facilitating improved anomaly recognition and decision-making. The investigation encompasses an in-depth analysis of various DL architectures, an exploration of spatial-temporal representations, and an assessment of real-world implications. This work offers valuable insights to the evolving realm of internet of things (IoT) analytics, laying the groundwork for more intelligent and adaptive multiclass anomaly detection systems within the IoT_GPS_Tracker dataset. The achieved overall accuracy of 94.72% underscores the effectiveness of our DL approach in elevating anomaly detection within the context of multiclass classification.

articleTitle: A Novel Classification Approach for Smart Card Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The primary objective of this research is to monitor and detect fraudulent transactions within payment systems. As the use of smart transactions continues to increase, so does the prevalence of fraudsters. These individuals consistently seek to disrupt others by engaging in illegal activities, resulting in financial losses for customers while benefiting the fraudsters. Therefore, it is crucial to prioritize the monitoring and early detection of fraud. This article presents a unique Machine Learning (ML) model for the early identification of fraudulent transactions, utilizing a range-based classification approach. Many existing machine learning algorithms struggle to improve the misclassification rate while maintaining good accuracy. However, the proposed range-based classification model exhibits strong accuracy while addressing the issue of rising misclassification rates. The experimental results are presented through a bar graph and a classification report. Additionally, compare the proposed model with several existing technologies to showcase its effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Potential Ensemble Technique with Hybrid Featured Selection for Impalpable Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the present day world the cluster of computers in the network share the information which is at highly risk. Data sharing on the open channel is not secure enough; intruders continue to sense and invade the numerous techniques to attack the data in various ways such as remote attack. Mostly the attacks detected on major classes but when the attacker invades at the minor classes at user to local or remote to local which is impalpable to detect due to its less sensing. But these impalpable attacks are much harmful. Currently there is very scare technique to detect such assaults to identity. In this article, numerous techniques implemented to identity the very minutely undetectable assault from the two points of view one is user at local and another is at remote to user. Here with an proposed hybrid machine learning technique gives the new way to detect several attacks like denial of service etc both with opting featured selection and non featured selection. While comparing the proposed approach with existing techniques justified with the significance of detection accuracy in Dos probing, user to remote and remote to local is being much better than the other existing approaches. For the experimentation verification NSL-KDD datasets are used to test and investigate an assessment.

articleTitle: Integration of AI, Digital Twin and Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) For Healthcare 5.0: A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rapid advancement of technology has ushered in a new era of healthcare, termed Healthcare 5.0, marked by the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Digital Twin technology, and the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT). This paper explores the challenges and opportunities inherent in reimagining healthcare within this paradigm in the context of India. As a nation with a vast and diverse population, India stands at the crossroads of harnessing the potential of these cutting-edge technologies. Through a comprehensive literature review and critical analysis, this study identifies and delves into the multifaceted challenges posed by technological disparities, data privacy concerns, skill gaps, regulatory complexities, and ethical considerations. These challenges highlight the need for equitable access, robust training, ethical frameworks, and collaborative efforts. However, amidst these challenges lies a landscape of unprecedented opportunities, including improved patient outcomes, personalized treatments, efficient healthcare delivery, and enhanced medical research. The transformative potential of AI, Digital Twin, and IoMT technologies necessitates a multidisciplinary approach, involving policymakers, healthcare practitioners, technologists, researchers, and patients. We examined key facets of Industry 4.0, the Internet of Things and Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) in our analysis. These features cover possibilities like enhanced decision-making, digital integration, predictive analytics, and sustainability. But there are challenges, including data overload, security concerns, and the need for scalable technology

Author Keywords: Internet of Medical things (IoMT) and Industry 4.0

articleTitle: Surrounding Light Intensity Detection web app with OpenCV and Streamlit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In today’s time with AI (Artificial Intelligence), we are trying to give a sense of intelligence to machines. In many computer vision, and IoT applications a machine needs to understand whether the surrounding light intensity is bright or dark. This intelligence is essential for an IoT product to do various jobs such as Switching on and off the light. This paper presents a prototype web app to detect surrounding light intensity and classify it into two labels ‘bright’ and ‘dark’. The Web app was built using streamlit python framework and the algorithm was designed using the OpenCV computer vision framework. The web app was tested with various people of different age groups and under varied environmental conditions. The experimental results showed that the app is giving fairly accurate results. The algorithm proposed is capable to be used in the production process of any IoT application for detecting surrounding light intensity.

Author Keywords: Light intnsity detection Light detection Web app

articleTitle: Predict the Temperature Rise using Facebook’s Prophet Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Global warming is by no means a new phenomenon. It is the term given to the rise of Earth’s temperature on a long-term scale. It has also been established that this occurs due to the accumulation of Green House Gases like Carbon Dioxide and Methane in the atmosphere and the subsequent absorption and entrapment of solar radiation by them. But a lesser-known fact is the release of greenhouse gases due to food and feed production. This is exactly what this paper intends to explore in this study. Four different datasets from various sources ranging from United Nations FAOSTAT database to NASA’s very own country-wise temperature database were taken in this study. The datasets were explored in a cause-effect manner performing the necessary preprocessing along the way. Finally, we used another comprehensive database generated by NASA consisting of temperature anomalies of the world based on months of every year and performed a Time-Series Forecasting using Facebook’s Prophet model to predict the temperature rise in the coming years.

articleTitle: A Smote based Heart Disease Prediction Approach using Conventional Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Coronary Heart Disease (CHD) is one of the major reasons of mortality worldwide. According to the report of the World Health Organization (WHO) in the year 2020, 20 million people died due to heart disease. CHD is highly preventable if predicted at an early stage coupled with early medication. To this end, in this work, 10-year risk of developing CHD using Boruta and Smote-based conventional models such as Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors, Decision Trees, and Support Vector Machine to improve the accuracy is predicted. The dataset provided by the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute consisting of 4000 patients with 15 attributes is used. For evaluation purposes, metrics such as Precision, Recall, F-measure, and RUC are used. The comparative analysis shows a precision of 86% and AUC of 92.8% for SVM depicting the best performance among all models.

articleTitle: Improving UHVDC Wall Bearings Electric Reliability: Grading Ring Optimization and Field Investigation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The cause of the violent explosion of a standard 800 kV conversion generator component has been examined in this study. The electromotive force and possibility dispersion along the HV bearing are calculated using the numerical simulation technique, and the construction of the scoring plates for the 800 kV bearing is optimized. Software is employed to build the two-half model of the 800kV gasket and control hall arrangement. The junction between the flange and indeed the enclosure and casing have a greater field strength, and the electromotive force is spread instead irregularly, in accordance with the computation of the magnetic charge and dissipation factor along the sleeve without any classification rings. The technique for attaching a classification ring to the hinge side to lessen its field strength from around the top of the shed and scabbard is then presented in this article. In order to reduce the maximum electrical field strength all around the component and the evaluation ring and to achieve the best evaluation ring construction, this technique also improves the position and setup factors of the assessment ring. The optimum layout is able to be used for the 800-kV power production project to minimize the likelihood of overloads of the UHVDC stabilizer bar after the model. The model confirms that the maximum field density from around the ground of the specimen, shed and holster, and the assessment ring is dominated within an appropriate limit.

articleTitle: Taxonomy of Multi-Agent Systems Attacks and their Defense Tactics in Certifying Security of Cyber Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The utilization of multi-agent systems has been increasingly prevalent across various sectors, owing to their notable efficacy in execution. However, a multitude of hazards exist that possess the capability to undermine the integrity of the agent and pose a threat to the overall security of the system. Therefore, it is crucial to carefully evaluate and address security vulnerabilities during the process of creating Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). This survey assesses different models that aim to guarantee the security of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). These models were developed based on principles related to the agents' functionality and communication. This study offers a comprehensive examination and categorization of the prevailing threats targeting Multi-Agent Systems (MASs). Following this, we conduct a comprehensive analysis and assessment of diverse security strategies described in scholarly sources, classifying them into prevention, detection, and resiliency approaches based on their established credibility and reliability. In conclusion, we offer a suggestion for the optimal security approach to address particular types of threats, considering the most recent breakthroughs in the field of study.

articleTitle: Automatic Street Light System Using Arduino & LDR Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The massive quantity of electricity gets used in lights through roadways in India. Still, roadways remain empty for nearly all of the day after at night, with a handful of cars passing during the entire time. In India, the typical roadway and bridge illumination system isn't automated. The number of vehicles and visitors is particularly high in the streets at night, and the lights are on all night. A greater proportion of light is squandered on roads ineffectively. This paper shows a street light system is utilized with different innovations. Power LEDs are utilized due to its excellent electrical efficiency, extra duration, cost-effectiveness, and capacity to lower pollution levels. Using a smart street light system, we will save our electrical costs. In addition, smart street lights will control power more effectively by reducing the risk of the automated street light system warming as well as the risk of incidents. Wasting energy by keeping the street lights on all night, we can build an affordable, high-performance smart street light system with the Arduino, LDR sensors. In this article, we'll discover how to create an automatic street light which turns itself on or off while a car or other object is passing by.

articleTitle: Identification And Diagnoses of Plant Diseases in Fruit Crops Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: India, being an agriculture-centric nation, historically relied on traditional farming methods that often resulted in crop losses and significant financial setbacks for farmers. In the present era, however, the incorporation of technology in agriculture has led to a rise in crop value, still, there is a great scope of research. One of the key reasons of the production of low-quality crops is the presence of infections or diseases. This research paper focuses on the application of machine learning algorithms, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and MobileNetV2, for plant disease detection in apple, strawberry, and grape leaves. The dataset used comprises 29,327 images, and various performance metrics were employed to evaluate the models' accuracies. According to the findings, the SVM model performs best with 82%, 98% and 72% accuracy for apple, strawberry, and grape crop respectively. Also, the precision, recall and F-score values are significantly high for CNN. So, among three considered model in the experiment for identification of disease in apple while for grapes and strawberry CNN works better than other two models.

articleTitle: Secured Normalized Tagged Response for Patient Critical Care Monitoring System: A Unified approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the rapidly advancing realm of healthcare, ensuring the well-being of critical care patients stands as a paramount mission. Various cutting-edge sensors are available in the market, proficient in monitoring vital health. A substantial number of healthcare facilities still rely on manual processes, a practice that is not only repetitive and labor-intensive but also fraught with the potential for human errors. This pressing need for immediate, accurate responses in the context of critical care has driven the development of a comprehensive solution. Our proposed system brings together security, data normalization, and efficient data exchange, underpinned by a unified approach. Security, a cornerstone of healthcare, finds its realization in the implementation of JSON Web Tokens (JWT). This technology ensures the privacy and integrity of communication between healthcare entities. Crucial patient data, including personal particulars, lifeline parameters, and historical records, is securely housed in a scalable and non-redundant Postgres SQL database. In emergencies, time is of the essence. To expedite responses, an innovative tagged QR code technique is introduced. The unified approach doesn't simply prioritize security; it underscores the significance of data standardization and efficient data exchange. A robust security framework has been meticulously designed to protect sensitive patient information, minimize the risk of data breaches, and prevent unauthorized access. Furthermore, data normalization ensures that patient data is consistently structured and formatted, facilitating compatibility with diverse healthcare platforms and devices. The normalization additionally enhances interoperability, enabling seamless information exchange between different systems and healthcare providers. In summary, our unified approach, marked by state-of-the-art security, data normalization, and efficient data tagging, sets a new standard for patient care in critical settings, ensuring the highest level of patient well-being.

articleTitle: Risk Factor Analysis in Breast Cancer Using Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Presently All Types of cancers can be detected using artificial intelligence and data mining technologies. These technologies can recognize patients who have or don't have illnesses. In the early stage, the use of machine learning technology is intended to deliver precise and rapid diagnosis findings. Cancer has become one of the most common diseases whose mortality rate is rising at an alarming speed. The severity of the condition is greater in industrialized nations, where females are more likely to get the issues of breast cancer. When the tissues in the breast continue to grow abnormally it results in the breast tumour. These cancerous cells can spread throughout the entire body and affect different body parts like the brain, bones, heart, or lungs. These cells can reoccur on the primary sites resulting in the relapse of cancer or these cells can further cause damage to various body parts i.e. metastasis. Hence, it is very important to control the spread of these cancerous cells at an initial stage so that it does not lead to the death of the patients. If the spread of cancer is controlled and proper medication and treatment are given to the patient who is suffering from this disease, then that can save the life of that patient. In this research paper, the work done by different authors in analysing risk factors is studied, and the feature selection technique PCA is applied to the breast cancer surveillance consortium dataset to predict the most important risk factors leading to breast cancer.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Approaches for Cyber bullying Detection in Digital Forums
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Social connections developed under narrow cultural bounds, such as physical locations, prior to the invention of information and communication technologies (ICT). Recent advances in communication technology have greatly surpassed the spatial and temporal limitations of traditional communications. But the improper use of social technology, like social media platforms, has given rise to a brand-new kind of aggressiveness, violence, and abuse that only takes place online. This analysis highlights a new type of social media website behavior. We thoroughly evaluate cyberbullying (CB) prediction models. We examine cyberbullying prediction models in great detail and pinpoint the key problems that surround their creation on social media. This paper describes the overall process for identifying cyberbullying in depth and, more importantly, it summarizes the method. The aim of this effort is to build an efficient method for spotting online bullying and abusive messages by combining NLP and Machine Learning (ML) technologies. For this, I have gathered 2 datasets (DATASETS 1 AND 2) from various sources. Dataset 1 has 10,000 comments, whereas Dataset 2 has 20,000 comments. Tokenization, stop words, Bag of Words (BoW), and six machine learning algorithms—Logistic regression (LR), SVM, Random forest (RF), Decision Tree (DT), Naive Bayes (NB), and XG Boost (XG)—have all been used in NLP. I have trained and each of the 6 ML algorithms, and I have analyzed the outcomes for each independently. Results demonstrate that RF is more effective for both datasets, showing 99.39% accuracy, 99.31% precision, 99.93% recall, 99.61% F1-score, and 97.32% specificity for Dataset 1 and 98.86% accuracy, 97.7% precision, 99.48% recall, 98.58% F1-score, and 98.45% specificity for Dataset 2 accordingly.

articleTitle: An Effective Method for the Compression of Images Used in Virtual Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research paper introduces a concept for photo compression that utilises the spatial redundancy approach. The proposed method use the discrete cosine transform technique with various block sizes, specifically 8x8, 16x16, 32x32, and 64x64. The process of quantization can be achieved by establishing a set of threshold values at various distances. Due to these aforementioned considerations, the implementation of this strategy is straightforward, requiring less memory usage and may be completed in a shorter duration. The utilization of the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) methodology was employed to develop and execute a compression approach for virtual graphics through the utilization of MATLAB. The calculation of the compression ratio and peak signal-to-noise ratio was performed for each compressed block to get the ideal results. In order to enhance the analysis of the collected data, utilized the metrics of Compression Ratio (CR) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), in conjunction with software tools that are applicable across several sectors.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Communication Network Transforms Information Technologies: A Thematic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Information technology (IT) is transforming the modern era by enabling easier generation, storage, retrieval, and sharing of information. Advancements like artificial intelligence, block chain, and data analytics are transforming information gathering, processing, and utilization. Block chain technology is blending decentralized design with communication networks, bringing improved transparency, security, and efficiency. Using bibliometric, network and thematic analysis, this study looks at the investigation on information technologies, block chain and communication network from 2017 to 2023. The objective of the research study is to get an understanding of the fundamental principles behind blockchain technology, as well as to explore the necessity for its adaptation within the field of information technology. Furthermore, the study aims to identify potential future trends and research avenues in this area and develop a framework that can be used by the researchers for further study. These notions will facilitate the selection of optimal study topics in subsequent endeavours.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Fake News Detection on Social Media Text
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In today's digital age, the swift spreading of information has revolutionized the way for news consumers and makes them informed. However, this convenience comes with a downside – the propagation of fake news, which can spread misinformation, manipulate public opinions, and undermine the credibility of legitimate sources. The term "fake news" refers to intentionally fabricated or misleading information that is frequently presented as news for a variety of cognitive processes, including commercial, social, or political gain. Machine Learning (ML), with its ability to analyze large datasets and discern patterns, has emerged as a promising solution for tackling the issue of fake news. By leveraging techniques such as Natural Language Processing (NLP), classification algorithms, and anomaly detection, ML models can be trained to identify and differentiate between authentic news and fake news. That in turn prevents the news consumer from misleading, prevent a product or service from defame and also helps in political defaming. Machine learning algorithms can be used to analyze historical data and make accurate predictions about whether news fakes or not. In this study, the proposed machine learning-based news analysis model utilizes feature selection technique to categorize the news. The model explores different classification algorithms, including Decision Tree (DT), Passive Aggressive Classifier (PAC), Logistic Regression (LR), and Random Forest (RF), to build the fake news prediction model. The experimental results show that the Passive Aggressive Classifier outperforms other models with an accuracy rate of 93%. The proposed model can help news channels; social media and consumers to distinguish between fake and real news, and minimize the risk of misleading.

articleTitle: Machine Learning For 5G Security Using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The abstract for the research paper on "Machine Learning for 5G Security using Random Forest" discusses the importance of 5G security in the current digital age and the role of machine learning in addressing security concerns. The capacity of machine learning algorithms to assess and identify security threats in real-time has led to a rise in their appeal in the field of cybersecurity. With the emergence of 5G networks, there is an increasing need for robust security measures to protect the network from various types of attacks. In this context, the use of Random Forest (RF) as a machine learning algorithm has shown promising results in detecting security threats in 5G networks. This study provides an overview of the use of RF in 5G security while emphasizing its benefits and drawbacks. The study includes a detailed discussion of the working principle of RF, its suitability for security analysis, and the various metrics used to evaluate its performance. The paper proposes the use of Random Forest algorithm, a powerful machine learning technique, for securing 5G networks. The research explores the application of Random Forest to identify potential security threats and classify network traffic into secure and insecure categories. The suggested approach demonstrates great accuracy in identifying security concerns when tested using data from a real-world 5G network. The outcomes show how machine learning approaches can improve 5G security and offer a dependable line of defence against cyber attacks. The paper concludes by highlighting the significance of this work and its potential for further research in the field of 5G security.

articleTitle: EmoNet: Exploring Facial Emotion Recognition Through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study uses a CNN model to explore deeper into the complex categorization of mask face emotion identification. There are number of application techniques which uses face emotion recognition [FER]. Ex.: - application like (Snapchats), Healthcare (identify genetic diseases), Market research, phone (face locks). The problem over this application is still under the accuracy point of research. Mask Facial Emotion based on image processing and vision of computer. In this project we are presenting the system which run on machine learning algorithm [CNN (Convolutional neural network)]. It is capable of recognition of facial emotion under mask with more accuracy. This system helps to differentiate between 5 universal emotions like Happy, Anger, neutral, Surprise and Sad.

articleTitle: Analysis of Soil Categorization for Improving Productivity with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Agriculture plays a crucial role in sustaining a thriving economy. However, the quality of soil, which is vital for sustainable food production, may deteriorate due to intensified cultivation practices and growing demand. Emphasizing the significance of maintaining healthy soil is imperative, as a deficiency in essential nutrients can substantially reduce crop yields. The adoption of advanced technologies like smart soil prediction and soil analysis provides precise information about the distribution of soil nutrients, which is crucial for achieving precision in agricultural practices. These intelligent soil analysis systems are increasingly driven by machine learning techniques

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement and Harmonics Reduction Method Using Neural Fuzzy Logic Controller In Two-Stage Pv-Battery System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: According to the Power Quality Analysis, how much harmonic current must be injected into the grid as a result of solar power plants connected on the user side summarizes the impacts of grid-connected solar power plants on harmonic current on the power quality of the distribution network. After that, models for solar generation and the electrical grid are developed in order to examine photovoltaic generation that is connected to the grid. The converter manages reactive power adjustment in both linear and nonlinear loads. Comparisons are made between the performance of controllers for artificial and fuzzy neural networks. This technique successfully eliminates total harmonic distortion. The main goals of the strategy are to get the most out of renewable energy sources and to boost the absolute system's accuracy by using more power—typically half of the regular boost inductance.

articleTitle: A Real-Time IoT Based Fall Detection and Alert System for Elderly
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Many senior adults live independently or are distanced from their younger family members for various reasons, exposing them to the risk of falling. Falls among the elderly can lead to serious health complications, and in some cases, they can be fatal. An Internet of Things (IoT)-based fall detection and warning system has emerged as a crucial tool for caregivers dealing with the elderly population. This innovative device employs accelerometer and gyroscope sensors to continuously monitor an individual's movements. By comparing these movements to predefined thresholds, it can detect potential falls. When a fall risk is identified, the device swiftly sends an alert, providing immediate assistance to the elderly person in need. The results of implementing this technology have been highly promising. When a potential fall is detected, the system sends alerts to designated caregivers or family members, ensuring they are informed about the situation. Simultaneously, the device prompts the elderly individual to seek help promptly. This dual-notification system ensures that immediate attention is given to those in need, significantly reducing the risk of severe health consequences resulting from undetected falls. To achieve this functionality, the device employs a Node MCU microcontroller and an MPU6050 sensor module. The MPU6050 module houses both an accelerometer and a gyroscope. The accelerometer provides critical three-axis data on angular parameters, while the gyroscope aids in orientation detection. By continuously analysing acceleration patterns and comparing them to predefined thresholds, the device effectively identifies potential falls. Once a fall is detected, the system promptly notifies the individual via email, thanks to the integration with the Node MCU microcontroller and Wi-Fi connectivity. This email notification serves as a vital lifeline, ensuring that timely assistance can be provided to the elderly, ultimately preventing life-threatening situations. The IoT-based fall detection and warning system, utilizing accelerometer and gyroscope sensors, addresses a pressing concern faced by seniors living independently or distanced from their families. This technology's ability to detect falls and alert caregivers via email significantly enhances the safety and well-being of elderly individuals, reducing the risks associated with falls and their potentially dire consequences.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Security with Key Distribution Method in Mobile Ad-hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A Mobile Ad-hoc Network (MANET) is the best network system in wireless communication because it has the best properties to connect devices without the need for extra infrastructure and dynamic access. A MANET is used too much by devices, laptops, pc, and any other gadgets but in an insecure network. A better security strategy can give the best protection and fast speed without giving time to attackers in insecure MANET. In this paper, the Lightweight Security with Key Distribution Method in Mobile Ad-hoc Network (LS-KMM) method is combined with the Diffie-Hellman method and discrete distribution method. The authorized access system is concerned with the key exchange method of Diffie-Hellman to manage the right access by exchanging secure keys between users and a strong security scheme achieved by the discrete distribution method at a lightweight speed for stopping attacks in MANET. The experimental test result presents that the LS-KMM method is achieved better than existing methods, DES, 3DES, conventional AES, modified AES, RC4, Blow-fish, and RSA in the conditions of encryption process time, running time, and the avalanche effect.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Bagged CNN with Whale Optimization Algorithm to Forecast the Productivity of Rice Crop using Soil Nutrients
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Soil nutrients plays a major role in the growth of crop and yield of crop. Traditional methods in agriculture failed to produce high yield due to global warming and chemical fertilizers. Thus, efficient predictive model from machine learning can be used to produce better yield. There are two subdivisions namely Ensemble Learning (EL) and Deep Learning (DL) that performs better than the machine learning shallow methods. DL deals with models which are very complex and data that are non-linearly related whereas, EL methods can combine multi- base models to built efficient predictive models. DL with EL methods can combine the advantages of both methods and produces end model that shows great accuracy in performance. Also, ensemble methods, namely boosting and stacking helps to reduce the bias and Bagging called Bootstrap aggregating reduces the variance while using the different subsets of the same dataset. In this research, Bagged Convolutional Neural Networks(CNN) based prediction system has developed with WOA to forecast the productivity of Rice crop with the help of soil nutrients such as micro and macro nutrients along with pH value. This Bagged DLArchitecture reduces the overfitting of the data and produces an accuracy of around 85.8% with a error rate of about 14.2%.

articleTitle: Solicitations of ML Paradigms in Soft Robotic Applications: An Inclusive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Extensive research has been conducted on soft robots due to their inherent qualities of malleability and adaptability. Soft robots encounter difficulties in the areas of modelling, calibration, and control in comparison to rigid robots. The intricate behaviours witnessed in soft materials stem from their distinctive characteristics, such as non-linearity and hysteresis. In order to address these constraints, current research has employed various methodologies rooted in machine learning. This study provides a comprehensive survey of the current machine learning methods used in the field of soft robotics. The paper classifies the implementation of these methods in various soft robotic applications, including soft sensors, soft actuators, and applications such as soft wearable robots. Besides, it examines the observed patterns in several machine learning methods regarding multiple categories of soft robot applications. Furthermore, it highlights the current constraints in the study domain, followed by a concise overview of the machine learning methods that are now available for soft robotics.

articleTitle: Ensemble Classifier for Pediatric Pneumonia Diagnosis in Chest X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The increased fatality rates in the past few years have brought pediatric pneumonia to widespread attention. Chest X-rays are a frequently used method for diagnosing paediatric pneumonia since they are non-intrusive and inexpensive. However, efficient identification is difficult because to the minimal radiation exposure required for paediatric assessment. To identify and categories paediatric pneumonia using X-ray pictures, a reliable computer-aided diagnostic model is required in response to this issue.
