The purpose of this study is to compare the effectiveness of solo and group learning methods for diagnosing pediatric pneumonia. The ensembles employed rely primarily on (InceptionV3, ResNet-50, and VGG16) fine-tuned variations. Authors employed a dataset of 5856 chest X-ray scans, in to conduct extensive research. As a consequence, for the base model, we discovered that ResNet50 has the best accuracy of 82.21% amongst the three base models. Furthermore, the ensemble model outperformed with an accuracy of 84.46%.

articleTitle: Forecasting Oil Production Using Regression and Ensemble Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) algorithms can be used to forecast the production of bore oil volume. Different ML algorithms were applied to train the model over number of features. The public dataset for daily production was used for this study. The proposed model underwent various preprocessing stages before applying the algorithms. The data is purified by filling the null values with imputing methods like iterative imputer, KNN imputer. Accuracy of an algorithm is much influenced by the right feature and so, feature selection methods play a vital role. Random feature elimination with cross validation techniques like – linear regression, decision tree regression and random forest regression are used to identify prominent features that influence the dependent feature. Conventional regression algorithms like linear regression, polynomial regression are applied along with ensemble algorithms like Decision Tree Regressor, AdaBoost Regressor, Random Forest Regressor, Gradient Boost Regressor and XGBoost Regressor are applied on dataset. The metrics used to analyze the performance of these regression models includes Mean Square Error (MSE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), R2 Score. The traditional regressor algorithms are good at train data, they are failed to perform well on test data. Among the ensemble algorithms, XGBoost has performed will comparing with the remaining algorithms on both train and test dataset.

articleTitle: An Overview of Methodologies and Prototypes involved in Speech Recognition Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The discipline of voice recognition is characterised by its multidisciplinary nature, incorporating the domains of linguistics, electrical engineering, and computer science. Its primary focus lies in the analysis and interpretation of spoken language. At present, automated voice recognition systems are employed across several fields such as commerce, government, and education, to effectively process mathematical statements. The present study is centred on the identification of impediments in speech recognition systems for mathematical phrases. This article offers a comprehensive examination of the current status of voice recognition techniques, encompassing a broad scope as well as focusing on the specialised domain of mathematical expressions. In this study, we examine many components including feature extraction approaches, classifiers, datasets, recording tools, and performance assessments.

articleTitle: Privacy Preservation and Secured Data Storage on Cloud Using Encryption Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the recent time, most of the crucial data are stored on the cloud due to ease of access and extra storing capacity. Cloud computing is an emerging technology that has a power of on-demand availability of computer resources, elasticity of digital data in terms of storage and easy access as per the user’s requirement. Cloud computing creates an interaction between client and server by using cloud service model and deployment model. Therefore, security of such important data is mandatory. In this research articles the major issues while storing and accessing data on or from the cloud are discussed and the encryption algorithms such as DES, AES, RSA, Blowfish, and Homographic are discussed along with its security features. The Cryptographic algorithms are discussed as it provides more security to the user by using security keys.

articleTitle: Answer Relevance Score (ARS): Novel Evaluation Metric for Question Answering System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The evaluation of question answering systems plays a crucial role in assessing their performance and effectiveness. Existing evaluation metrics often focus on aspects such as recall, precision and F1 score, but may not fully capture the relevance and informativeness of the generated answers. In this paper, a novel evaluation metric called Answer Relevance Score (ARS) is proposed that takes into aspects i.e. correctness and completeness. Correctness considers the comprehensiveness of answer which consider the semantic and contextual analysis of sentences selected for answer. The answer's completeness analyse the rate of information overlap in reference and generated answer. ARS is compared with existing metrics and to this end, comparative study is also given for evaluating the efficiency of existing metrics across two datasets; Natural Questions and WikiQA. It is find that ARS metric correlates much better with human judgement than other benchmarks.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction from Text using Grasshopper optimization algorithm for identifying hate speech
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The optimization algorithms have ability to eliminate features that are extraneous and redundant, shrink the vector space, manage computation time, and enhance performance on problems requiring more accurate classification. Feature selection and feature extraction have always been crucial, especially in text categorization. Using optimization algorithms, engineering methods are used in these can be improved still further. Using five machine learning (ML) models—Decision Tree (DT), Naive Bayes (NB), Random Forest (RF) and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) and Deep Neural Network (DNN)—this paper implements one such optimization algorithm, Grasshopper optimization (GOA), using various feature extraction and selection methods on textual datasets. The machine learning model performs more effectively due to the suggested feature selection and feature extraction strategies. In order to identify hate speech, this study takes into consideration text-based datasets. The positive, negative, and neutral sentiments of tweets are extracted from the Twitter API to create the text collection. On the application of GAO, Combining Random Forest with the method of feature extraction TF-IDF shows a greatest accuracy improvement of 24% as compared with without applied any optimization algorithm and 13% accuracy increased as compared with another optimization algorithm i.e., ACO. GOA provides an accuracy of up to 93%, which is superior to ACO optimization algorithm's 80% accuracy when used with the Random Forest model.

articleTitle: Metric Suite for Event-Driven Software Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Event-driven software systems have gained significant prominence due to their ability to handle complex and asynchronous interactions. Evaluating the quality and characteristics of such systems is crucial to ensure their reliability and efficiency. This research paper proposes a comprehensive set of metrics specifically designed to measure event-driven software systems. Beginning with an exposition of the event-driven programming paradigm, this study emphasizes its pivotal traits, highlighting the distinctiveness of event-driven systems in contrast to structured and object-oriented programming paradigms. The purpose of this research paper is to address the necessity for metrics tailored to event-driven systems. The proposed metrics are grouped into categories, such as event structure, event dependency, event performance, event complexity, event synchronization and event reliability metrics. Each metric is defined and described. These metrics facilitate software practitioners to make informed decisions during system design, optimization, and evaluation processes. The research paper concludes by discussing the limitations of the study, including potential threats to its validity. Future guidelines are also outlined, highlighting opportunities for further research, industry adoption, tooling, benchmarking, and continuous improvement of the proposed metrics.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Autism Spectrum Disorder: Leveraging Machine Learning Algorithms to Assess Likelihood from Multifactorial Features
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This work proposed predictive modeling approach for Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) assessment, employing machine learning algorithms to analyze multifactorial features. Utilizing a diverse dataset that includes demographic, behavioral, and clinical information, our models aim to predict the likelihood of ASD. The chosen evaluation metric is the Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC-ROC Score), ensuring robust model performance assessment. Through rigorous experimentation, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our methodology in accurately identifying individuals at risk of ASD. This research contributes to advancing early detection methods and enhancing our understanding of the intricate interplay of features influencing ASD, laying the groundwork for more informed diagnostic strategies.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review for Cardiovascular Disease Detection using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The most important part of providing health care is diagnosing diseases. If a disease is diagnosed earlier than usual or anticipated, it may save a person's life. Methods based on machine learning can assist the medical field by providing accurate and immediate disease diagnoses. The difficulty of diagnosing heart disease makes it one of the most hazardous diseases in the world today. In healthcare contexts, ML is a powerful technology that can swiftly and correctly predict outcomes. After a brief explanation of machine learning, we present synopses of the very common methods for HD diagnosis. This study provides a comprehensive overview of heart disease, the risk factors associated with it, and a brief discussion of the numerous techniques employed to automatically detect heart disease. The detailed information on certain machine learning-based methodologies and investigates the methods for heart disease diagnosis that have been mentioned in the literature throughout the previous five years (2018-2023). There is also mention of a comparison chart. However, among the possibilities mentioned, the classification of cardiac disease has recently drawn increasing attention as a useful and significant alternative.

articleTitle: Advanced Aerial Network Nodes for Next-Generation Wireless Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study explores the use of drones with mobile capacity as airborne hubs for connection to the last mile, highlighting the requirement of high-fidelity, low-latency communications. The main goal is to improve on-demand connection to the internet by using Future Aerial Networks (FANETs), which group drone as handheld intermediaries. The research thoroughly examines important factors such energy availability, flexibility, communication effectiveness while ideal node placement, and adaptable optimizations. This study work’s basic core is deeply shaped by these components. The study also improves the fundamental ideas of mobile network architecture to accommodate novel app possibilities and reduce operating expenses associated with various ad hoc installs. The thoroughness of this research opens the door for new transmission concepts by illuminating the advantages and difficulties of using drone-based overhead intermediaries.

articleTitle: An Explainable Deep Learning Intrusion Detection in IoT-Enabled Transportation Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cities are becoming sophisticated ecosystems that increase production and efficiency because to a notable increase in the Internet of Things (IoT). These technological advancements also increase scope of vulnerabilities to Cyber-attacks, making robust security measures a necessity.In this study, we explore IoT-enabled transportation networks’ need for intrusion detection systems. Adaptable and robust security solutions are essential as sophisticated cyber-attacks target critical infrastructure. The suggested framework applies deep learning and machine learning models to network intrusion detection through a thorough examination: Gradient Boosting Classifier which gave a 95.77% score, Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) giving 96.54%, Autoencoder combined with k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) Classifier gave 94.74%, and Feedforward Neural Network (FNN) with the highest score of 97.15%. But GRU excels with its rapid execution. This study focuses on evaluating and comparing these models. In addition, the framework can adapt to changing attack patterns and dynamic situations since it uses unsupervised learning techniques. This adaptability allows the framework to detect both known and unidentified attacks, ensuring its resistance to emerging dangers.

articleTitle: Bitcoin Price Analysis With Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cryptography is used by cryptocurrencies to safeguard and authenticate transactions, as well as to regulate the creation of new units. Cryptocurrencies, as opposed to traditional money, which is often issued by a central authority like a government are decentralized meaning they are not managed by any one entity or group. One of the most well cryptocurrency is "Bitcoin". Cryptography is used by Bitcoin, a decentralized digital currency, to safeguard transactions and regulate the generation of new units. It is exchanged on different cryptocurrency exchanges and runs without the help of a central bank. However, the future currency is the ultimate digital currency. In this paper we are going to inculcate with the neural network models like sequence-to-sequence, ARIMA(Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average), LSTM(Long Short-Term Model). This process is certainly made to analyze the bitcoin price over the past couple of years. We trained our model accordingly and found out 96.21% accuracy for the sequence-to-sequence and 94.2% for the ARIMA as well. Eventually this paper and its work insinuate regarding the highly accurate performing algorithm and its analysis as well.

articleTitle: HUMSAFAR: Woman Safety Device with Tracking using ARDUINO
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: India,which is a promising global leader and an economic hub, is still trapped in the clutches of various patriarchal problems like kidnapping, murder, molestations, dowry, crime against women, worst among all is rape. The atrocities against the women can be stopped with the help of this proposed safety device. The proposed safety device includes a microcontroller, an emergency pushbutton switch, and a heartbeat sensor. Whenever emergency situation is sensed, the device acquires the current location of the woman in distress and forwards it to emergency contacts via Global System for Mobile (GSM) module. The Global Positioning System(GPS) module is used to track the location. The information processed by microcontroller is sent to the user using GSM modem (interfaced to the MCU) which then sends an SMS to the predefined mobile number. When a woman is in danger and need self-defense, she can press the switch allotted to her. The complete system is initialized and a SMS with location will be sent immediately to the concerned person with a single press of the switch. The heartbeat rate data is also sent along with the coordinates of the person’s location as a text message to the number using GSM and GPS.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Classification Based on SVM Based Densenets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research proposes a novel approach for the classification of plant leaf diseases by combining Support Vector Machines (SVM) with Dense Convolutional Neural Networks (DenseNets). Plant diseases pose a significant threat to agricultural productivity, making accurate and efficient disease classification crucial for timely intervention. In this study, a DenseNet architecture is employed to automatically extract high-level features from plant leaf images. These features are then fed into SVM classifiers for robust disease classification. The proposed hybrid model harnesses the strengths of both deep learning and traditional machine learning techniques, resulting in improved accuracy and generalization. Experimental results on a benchmark plant leaf disease dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach, showcasing its potential for aiding in precision agriculture and crop management.

articleTitle: Feature Vector Generation for Content Based Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The utilization of computer vision techniques to address the image retrieval problem, which involves searching for digital images in extensive databases, is referred to as Content Based Image Retrieval. The present paper expounds on a CBIR approach that is capable of filtering images on the basis of their content, thereby enhancing the indexing process and yielding outcomes that are more precise. The given paper involves the generation of feature vectors through the utilization of the color averaging technique, followed by the application of similarity measures. Furthermore, the performance of the proposed method is evaluated through the selection of a few query images per class in a random manner. The Precision-Recall cross-over plot is utilized as a performance evaluation metric to assess the efficacy of the algorithm. The findings of the study indicate that the relevance of the retrieved image is influenced by both the size of the database and the number of distinct classes.

articleTitle: Emerging Technology for Smart Farming in The Agriculture Domain: Application and Future Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Food is necessary for basic needs, farming is regarded as a global source of commerce. Horticulture is a significant source of employment in non-industrialized countries like India. The activities involved in farming are broadly categorized into three key areas: reaping and post-collection. AI is the present innovation helping agriculture people cultivate bits of knowledge about the pre-harvesting and post-harvesting approaches. This paper presents a broad study of most recent AI & ML application in agribusiness to mitigate the issues in pre collecting, reaping, and post gathering.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Developments in Oncological Diagnostic Imaging: Revolutionary Approaches to Cancer Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This project aims to demonstrate new uses of deep learning techniques in the detection of cancer. A huge body of examples that show the desired behaviour may be used to train a system using deep learning, which is a family of algorithms. Introduction of deep learning methods to tumour imaging may help pathologists identify and categorise cancer early on so that patients can get the right therapies to improve their chances of surviving or recovering. Utilising statistics and other analytical techniques and ScienceDirect have data, it appears that since the late 1990s, a sharp increase in research on deep learning technologies in medical imaging has been motivated by the exceptionally high mortality rates of some cancer types in order to address the concomitant issues of a more precise recognition and the identification of cancer types to use effective therapies for cancer. This study also identifies the institutions, nations, and intellectual subject areas with the greatest levels of intellectual output in multiple disciplines as the origins of the trajectory of deep learning technology in cancer detection. According to Amara's law, this novel technique may result in a change in the way that cancer diagnoses and treats its many forms. When they can submit digital photos to laboratories in other developed nations to have malignancy kinds diagnosed, this fresh innovation may also aid developing regions, narrowing the present healthcare divide as much as feasible.

articleTitle: Fuzzy based Hybrid Clustering using Dual Cluster Heads (FHCDCH) for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A broad spectrum of applications use wireless sensor networks (WSNs) but the consumption of the energy is one of the biggest issue due to the resource constraints. Clustering has been proved to be the most widely used technique for efficient resource utilization. It is not only used for topology management but also for balancing the network load so as to ensure energy efficiency and network stability by enhancing the network lifespan. The proposed work suggests the use of dual cluster heads viz. primary CH and secondary CH to balance the load evenly. The proposed hybrid approach FHCDCH forms clusters by applying Fuzzy–C–Means proceeded by the appointment of secondary CH by using fuzzy logic on the basis of node’s remnant energy, degree and centrality. The proposed scheme FHCDCH exhibits 30%-40% improvements in terms of network longevity and throughput as depicted by the simulation results.

articleTitle: A Qualitative Analysis for Predicting the Future of Auto Text Summarization in Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study conducts a qualitative analysis of the future prospects of auto summarization of text in Natural Language Processing. Auto-text summarization is one of the most discussed and well-known use cases of Natural Language Processing used to easily find the summary or conclusion of a lengthy text. Manually this process takes much more time but auto text-summarization reduces the time constraint by converting large text into a condensed form while maintaining its meaning and key information. This technique saves time and effort by focusing precisely on important points.In this paper, we also focused on the different types of text summarization and their uses, and a list of tools and methods available for text summarization. We are trying to predict the future of text summarization and the useful extensions needed in it to improvise the auto text-summarization process.

articleTitle: Ensemble Boosting Algorithms for Software Defect Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the ever-evolving world of software development, ensuring high-quality software is crucial for meeting user expectations. Software Defect Prediction (SDP) identifies the modules which may contain defects and require substantial testing. Therefore, predicting software defects at an early stage is very much helpful for companies. However, problems like class imbalance and noise in dataset needs to be addressed to build a better model. This paper uses SMOTE for resampling the data and explores the use of ensemble boosting algorithms for predicting software defects. The study utilizes several boosting algorithms, including CatBoost, XGBoost, and LightGBM, and compares their performance on publicly available software defect dataset such as NASA(PROMISE). The proposed ensemble learning model significantly improved the predictive accuracy, outperforming conventional machine learning methods like Logistic Regression and Naïve Bayes. The experimental outcomes show that ensemble boosting model has achieved better results in predicting defects with 86% Accuracy, 0.85 G-mean and 0.92 AUC measures.

articleTitle: New Machine Learning Model to Movie Recommender and Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Recently, technology has put the limelight on every industry, which ends in an overload of massive data that might be resolved using efficient recommender systems. The recommendation system is handy to accommodate large amounts of knowledge and separate helpful information. One in each of its applications falls in movie recommendations. Currently, numerous movies are developing, which makes it difficult for movie addicts to settle on one in all of them. The movie recommendation system intends to assist movie enthusiasts in cutting back on human effort by suggesting movies efficiently and effectively without wasting much time in useless browsing. Recommending products that support user interest is one of the principal business tasks achieved using machine learning (ML). This research develops a new supervised ML model to recommend movies with the naïve Bayes’ (NB) and support vector machine (SVM) classifier that combines cosine similarity (CS) and sentiment analysis (SA). The CS may be a standard accustomed measure of finding similarity between two items, and the SA of a movie review can classify the type of a review. The proposed model applies the training strategy and the reviews classifications are done accordingly and the predictions are made. This research model performance is tested with benchmark instances, 97% accuracy is obtained by applying SA with the NB approach, and 98% accuracy is obtained using an SVM. The simulation results conclude that the proposed model produced more significant outcomes than the existing approaches in deploying the proposed recommender engine as a website that takes input from users and recommends similar movies with related images in minimal computing time.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing for Prediction of Disaster Tweets using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: People who have access to the internet now often utilize social media as a result of the growing digitization. The widespread usage of social media has considerably hastened the propagation of social events while also accelerating human connection. It seemed obvious that the broad and quick use of information would have advantages for social scientists and computer scientists. People’s sentences on social media may be classified based on the emotional emotions they include, making it simple to utilize them to describe and forecast events. NLP (Natural Language Processing) approaches may carry out this estimate procedure. In this paper, we used the ensemble learning approach to evaluate tweets that included terms associated with catastrophes using various pre-processing techniques and TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) feature extraction method. We compared these classification algorithms (Gaussian Navies Bayes, Logistic Regression, Random Forest,) according to their f1 scores, accuracy, precision and Recall.

articleTitle: Enhancing Non-Destructive Examining of Composite Materials Using Lightweight Structures And Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Composite materials and structures are becoming more efficient and cost-effective, and new special features are being developed to improve their specific properties. Their use in a variety of applications such as wind turbines, aeronautical, medical equipment, transportation, and other load-bearing structures is becoming increasingly important. It is necessary for non-destructive composite examining to be robust and trustworthy in order to limit the risk of damage as well as the cost of maintenance. In order to ensure the product quality throughout its life cycle, many non-destructive examining procedures based on a wide range of concepts have been created. In this paper, nondestructive examining was used to obtain vibration measurements of composites in high-frequency regimes, which were then analysed. Both end-to-end classifications of the data and classifications of data acquired by feature engineering with modal analysis employ Support Vector Machine (SVM) to carry out damage localization in their respective applications. Finally, the findings display a large number of plates made of various materials and with defects of varying magnitudes.

articleTitle: Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Controller Based Electric Vehicle Battery Charging System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Because adequacy and frameworks have a significant influence on electric cars, the market for electric vehicles (EVs) is rapidly contracting around the world. According to the Society of Programmed Specialists, charging frameworks are in use. This billing system geography the frameworks are always being tested. The charge frameworks for information positions 1 and 2 are single-stage. The framework consists of a frequency engine, a reverberate engine, a DC/AC engine, diode ground fixes, and rectification assistance. The engine makes use of steady and consistent. With its two-way engine provided, receptive, and machine control, the third stage of charging framework uses a three-stage information system. The three testbeds are set up to envisage different kinds of accusing frameworks. demonstration by reenactment of execution frameworks.

articleTitle: Smart Mushroom Cultivation: Enhancing Growth Conditions through Sensor-Based Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Smart mushroom cultivation using remote sensing involves the integration of advanced technology to optimize the growth and productivity of mushrooms. Remote sensing techniques using arduino, sensors and cloud services are employed to monitor and manage various farming and growth related parameters in mushroom farms. Using the remote sensing of mushroom fields provides a macroscopic view of environmental conditions, helping farmers identify suitable locations for mushroom cultivation based on factors like temperature, humidity, and vegetation cover. Ground-based sensors are strategically placed within the cultivation area to measure crucial variables like temperature and humidity levels. These sensors transmit data to a central control system, allowing farmers to maintain optimal conditions for mushroom growth. Automated climate control systems can adjust parameters in response to real-time data, ensuring consistent and ideal growing conditions. This enables timely intervention, reducing crop loss and the need for chemical treatments. Furthermore, remote sensing can improve resource management. Precise water and nutrient monitoring based on sensor data can lead to more efficient resource utilization, reducing waste and operating costs. In summary, smart mushroom cultivation using remote sensing technology optimizes environmental monitoring, and resource usage. By harnessing the power of remote sensing, mushroom farmers can increase yields, reduce environmental impact, and enhance the overall sustainability and profitability of their operations.

articleTitle: Design of an efficient deep Learning Model for Segmentation and Classification of Psoriasis and Vitiligo Skin diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Skin diseases such as psoriasis and vitiligo can greatly impact a patient's quality of life. For correct diagnosis and therapy planning, it is crucial to accurately segment and classify various skin disorders. Existing segmentation & classification models for identification of skin diseases either have low efficiency or have higher complexity when used for clinical scenarios. In order to address these problems, we provide a deep learning model in this study that can automatically separate and categorize vitiligo and psoriasis skin lesions from clinical photos. The suggested model is built on a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture that has been specifically designed for use in medical image processing applications. Initially, all the collected images are augmented via scale, rotate, width shift, height shift, shear and zoom operations. In proposed approach, train the model on this augmented dataset of clinical images for psoriasis and vitiligo lesions via Transfer Learning based ResNet50 CNN, and evaluate its performance using various metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-scores. Proposed approach results show that the proposed model achieves high accuracy in both segmentation and classification tasks. The proposed deep learning model can assist dermatologists and medical professionals in accurately diagnosing and treating skin diseases, potentially leading to better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Platform for Ethnic Regional Retailers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: E-commerce, is a business model that involves buying and selling goods and services over the internet. E-commerce continues to evolve with technological advancements, shaping the future of retail and providing exciting opportunities for businesses to grow and thrive in the digital age. E-commerce continues to evolve with technological advancements, shaping the future of retail and providing exciting opportunities for businesses to grow. Regional retailers can use e-commerce to expand their reach beyond their immediate locality and tap into a broader customer base. Customer, Retailer, and E-commerce are three essential components of the modern retail ecosystem. Each plays a distinct role and interacts with the others to create a seamless shopping experience. A retailer is a business or individual that sells goods or services to customers. Customers are individuals or businesses who purchase goods or services from retailers. The success of the retail industry hinges on the synergy between customers, retailers, and e-commerce. By understanding and fulfilling customer needs, retailers can thrive in the dynamic e-commerce landscape and create a satisfying shopping journey for customers. An application has been developed to facilitate customer-regional retailer engagement that offers user-friendly features. The dataset collection phase has been done considering one of the states of India. In the current research work the challenges of app development, data privacy, and user-generated content has been discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Real Time Surveillance and Object localization System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Real-time (RT) surveillance and object localization are very important for the detection of objects and their activities. It helps society to monitor the anomalous behaviours of objects and enhance security systems. For accurate and precise detection, an effective, fast, and reliable algorithm is needed. This paper proposes a novel real-time technique of surveillance and object localization, i.e., object and location prediction. The first step is to propose a novel technique of surveillance, in which the encoder-based features are extracted and then used for the prediction of object locations and their classes. The proposed technique is trained with a standard dataset. After that, in the second step, the proposed technique is deployed on a Jetson-Nano ARM Cortex-A57 based developer board for RT implementation. The proposed methodology shows the effective results in RT with an approximate accuracy of 97% and 99% with standard datasets.

articleTitle: Loan Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Loan prediction is a significant problem in the banking industry. Using Technology, will change and make some improvements in Loan prediction by bank employees manually. By using "Machine learning "in loan prediction. The machine learning system will check the data for a loan of the applicant and the data will be checked so fast and without any human error. So, it will help to improve technology in Bank sectors. By this, processing the data will be checked quickly, making the data output in less time. It helps both the applicant and the bank employees.Machine learning algorithms can be used to analyze historical data and make accurate predictions about whether a loan application will be approved or not. In this study, we propose a machine learning-based loan prediction model that utilizes various features such as credit score, income, loan amount, and loan term. We explore different classification algorithms, including logistic regression, decision tree, and random forest, to build the loan prediction model. Our experimental results show that the random forest algorithm outperforms other models with an accuracy rate of 83.45%. The proposed model can help banks and financial institutions streamline their loan approval process, reduce manual effort, and minimize the risk of bad loans.

articleTitle: Towards a Greener Tomorrow: IoT-Enabled Smart Environment Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Integrating IoT technology into environmental monitoring systems offers solutions to contemporary sustainability challenges. This study explores IoT's potential to enhance environmental sustainability, focusing on improved air and water quality monitoring, resource-efficient precision agriculture, and waste management. It also addresses challenges such as cybersecurity risks and scalability. Ultimately, it underscores the pivotal role of IoT in advancing environmental sustainability, emphasizing the imperative of informed decision-making, use cases, and proactive measures to pave the way for a greener and healthier tomorrow.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Accident Detection and Localization Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Traffic surveillance footage requires constant monitoring in order to detect deadly accidents and to react appropriately. However, it is tiresome and mistake prone to regularly supervise them with humans. A sophisticated and quick system for detecting road accidents is urgently needed due to the rise in fatalities from accidents on the roads. After accidents, a few crucial seconds frequently makes a lot of difference. There is a need for a system that can immediately recognize emergency situations and notify the police and hospital about them. This study proposes a real-time traffic incident detection and alarm system that is based on a computer vision technique, with the goal of achieving a penetrating impact in boosting the associated demand for road traffic security and safety. The vehicle detection and tracking model first assigned a distinct serial number (ID) to each vehicle in order to detect and track the movements of the vehicles. This was done using the YOLOv3 object detector and DeepSORT tracker with region of interest interception. The mean average precision (mAP) of this model was 98.2%.

articleTitle: A Case Study on BERT models for Aspect Based Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Aspect Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) is a powerful tool to analyse a product and increase the business exponentially. The process involves classifying a sentiment to the text according to the different aspects such as positive or negative and sometimes as neutral. The deep learning algorithms (DLA) are more preferred for these tasks due to their better performance in getting more accurate and precise results as compared to the traditional machine learning algorithms used for the same tasks. The objective of this paper is to study the specific Bidirectional Encoder Representation (BERT) models used for ABSA tasks. The aim is to identify and analyse the various techniques and the architecture being used and also the challenges and issues associated with these models. An analysis is provided to summarize the recent implementation of the models and the different ABSA tasks performed by those models, the architecture and different techniques implemented with the models and the challenges and issues associated with the models.

articleTitle: AI Approaches for Pulmonary Disease Forecast
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: There is a significant risk to the healthcare system that respiratory diseases will become the leading cause of mortality globally by 2030. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) techniques intended to identify and categorize a range of respiratory ailments have drawn considerable interest from the scientific community. This comprehensive study aims to provide an overview of the most current machine learning and deep learning techniques especially developed for the identification of airway illnesses. It also forecasts future developments in this discipline by examining present problems and suggesting possible lines of inquiry. Our thorough analysis comprises 155 publications that describe various respiratory illnesses, highlighting the crucial role that machine learning methods play in forecasting certain ailments. As a result, this study outlines the challenges that now exist and the opportunities for future advancement while also highlighting the potential benefits of machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) in enhancing the efficacy of apps for diagnosing respiratory illnesses.

articleTitle: Unlocking the Potential of Machine Learning in Indian Small and Medium Enterprises (SMES) and an Examination of Outcomes in the Knowledge Management Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In recent times, the widespread adoption of digital technologies, along with the introduction of Machine Learning (ML), has presented new opportunities for organizations to improve their operational efficiency, competitiveness, and knowledge management strategies. This article examines the underutilized capacity of incorporating ML into small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in India. It further investigates the transformative effects that ML can have on the process of knowledge management. The utilization of ML technology to perform real-time data analysis empowers businesses to effectively detect and address possible threats, thereby ensuring the protection of sensitive information and financial assets. Additionally, this study provides insights into the utilization of ML in enabling personalized marketing campaigns and ongoing process enhancement. This has the potential to open up new opportunities for growth, enhance competitiveness, and improve knowledge management, hence enabling these enterprises to better navigate the dynamic and always changing business environment.

articleTitle: A preliminary study on Information Technology Startup Challenges and their Plausible Solutions from Lean-Agile Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This empirical study discusses the challenges faced by start-ups operating in the Information Technology (IT) sector. This paper proposes three objectives. First, to collate all the challenges faced by the Indian startup companies, especially in the IT sector within the Bangalore region. Second, to analyze how the startup founders tried to overcome these challenges. Third, this paper presents plausible solutions for IT-based start-ups to overcome these challenges through a Lean-Agile mindset, principles, and practices. This research also comprises information from secondary sources. A tailored SHELL methodology [1] was used to identify the start-ups' challenges in seven real-life Indian Startups. Findings reveal major challenges such as poor product/market fit, lack of customer centricity, ineffective leadership, and too many competitors. The following were cited by founders as the solutions – a) By re-inventing and moving to some other product b) Branding, delivering quality, and customer education c) Process changes and appointing a Project Manager d) By implementing an agile approach, customer involvement at each stage of the development was possible. To minimize the effect of these challenges, the primary solutions suggested in this paper were related to the use of design thinking tools during the continuous exploration phase of product development. Emphasis is also given to the Lean-Agile mindset that enables leaders or founders towards successful business outcomes.

articleTitle: A Circularly Polarized Four Port MIMO Antenna with Split Ring Metamaterial for dual band IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: MIMO (multiple-input multiple-output) antennas are widely used in numerous applications to enhance the speed of communication through high frequency signals, which are provided by MIMO antenna. Several MIMO antenna systems in recent research are focusing on ways to attain high isolation among antenna units and to reduce mutual coupling because lesser dimensions and areas are limited when organizing antennas. In this research work, a dual band circularly polarized split ring Meta MIMO antenna is designed to obtain less loss of polarization and better reliability. The presented four port MIMO antenna is applied over a dual band IoT application that resonates over dual frequencies between 2.95 GHz to 8.2 GHz. The MIMO antenna is designed on the Rogers RT DUROID 5880 substrate and uses a Microstrip feed line. Rectangle shaped defected ground structure (RDGS) is used the work to minimize antenna’s mutual coupling and cross polarization issues. The proposed model can analyze various performance metrics such as bandwidth, gain, return loss, radiation pattern, isolation, DG (Diversity Gain), TARC (Total Active Reflection Coefficient), and so on.

articleTitle: An Outline of Data Encryption Standard (DES) Tools and Its Facets within the Realm of Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The development of Discrete Event Simulation (DES) systems for enhancing decision-making and research in cloud computing has experienced a substantial growth. The growing diversity of cloud systems makes it extremely challenging to effectively manage cloud resources and services inside data centers. The increasing prevalence of Internet of Things (IoT) gadgets, smartphone apps, and cloud services, together with the introduction of concepts like Edge and Fog Computing, have made this system more complex. A significant amount of time and effort must be invested in these tasks. In intricate hyperscale computer environments, decision assistance is provided by the safe and dependable DES technology. This study aims to provide a comprehensive evaluation of DES systems made especially for cloud computing environments. The study carefully evaluates these instruments in a number of categories and is based on a thorough investigation of recent literature. This study goes beyond conventional stand-alone simulation systems by incorporating custom extensions and add-ons designed for certain cloud computing tasks. In addition to highlighting CloudSim’s increasing significance as the main platform for simulated research, this also draws attention to the lack of tools made expressly for distributed execution.

articleTitle: Mobile Application Using CNN For Skin Disease Classification with User Privacy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Skin diseases present a complex challenge for mechanical analysis due to the inherent irregularities in skin texture, varying complexions, and the presence of hair and other surface features. The need for an accurate and automated system for skin disease detection is paramount. However, the task is compounded by issues such as dataset imbalance and stringent data privacy concerns associated with medical images. In this study, we harnessed the power of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in the domain of Medical Image Analysis (MIA) to classify skin diseases. Additionally, we employed a federated learning approach to safeguard data privacy. Our results demonstrate the remarkable performance of CNNs, achieving an accuracy score of 0.90 in skin disease classification. Building upon these findings, we propose the development of a mobile application tailored for skin disease classification, leveraging CNNs and the federated learning strategy. This mobile app offers an innovative solution for skin analysis while maintaining the highest data security and privacy standards. In conclusion, our research underscores the potential of CNNs and federated learning in the realm of skin disease classification. We introduce a promising path for the creation of an efficient mobile application for skin disease diagnosis, meeting the rigorous demands of modern medical data handling and analysis without compromising data security or privacy.

articleTitle: Disease Diagnosis and Diet Plan Recommendation using KNN model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Healthcare is essential for every individual in order to maintain a healthy and peaceful life. However, it is very difficult to have a doctor’s consultation for every small health issue. So rather than consulting the doctor every time, it is better to use a medical chatbot for healthcare purposes for predicting the disease and for having the awareness of very basic details of the disease before the doctor’s consultation. It not only reduces the cost of the consultation but also improves the medical knowledge of the user by means of a chatbot. The chatbot is a computer program which uses natural language to interact with the users and uses NLP techniques to identify the symptoms provided by the users. The proposed system uses the KNN model to predict the most probable diseases. It diagnoses the disease using the symptoms provided by the user which is taken as input. It also gives the list of most probable diseases and their probabilities based on the user-selected number of probable diseases he wants to know. Later on, it also provides a diet plan to the users based on their answers in order to control the disease up to some extent.

articleTitle: Sign Language Detection Using CNN-YOLOv8l
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sign language is commonly used by speech and hearing-disabled people as a way of exchanging thoughts, emotions, feelings, and needs. There are multiple sign languages used all around the globe. Understanding sign language can be a difficult task for a normal person. At present, speech and hearing-disabled people rely on human translators to make this task easier, but it is not always feasible to have a human translator. Multiple sign language detection models were proposed in the current time, but they are mostly based on old object detection techniques, thus making them slower to detect and less accurate. The objective of the present work is to design and implement a model which detects real-time sign language using deep learning. The proposed system uses a YOLOv8 model to train the dataset. A deep learning neural network is like the human brain which uses a combination of different factors like inputs, weights, and biases to do different tasks, such as identifying and classifying objects. Deep learning algorithms perform better when they are trained with a large amount of data. The performance of the proposed model has been evaluated based on accuracy, precision, and recall. The dataset consists of Indian sign Language having9991 images of 26 alphabets and 9 numeric digits. The proposed model shows a training accuracy of 98.9% for 20 epochs of training.

articleTitle: Wireless Liberty: Sensors Measuring Pressure and Temperature
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The continuous collection of physiological data, especially temperature and pressure, throughout the human body, using wireless, skin-adherent detectors based on NFC (near-field communication) technology, is presented in this research study. To better understand human health, forecast illnesses, and avoid problems like pressure ulcers, the article stresses the significance of monitoring skin temperature as well as pressure in diverse anatomical locations. This study proposes a novel NFC-based method for continuous physiological monitoring. It provides hitherto unattainable tracking capabilities for pressure and temperature throughout the human body and has the potential to significantly enhance healthcare results. In order to increase the radius and sensitivities of these sensors, future research will examine enlarged clinical investigations and developments in wireless technology.

articleTitle: Text Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Natural language processing model performance and generalization are greatly enhanced by text data augmentation. This paper introduces nlpaug, a Python library that provides a wide range of text data augmentation techniques. nlpaug offers functionalities for tasks such as synonym replacement, word insertion, word deletion, character-level modifications, and sentence shuffling. We present an overview of the nlpaug library, including its features and capabilities, and discuss the advantages of using nlpaug for text data augmentation. Through experimental evaluation, we demonstrate the effectiveness of nlpaug in enhancing model performance and its versatility in different NLP tasks. The paper concludes by highlighting the potential applications and future directions of text data augmentation using nlpaug.

articleTitle: Design of a Compact Hexagonal Wideband Antenna for Modern WiMAX, Wi-Fi, and IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study converses, a compact wideband microstrip line-fed patch antenna for various Wi-Fi, WiMAX, and various IoT applications. The dimensions of the proposed antenna are 30×30×0.762mm3. A partial ground with multiple slots is present to enhance the results and FR4 epoxy with dielectric constant, 4.4 is used as the substrate material. The impact of variations in the dimensions of the center ellipse of the patch, circular slots of the patch, width of partial ground, slots in the partial ground, and the rectangular slot etched to the feedline of the antenna, have been investigated. The simulated wide bandwidth of the devised structure ranges from 2.9 GHz to 5.5 GHz with a reflection coefficient below -10dB. The peak gain for the antenna is 7dBi (simulated) and the maximum radiation efficiency is 95.8%.

articleTitle: Estimating the Future Demand for Manufacturing Goods Using Time Series Forecasting Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In day-to-day increasing demand of products, forecasting plays an important role. The forecasting is not only limiting the application to forecast the future demand but also used for other applications such as economical returns, weather prediction etc. The forecasting method converts the raw data into useful predictions by undergoing through serios of steps for systematically evaluation. It encompasses both the qualitative as well as quantitative methods to provide the tailor-made solutions to the specific context and the available data. The present study briefed the forecasting concept and also discussed the various facts and facets associated to forecasting process. The time-series analysis method is used to predict the future demand. The week-wise data for two consecutive years was gathered and then processed through time-series analysis. In addition, the regression equation was also estimated for predicting the future demand. The forecast accuracy was also studied through the estimation of R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value which is app. 0.99 gives the model-fit analysis.

articleTitle: Embedded Cognition in Virtual Environments: An Ecological Approach to AI Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In order to investigate artificial intelligence (AI) over the long run and scale it up, this research article suggests using virtual reincarnation in video games. By using the realistic and engaging features of virtual worlds, it is intended to create AI systems they may comprehend and reason at a level comparable to that of human beings. The study makes the case that conventional methods of AI, which concentrate on single-sense jobs, are constrained in their capacity to produce all-encompassing intelligence. Virtual the incarnation, on the other hand, enables multi-modal learning as well as progressive evolution, offering an infrastructure for moral white box experimentation and the investigation of intricate moral dilemmas in AI. The research emphasizes the significance of ground semantic in virtual vision and the need for more sophisticated and interactive game experiences.

articleTitle: Leveraging Blockchain Technology and Knowledge Management for Enhancing Sustainable Organizational Performance in India
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This paper examines the possible synergies that can be achieved by combining blockchain technology and knowledge management to improve the sustainable performance of organizations in the Indian environment. In light of the urgent environmental and sociological concerns confronting the global community, it is imperative for companies to engage in adaptive and innovative practices in order to ensure their sustained viability in the long run. Blockchain technology, renowned for its inherent qualities of immutability and transparency in maintaining ledgers, exhibits potential in promoting sustainability through the augmentation of transparency, traceability, and trust in diverse corporate operations. Simultaneously, knowledge management assumes a crucial role in easing the acquisition, dissemination, and utilization of key insights inside a company. In the context of India, a nation experiencing fast economic growth and facing distinct sustainability issues, the adoption of this dual approach has significant significance. Sustainable organizational performance involves a broad range of factors, such as the mitigation of carbon emissions, the responsible management of resources, and active participation with the community. The utilization of blockchain technology has the potential to play a crucial role in attaining these goals by revolutionizing the management of supply chains, streamlining operations through the implementation of intelligent contracts, and ensuring the protection of confidential information through encryption and stringent access controls. This statement underscores the significance of quantifying and overseeing success by means of key performance indicators (KPIs) and advocates for involving stakeholders to foster trust and transparency. It highlights the imperative of ongoing enhancement and assimilation of global exemplars and empirical analyses. The amalgamation of blockchain technology and information management presents a promising avenue for Indian enterprises to augment sustainability efforts, as well as fortify operational efficiency and competitiveness. It calls for a strategic, data-driven, and collaborative approach to address the unique sustainability challenges and opportunities in the Indian context.

articleTitle: Survey on Machine Learning Techniques Used for Central Serous Retinopathy Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Central Serous Retinopathy (CSR) is an important health concern affecting millions of people worldwide, leading to vision loss and blindness. This condition is identified by abnormalities in retinal layers and fluid leakage, frequently occurring in the vicinity of the macula. The disease generates pressure inside the retinal layers, resulting in the detachment of retinal walls and subsequently causing impaired vision. As the macula is home to most of the visual sensory organs, including rods and cones, the eyesight undergoes substantial effects. Thus, early detection of CSR permits preventive actions to be taken to avoid any eye damage. While numerous physical approaches for detecting CSR have been devised previously, they have demonstrated inaccuracies and a lack of reliability. This paper examines the different algorithms, imaging modalities, and the outcomes they yield that have been devised over time for the timely detection of CSR. The research reveals that the SVM classifier has achieved a 97% accuracy rate in recognizing central serous retinopathy ailment based on OCT images.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach to Forest Fire Detection and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Forest fires pose a significant threat to sensitive ecosystems worldwide. Early detection and monitoring of these fires are critical for improving response times and aiding firefighting and evacuation efforts. This research paper proposes an approach that utilizes Convolutional neural network (CNN) based transfer learning models in conjunction with drone-derived images to accurately detect and differentiate between fire and nonfire images. This automated system enhances the efficiency of forest patrols and rapid-fire detection without human intervention. Pre-trained CNNs, including MobileNetV2, ResNet50, Xception, and VGG16, were fine-tuned using a dataset containing forest fire and nonfire images. A sigmoid classifier in the classification layer predicts the probability of an image being a fire or nonfire. Experimental results demonstrate the models' ability to identify fires across various scenarios with competitive processing times, making them highly deployable in forest settings.

articleTitle: Enhancing Public Safety with AI-Powered Intelligent Surveillance: An Examination of Immediate Incident Detection and Rapid Response in Urban Settings
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This study describes a comprehensive smart surveillance system that integrates algorithms for face recognition, facial expression detection, and behavioral analysis. The technology improves on traditional surveillance by offering real-time insights into individual characteristics and activities. Deep learning, especially convolutional neural networks (CNNs), is used for robust face identification even under difficult settings. Furthermore, it uses machine learning, such as deep neural networks, to classify emotional expressions, providing insights into people's moods. The behavioral analysis module of the system detects suspicious activities and abnormalities using computer vision methods such as optical flow and action recognition models that have been trained on a large dataset of annotated behaviors. These components work together to form a single framework for real-time monitoring and analysis of persons in the surveillance region. The system excels in properly recognizing faces, recognizing emotions, and detecting suspicious activities, resulting in increased security and efficiency in surveillance applications.

articleTitle: Latency Minimization in 5G Network Backhaul Links Using Chaotic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the realm of 5G wireless networks, achieving ultra-low latency is of paramount importance to support real-time applications and services. A critical factor influencing overall network latency is the backhaul links connecting remote base stations to the core network. This research delves into the application of chaotic algorithms for latency minimization in 5G network backhaul links. Chaotic algorithms, known for their sensitivity to initial conditions, offer a unique approach to optimizing network performance. By harnessing the inherent randomness and deterministic chaos, these algorithms can effectively explore the solution space for optimal routing and resource allocation. Through comprehensive simulations and performance evaluations, this study demonstrates the potential of chaotic algorithms to significantly reduce latency in 5G backhaul networks. The results underscore the viability of utilizing chaos- inspired techniques to address latency concerns, opening new avenues for enhancing the overall efficiency of 5G networks.

articleTitle: A High Accuracy Deep Learning and Iot Network for Pest Detection Using Analysis of The Pest Sound in Large Agriculture Area
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The significance of agriculture in ensuring human survival in the contemporary day necessitates enhancing crop yields. Pest infestations have the potential to cause harm or hinder the growth of crops, hence exerting a negative impact on agricultural productivity. Therefore, it is imperative to initiate agricultural pest identification and management measures promptly. Pest surveillance poses significant hazards, requires extensive physical effort, and is labor-intensive. The combination of emerging AI and IoT technologies has the reliability of pest identification in agriculture. These advancements enable autonomous control of maintenance chores, leading to improved outcomes in pest management. The present work introduces an innovative technique for the real-time identification of pests by leveraging the IoT and DL algorithms. The pest identification technique DConvNet was trained using pest audio sound, preprocessed by Planck-taper filter, DPSS approach, non-overlap-add method, and features extracted by LPCC and GMM methods. This study illuminates the aspirations of the IoT and AI in pest monitoring in agricultural settings, with the benefit of minimizing the need for human involvement to maintain constant vigilance. The DConvNet system demonstrated high accuracy in automating pest identification, as evidenced by extensive agricultural field experiences. The proposed model achieved superior performance compared to KNN, ANN, VGG-16, and EfficientNet B3 in the task of pest detection, achieving an accuracy of 99.72%, recall (99.78%), and F1 score (99.86%).

articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning Techniques to Estimate Airline Ticket Pricing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Frequent travelers often have the ability to predict the optimal time to purchase airline tickets in order to secure the best price. In order to maximize revenue, airlines frequently adjust their ticket pricing, which may result in higher prices during periods of high demand. To determine the airfare for a given route, data was collected over a specific period of time, which included various parameters such as flight schedules, airlines, and other relevant factors. Machine learning models were then employed to extract useful features from this data. Understanding the drivers of airfare price fluctuations is crucial in developing a mechanism that assists consumers and revenue management systems in making informed decisions about ticket purchases, considering the influence of various distinct factors on the cost of a plane ticket. The study aims to identify these key factors and their connection to price changes. By incorporating various powerful machine learning techniques such as Random Forest Regressor, Decision Tree Regressor, Linear Regression, and KNeighbors Regressor, Extra Trees Regressor, Bagging Regressor, this study aims to build a highly reliable and accurate flight fare prediction model that can efficiently handle diverse types of data, thus contributing to the advancement of more efficient and dependable airline ticket pricing systems.

articleTitle: Object Detection in Medical Diagnosis of Cows Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cattle farming is vital for global agriculture, supplying essentials like milk and meat. For both economic and animal welfare considerations, cow health is crucial. To diagnose cow health, this study uses cutting-edge deep learning methods including CNNs with Transfer Learning, Data Augmentation, Image Data Generator, and the Adam Optimizer. A variety of high-resolution cow picture were gathered for datasets and employ augmentation for generalization. Pre-trained CNNs are modified by transfer learning to identify a variety of diseases, such as Infectious Bovine Keratoconjunctivitis, Ringworm, Lumpy Disease, and Foot and Mouth Disease. The Adam optimizer speeds up model training, while the Image Data Generator effectively preprocesses data. Results show precise detection of cow ailments, showing the promise of deep learning in veterinary medicine. This research paper paves the way for useful, affordable automated methods for early cow health identification, which will help farmers and proponents of animal welfare. Overall, it shows the promise of deep learning in veterinary medicine for improved cow health and production throughout the world.

articleTitle: Real Time Video Object Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The review of "Real-Time Video Object Detection using Deep Learning" provides an extensive analysis of the state-of-the-art in deep learning-powered real-time video object recognition systems. It examines the development of object identification models, stressing significant improvements in model accuracy, efficiency, and architecture design. It thoroughly investigates the most recent approaches and strategies for real-time video object detection. YOLO, Faster R-CNN, and SSD are just a few of the well-known deep learning models that are examined in this article to highlight their advantages and disadvantages in the context of real-time video analysis. It also explores the fundamental issues and most recent developments that have enabled deep learning to completely transform real-time object detection. Furthermore, this review broadens its scope to include additional noteworthy designs, such MobileNetV2 and Efficient D4, in recognition of the increasing demand for precise and effective real-time video analysis across applications like augmented reality, autonomous driving, and surveillance. This review provides a thorough evaluation of these models' capabilities by looking at their underlying theories and technological foundations, evaluating how well they perform on benchmark datasets, and considering metrics like speed, accuracy, and memory efficiency. It is noteworthy that this study employs and compares current models for real-time video object detection, making it a valuable resource for researchers, practitioners, and enthusiasts alike. This comprehensive analysis offers guidance for upcoming advancements in this quickly developing subject in addition to insights into the state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Honeypot Networks in Deception Technology for IOT Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In this Digitized world, everyone is looking up for options for which there is no need to go out and perform some specific tasks such as Shopping, transferring money, etc. With all these advantages the problem which has been raised is of Cybercrimes with which everyone is scared of these days. Cybercrimes may occur due to the viruses which can enter into devices using insecure websites and can eventually lead us towards being a victim of cybercrime. In this chapter, the Honeypot Networks and frameworks in deception technology for IoT devices has been discussed. Since IoT has taken over every single device in the market and so the risk associated with them is also higher as compared to any other end device. Some novel and enhanced traps are used to engage the hackers for a longer duration and keeping all the essential data secured. The prime constituents of data captured and data control in honeypot has expatriated and presents a categorization for honeypot as per the targets specified. The technical progress and security contribution of nowadays production and research honeypots will be reviewed. This paper highlights the scenarios of the virtualization and integration of upcoming Honeypots and sees how the fusion of Honeypot networks in Cyber security will be helpful for the better tomorrow.

articleTitle: LPS-ML: Loan Prediction System using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the banking industry, banks offer various products, but the main source of their revenue comes from the interest earned on the loans they provide. Consequently, their profitability is closely tied to the timely repayment of these loans by their customers and the occurrence of loan defaults. Predicting potential loan defaulters is crucial for banks to minimize their non-performing assets and maintain a profitable operation. The most important aspect is addressing the risks associated with each approved sanctioned application. Loan prediction is one of the most significant and well-known research areas in the fields of banking and insurance. Analyzing patterns within sample datasets is of utmost importance in today's landscape. With the shift towards Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning (ML) in the financial sector, many banks along with financial institutions are enhancing their business models by leveraging cutting-edge ML algorithms and advanced big data analytics technologies. This study includes the implementation of ML models on a publicly available dataset (for loan prediction) that evaluates critical risk factors to facilitate the decision process for loan sanctions based on an individual’s relevant characteristics. The performance of the presented method was assessed using several performance criteria, with SVM being the most suited-algorithm.

articleTitle: Fostering Smart Agriculture: Using Vision-Based AI for Livestock Managing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The swine industry constitutes a significant segment within livestock farming. However, conventional methods employed for monitoring pig health and welfare are laborious and time-intensive. Relying on these traditional monitoring techniques becomes increasingly taxing for both pigs and farmers, particularly in the face of the expanding scale of hog farming. This stress, in turn, impacts pig welfare and overall economic productivity. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a fundamental component in the realm of intelligent pig farming. Advanced pig farming systems leverage AI integration to continuously monitor biometric data encompassing pig vocalizations and behavior. This data, acquired through sensors such as cameras and RF ID devices, is transformed into pivotal indicators of pig health and welfare. Analyzing these essential variables enables the early identification of health issues affecting pigs, facilitating prompt interventions and treatments that significantly enhance production efficiency and financial outcomes in pig farming. This paper presents a comprehensive overview, highlighting the challenges and opportunities within precision pig husbandry. The fusion of AI technologies with traditional farming practices presents novel prospects and hurdles, shaping the landscape of modern pig farming. Through this evaluation, the paper aims to underscore the transformative potential and the evolving landscape of precision-based pig farming.

articleTitle: To Study Traffic Behaviors for Detecting Unusual Activities by Analyzing HTTP Packets
