publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cloud computing refers to the on-demand resource utilization, storage capability, and networking solutions over the Internet. Although, cloud computing is one of the critical mechanisms that provide the online storage solution with a subscription to the cloud environment. However, there are several security, privacy, and data breach issues with cloud computing. Network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) play a vital role in identifying and mitigating potential security threats. Traditional NIDS are not sufficient for complex and dynamic cloud problems, particularly with the widespread use of Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) as a primary communication protocol. This article proposes a behavioral intrusion detection system based on machine learning techniques to identify attacks by analyzing the HTTP traffic. The system is designed to monitor and analyze network traffic, specifically focusing on HTTP-based communications, to detect and prevent various types of network intrusions. The proposed NIDS employs a combination of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms to handle the diverse nature of cloud-based network traffic. To enhance the accuracy and efficiency of the NIDS, feature engineering techniques are applied to extract relevant features from HTTP network traffic, including packet payload analysis, header inspection, and traffic flow characteristics. The results demonstrate that the system achieves high detection accuracy while maintaining low false-positive rates, showcasing its potential as a reliable and efficient solution for securing cloud-based networks.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Health Data: An Application of High Utility Itemset Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A data science endeavour called "high utility pattern mining" entails finding important patterns based on different factors like profit, frequency, and weight. High utility itemsets are among the various patterns that have undergone thorough study. These itemsets must exceed a minimum threshold specified by the user. This is particularly useful in practical applications like retail marketing and web services, where items have diverse characteristics. High-utility itemset mining facilitates decision- making by uncovering patterns that have a significant impact. Unlike frequent itemset mining, which identifies commonly oc- curring itemsets, high-utility itemsets often include rare items in real-world applications. Considering the application to the medical field, data mining has been employed in various ways. In this context, the primary method involves analyzing a health dataset that spans from 2014 to 2017 in the United States. The dataset includes categories such as diseases, states, and deaths. By examining these categories and mortality rates, we can derive high-utility itemsets that reveal the causes of the most deaths. In conclusion, high-utility pattern mining is a data science activity that concentrates on spotting significant patterns based on objective standards. It has proven valuable in various fields, including the medical domain, where analyzing datasets can uncover high-utility itemsets related to mortality rates and causes of death.Categories and Subject Descriptors - [Health Database Applica- tion] Data Mining

articleTitle: Analysing Role of Databases in COVID-19 Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Numerous individual have perished as a consequence of the COVID-19 pandemic, which has also had devastating effects on the globe’s social, cultural, economic, and wellness domains. Managing a pandemic requires thorough understanding of its characteristics and behaviour, which may be learned by collecting and assessing pertinent data. Correct data availability is critical for gaining the knowledge needed to make choices and take preventative actions. As a result, this work highlights the importance of data in the field of COVID-19. Approaches used to collect the data of this pandemic are presented in this study. Furthermore, this paper highlights the challenges posed while collecting COVID-19 data. Also, various biomedical information databases available are presented.

articleTitle: Beyond The Internet of Things: Imagining IoT's Structure and Potential Routes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: wireless sensor system technology has made it possible for ubiquitous sensing, which affects many aspects of contemporary life. Indicators of environmental health, from sensitive ecologies as well as biodiversity to urban settings, may now be measured, inferred, and understood. The Internet of Things is enabled by the extensive utilization of these devices in a network that facilitates communication and action. In this network, the actuators and sensors smoothly interact with our environment as data is exchanged across platforms to provide a unified operational view. Near field communication (NFC) is the upcoming technology that will enable the transformation of the worldwide web into a fully integrated Future Internet. This technology is being advanced through the adoption of variousenabling device methods, such as tags, audience members, encased sense and actuators nodes, and nodes for near field interaction. The demand for data-on-demand, using complex and straightforward queries, increases significantly as studies transition from web to web2 to web3. This study presents a cloud-centric vision for the worldwideimplementation of the Internet of Things. The future of IoT research is expected to be influenced by many significant technology enablers and their corresponding application domains, which are emphasized. A cloud architecture based on the interplay of public as well as private clouds and employing Aneka is shown. Study conducted elaborate on the need of unity, the global web, and distributed processing in our last section of our IoT vision for the community of technical researchers.

articleTitle: Analysis and Implementation of DDOS Attacks and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks remain a pervasive threat in the digital landscape, continually challenging organizations worldwide. Our study employs the Slow Loris method, characterized by its low-bandwidth ‘low and slow’ approach, effectively mimicking normal traffic patterns when targeting servers. This technique offers a unique perspective, distinguishing it from the more bandwidth-intensive reflection-based DDoS attacks. Our comprehensive analysis, guided by the FAIR methodology, unveils a troubling trend. DDoS attacks are increasing in size, frequency, and complexity. To address this escalating threat, we explore a wide range of defense strategies, including both on-premises solutions like Arbor APS and cloud-based options such as Arbor Cloud. Our research underscores the effectiveness of a multifaceted approach that combines on-premises and cloud-based solutions, significantly reducing risk and loss exposure. Furthermore, our study underscores the critical importance of adopting a proactive approach in dealing with cybersecurity threats. Emphasis is placed on the significance of confidentiality, robust security measures, and the use of encrypted communication channels to thwart DDoS attacks. As part of our comprehensive approach, we present a compelling business case for DDoS attack protection, highlighting the substantial benefits of employing a layered security approach, which yields an impressive return on investment of approximately 150%.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security of Cloud Computing Transaction using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cloud computing has revolutionized the way businesses and individuals access and manage data and services. However, it has also introduced new security challenges, particularly in the context of transactional integrity and data privacy. This paper explores the combination of blockchain technology as an original tactic to enhance the security of cloud computing transactions. Blockchain, known for its distributed and unchallengeable ledger, offers a promising solution to address the vulnerabilities associated with centralized cloud systems. In this research, we also investigate the potential benefits of leveraging blockchain to secure cloud transactions, focusing on key aspects such as data integrity, authentication, and confidentiality. Through a wide-ranging analysis of prevailing literature and real-world use cases, we analyze the assets and boundaries of combining blockchain and cloud computing. We also propose a conceptual framework for integrating blockchain into cloud transactions, outlining the architecture, consensus mechanisms, and smart contracts to ensure secure and verifiable interactions. Furthermore, we examine the potential impact of this integration on various industry sectors, including finance, healthcare, and supply chain management, where secure and transparent transactions are paramount. We also discuss the challenges and adoption barriers that organizations may encounter when implementing blockchain-enhanced cloud security. Ultimately, this paper highlights the potential of blockchain technology to boost the safety and trustworthiness of cloud computing transactions, providing a foundation for further research and practical implementations in an increasingly interconnected and data-driven world.

articleTitle: Mapping Smart Vertical Farming in Cultivation of Herbaceous Medicinal Plants using Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Food security is an important domain that is having an increased demand in the modern era of urbanization and modernization. With an increased population shifting to urban areas, deforestation and eradication of arable land are growing at an uncontrollable pace, globally. Scarcity of land, water, and other diminishing natural resources are the results of the soaring shift of population to urban areas. Lack of manpower and the demolishing availabilities of agricultural resources add to the negative effect on traditional agricultural methods and thereby, food production. Consequently, the degradation of the health of the urban habitats is caused. The cultivation of medicinal plants is thus another upcoming agricultural concern arising in many countries worldwide. Harsh and extreme weather conditions and arid lands make traditional farming even more difficult in some parts of the world which in turn causes an exacerbation of the food gap. Thus, sustainable, intelligent, and feasible solutions to enhance the qualitative and quantitative production of medicinal plants are the need of the hour. Greenhouses came up as a solution to combat the issues and facilitate qualitative and quantitative crop productivity but real-time issues occur while controlling and monitoring its microclimate while growers focus on cultivating the optimal growth of the herbaceous plants. The authors of this research work performed a multi-dimensional systematic survey on the interference of smart precision farming methods on the cultivation of various herbaceous medicinal plants.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Probable Measures for Addressing Security Limitations in Internet of Drones
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The Internet of Drones (IoD) has garnered significant interest in recent years due to its portable and automated nature and is being utilized across various domains such as the military, search and rescue operations, and entertainment. However, due to the inherently unsecured radio transmission paths in the Internet of Drones (IoD), there are numerous security concerns associated with the data collected, generated, or processed by drones. This paper aims to address the prominent challenges of security and privacy in the IoD. It undertakes a thorough examination of security concerns and corresponding solutions for IoD security. The discussion encompasses the security requirements associated with IoD and highlights the most recent advancements in research pertaining to IoD security. Authentication methods and Blockchain-based schemes are highlighted in this overview of numerous significant security technologies. Through an extensive analysis, we hereby present an examination of the challenges encountered by existing methodologies and propose potential avenues for future research in the field of IoT security. This review highlights the necessity of implementing suitable security measures to tackle IoT security concerns. Furthermore, it emphasizes the importance of developing security solutions that carefully consider the trade-off among the level of security provided and the cost efficiency of implementation.

articleTitle: A Logistic Regression Approach for Detecting Phishing Websites
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Phishing remains a pervasive threat in the online landscape, challenging internet users' security. This study conducted a Systematic Literature Review (SLR), analyzing 80 articles to understand anti-phishing strategies. Spear phishing, email spoofing, email manipulation, and voice phishing were identified as common techniques. Machine learning emerged as a promising solution for combating phishing attacks.The research focuses on using Logistic Regression and Multinomial Naïve Bayes algorithms for phishing detection. Logistic Regression demonstrated superior accuracy at 96.3%, surpassing Multinomial Naïve Bayes by 1%. Ensemble learning, weighted soft voting, and Kappa statistics were employed to enhance classification, achieving 96.3% accuracy. This work underscores the effectiveness of ensemble learning in phishing detection, suggesting its potential to bolster internet security. Future research directions include exploring various phishing methods and anti-phishing measures for enhanced protection.

articleTitle: CallerId Application Design using Amazon Web Services
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A phone number is a personal unique number which can identify its owner. Personal information can be exploited through a person’s phone number. Many methods such as phishing and spam attacks have been used to exploit a person’s personal information. Nowadays, a phone number has many linked important information such as bank accounts, and passwords which make it more vulnerable to attacks. The growing demand for accessibility and connectivity is creating demand for an efficient solution. Hence, a caller identification app which can identify caller ID and spam protection of the incoming call or SMS is required. It protects users from attending unwanted calls and messages. In this work, the design and working of a caller identification app using AWS services is explored. Many researchers have conducted studies and surveys to identify the process of caller identification and develop caller identification methods and have published their research about the same. Most of these methods are conventional. What makes the proposed model novel, is that it uses a cloud-based new age model with complete backend design to develop a strong caller identification application with its roots in the AWS cloud. Though other models have been successful, this model is better because of the benefits provided by the cloud, which include high availability, scalability, elasticity, security, and cost-friendliness.

articleTitle: Latency Reduction in mmWave VLSI Circuits through Gravitational Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research focuses on addressing latency issues in millimeter-wave (mmWave) Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) circuits by introducing a novel approach called Gravitational Learning. The mmWave frequency range offers high data rates but poses challenges due to increased latency. Conventional techniques have limitations in reducing latency while maintaining circuit performance. In this study, we propose a gravitational learning-based method that optimizes the circuit layout and parameters to minimize latency. By simulating the gravitational interactions between circuit components, the proposed approach effectively explores the design space and identifies configurations that lead to reduced latency. Our experimental results demonstrate significant latency reduction compared to existing techniques, highlighting the potential of gravitational learning in enhancing the performance of mmWave VLSI circuits.

articleTitle: Demystifying Fake News Detection Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The developing subject of study known as fake news has piqued the curiosity of both academics and media practitioners. Fake news has become more prevalent in the digital age, highlighting how long-standing institutional safeguards against false information are undermined. Governmental organizations use social media to distribute critical information through their verified Facebook profiles, and official Twitter handles, as the information reaches many people quickly. However, a variety of deceptive practices, such as propaganda and rumors, have the potential to trick consumers on a regular basis. During COVID, fake news and rumors were particularly prevalent and easily disseminated, which caused confusion in those trying times. Therefore, given the current times, there is a dire need for applications to detect fake news. This paper reviews recent studies on various methods for spotting fake news on the Internet. It covers traditional techniques and cutting-edge innovations employing machine learning methods, mobile apps and websites for identifying bogus news. This review paper provides a comprehensive study by giving directions towards future research prospects to the researchers studying in this field of study.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition in the Wild using Artificial Rabbits Optimizer based Residual Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In affective computing, emotion acknowledgement in the wild is a much-studied area. Although there have been advancements, the difficulty of emotion acknowledgement in the wild due to head movement, face deformation, illumination fluctuation, etc. remains an open subject. To improve the model's simplification ability and, by extension, its performance across a variety of learning tasks, it is crucial that a wide variety of features be extracted by the deep neural network. Interest in facial expression detection in natural settings has grown in recent years despite the difficulty of obtaining discriminative and informative characteristics from partially obscured photos. In the first stage of this paper's pre-processing, the noisy pictures are enhanced by Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). After that, Residual Neural Network (ResNet) features extraction is used, and the same method serves as an emotion classifier. An iterative technique called stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is utilized to refine the ResNet model's objective function. Finally, the Artificial Rabbits Optimization Algorithm (ARO) is used to choose the best value for, thereby enhancing the reliability of the categorization. The suggested method is effective, as evidenced by experimental findings on three popular facial expression recognition in-the-wild datasets: AffectNet, AFEW Dataset, and RAF-DB, where it accomplishes state-of-the-art presentation with 96% accuracy and improves upon existing models by roughly 5% to 8%.

articleTitle: Effective Co-Operation in Edge-Cloud Computation Networking
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: To improve the performance of mobile devices, both the edge of the network and the cloud provide computing services. While the cloud can manage large processing needs, the edge can minimize latency by offering local computing services. Their cooperation is essential for edge-cloud computational business models since it increases the usage of computing resources and assures Quality of Service (QoS). To facilitate resource sharing between the network's edge and the cloud, this study proposes an effective architecture for mobility edge-cloud computing networks. It uses wholesale and buyback techniques. Study conducted design resource management issues for edge servers to manage wholesale and buyback agreements and for cloud services to establish wholesale rates and distribute local computing resources in order to maximize this sharing process. From the perspectives of both optimizing societal welfare and maximizing profitability in both the perimeter and the cloud, study conducted approach these issues. Study conducted illustrate the concavity of the social welfare for i) and suggest an ideal cloud resource management approach to maximize it. Study conducted first develop the conical shape of wholesale computing power with respect to the wholesale rate for option ii), given the difficulty of directly demonstrating the conical shape of the key issue. Study conducted then create an optimal pricing while computing administration approach for maximizing the resulting profits. According to numerical analyses, maximizing overall profit is consistent with promoting societal welfare, whereas maximizing individual earnings is achieved through maximizing pricing using cloud computing resource management.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Board Prediction Using Ensemble Model of YOLOv8 And Detectron2
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Road safety is greatly enhanced and smart decision-making for self-driving cars and intelligent modes of transportation is made possible by the detection and classification of traffic signs. In order to attain cutting-edge performance, this study suggests an ensemble model for traffic sign board prediction that combines YOLOv8 with Detectron2. While Detectron2 offers accurate object boundaries using instance segmentation, YOLOv8 is renowned for its quickness and precision in object identification. The ensemble technique improves the overall accuracy and resilience of the traffic sign board prediction system by taking advantage of the complimentary characteristics of both models. Benchmark datasets like the Belgian Traffic Sign Dataset and the German Traffic Sign Recognition Benchmark are the subject of extensive experiments. The YOLOv8 and Detectron2 individual models are outperformed by the ensemble model about of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. In addition, the ensemble model performs better in difficult settings like occlusions and various lighting levels. The results demonstrate the efficiency of ensemble models for traffic sign board prediction as well as their potential to improve both intelligent transportation systems and road safety.

articleTitle: An Optimized Resnet based Plant Disease Identification using Deep Learning Hypothetic Function
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Since the world is pragmatically changing with the deep learning approaches one such research is trending in the field of apple plant disease identification, whose adoption in developing nations may be challenging as a very few investigations done on apple cultivation which is very crucial fruit which to be explored in this research. Starting with the images captured with the sufficient resolutions is typically used for training existing deep learning models. However, models that would work effectively even with low-resolution data are required for developing nations with sparse internet access. The created models are quite large in number which results the majority of deep learning-based apps are accessible online. Unfortunately, such larger models required large memory requirements which are becoming a new problem. Therefore, smaller-sized models being recommended. In this paper, plant disease diagnosis using low-resolution data is accomplished using an existing deep learning model called Resnet. Deep convolution neural networks (DCNN), which are frequently used for image data, are the subject of the main attention. Concatenated residual networks, skip connections, and a novel DCNN architecture are utilized for the accurate results. by vanishing gradient with training parameters and making the with the hypothetical function. The study focused to treat the apple disease identification whose data collected from kaggle wherein the images consists of 10 classes and 5 classes of diseases that are frequently seen in Dhaka, Bangladesh, as well as a healthy class, are also used to assess the performance of the Plant Village dataset. Our proposed resnet 38 with the tuning hypothetical function justifies the significance of the overall approach whith the accuracy of 99.62% that is better than the cited DCNN networks.

articleTitle: Cloud Process Optimization: A Hybrid GA-PSO Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Within the realm of computing in clouds, optimising cloud operations is a major problem, especially when it comes to striking a balance between resource utilisation and effective completion of tasks that is regulated by complex mutual dependence. In the study article "clouds Service Optimisation: A Hybrid GA-PSO The technique," a combination of approaches to efficient task assignment to services is presented. This approach is designed to reduce runtimes, reduce expenses in cloud settings, and reorganise the allocation of the load of interrelated duties across various resources. The hybrid technique that combines PSO and GA shows impressive performance in terms of shorter completion times and lower costs for execution in comparison to other current technologies. It is noteworthy because it greatly maximises the distribution of tasks across available resources, resulting in an important rise in resource utilisation. Experimental results empirically validate the effectiveness of the GAPSO algorithms and demonstrate its advantage over earlier computer approaches. Compared to traditional approaches, the algorithm shows greater convergence to optimum outcomes while retaining superior quality. This highlights the hybrid approach’s effectiveness and productivity and establishes it as a strong contender for resolving the internet of things paradigm problems with work distribution, resource optimisation, and cost containment.

articleTitle: Hybrid Models for PCOS Prediction using Machine Learning Algorithms to Address Class Imbalance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: PCOS is a significant reproductive syndrome that is prevalent among women globally. It is distinguished by hormonal imbalances, specifically an excess of male hormones and elevated androgen levels, which disrupt normal ovulation and lead to various complications such as infertility, miscarriage, and pregnancy-related issues. Furthermore, individuals with PCOS have a higher likelihood of experiencing insulin resistance and being susceptible to the onset of type 2 diabetes.This study aims to address the challenges that are associated with identifying and classifying instances of PCOS. By balancing the dataset using SMOTE and employing machine learning methods such as Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and AdaBoost the research aims to improve PCOS identification accuracy. Correlation analysis and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) will be employed for individual algorithm. By incorporating both correlation analysis and PCA for individual algorithm, the hybrid model aims to improve the accuracy and effectiveness of PCOS identification. In this study, among the classification algorithms used, Logistic Regression emerged as the most effective model compared with other models for PCOS identification, achieving an impressive accuracy score of 95.4%. The findings of this study indicate that incorporating correlation analysis into machine learning models leads to improved performance in predicting or classifying instances. Specifically, the Logistic Regression model demonstrates superior accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score compared to the ML models incorporated with the PCA.

articleTitle: Hyperledger Fabric as a Secure Blockchain Solution for Healthcare 4.0 Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The healthcare sector deals with extremely sensitive information that must be administered in a safe and confidential way. The objective of the proposed framework is to utilize Blockchain Technology (BT) for tracking medical prescriptions and the implementation is carried out using the Hyperledger Fabric platform, an enterprise-grade open-source distributed ledger technology platform designed for Bigdata applications. Multiple entities, including patients, e-pharmacies, pharmacies, doctors and hospitals can establish connections by introducing several nodes in the Fabric chain. A web-centered application is provided for doctors, connecting them with participating pharmacies, hospitals and e-pharmacies through which, they can share patient prescription. Pharmacies and e-pharmacies have access to this data and can notify patients about the availability of prescribed medicines. Additionally, reminders for refills, such as heart medication, can be sent for patients requiring long-term medication. Patients can also try with nearby pharmacies and the availability of their prescribed medicines. The inclusion of a wallet feature in the application enables patients to use mobile tokens for making purchases. Patient data is treated with the utmost confidentiality, kept private, and accessed only upon request and with the consent of the concerned parties. This privacy is ensured through the use of zero-knowledge proof. Patients retain access to their complete medical history, facilitating interactions with doctors without the need for repetitive information sharing.

articleTitle: Cloud Deployment Unveiled: A Security Model Focused on Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The Cloud Compute Adoption Architecture (CCAF), a unique architecture designed to improve safety of the business cloud installations, is introduced in this research article. Using router, authentication and authorization, and encryption methods embedded in Industrial File Sync/Share systems, CCAF aims to provide a multi-layered privacy strategy. Our paper describes the creation of this security A system, examines relevant literature, and explains the reasoning behind CCAF. Through testing and thorough analysis of the key technologies, the study assesses the effectiveness of the CCAF security layered approach. The intricate security system in place at CCAF proved to be an outstanding tool during penetration testing, detecting and eliminating 99.95% of worms including trojans, and even deactivating over 85% of them after 100 hours of continuous attack. Of particular note was the operating system's lightning-fast reaction time of less than 0.012 seconds per trojan and virus, which allowed for the early detection and mitigation of threats. Moreover, each try at SQL injection was successfully thwarted by the CCAF's extensive security defenses, guaranteeing strong security of data. The article highlights the usefulness of CCAF by exploring how its multi-layered security is seamlessly integrated into current regulations, services, and corporate processes. The research highlights how important CCAF's complex security is for Big Data applications running in the cloud, especially when it comes to scalability, speed, and veracity. The study's conclusions highlight CCAF's legitimacy and significant contributions to the field, demonstrating its applicability and effectiveness in protecting the cloud.

Author Keywords: penetration testing and SQL injection assessment

articleTitle: Experiment Based Study to Enhance the Security of Cyber Space
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Giving security in an open, inter-communicated, and vast-threaded network has converted this situation into a significant problem these days. Information communicated through the network isn’t viewed as protected. Different threats and dangers like sniffing, spoofing, phishing exist. This paper presents an outline of different dangers and assaults to the network. There are numerous apparatuses in the open-source which are created as a countermeasure to these assaults. With the improvement of the economy and the advancement of science and innovation, computer network(CN) has been greatly utilized in each arena of improvement in a nation, and successfully advance and effectively promote the development of nation computing age. As an open-sourced tool, the network is generally utilized in an individual’s everyday life, however, it is likewise a direct result of this trademark that the CN is confronted with extraordinary security issues. On the off chance that a security weakness happens in a network, it will make immense misfortunes for a huge number of networking clients. This paper, will render varieties of ways to defend our networking spaces from being malfunctioned and the possible ways to overcome such a situation.

articleTitle: Advanced Channel Modelling for 6G Gigabit Small-Cell Systems (GBSMS)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A comprehensive theory for colonial tube models that unifies methods and fixes for Canal Impulse Responses (CIR). Key channel characteristics are smoothly integrated inside the structure over different levels and environmental settings. Making a model with three dimensions Irregular Geometry-Based Probabilistic Model (3D-IGPM) specifically for sixth generation (6G) communications infrastructures is the main goal. The stochastic behavior of pathways throughout many frequencies, such as sub-6 GHz the spectrum and visible-light connectivity (VLC) domains, is captured by the 6G Probabilistic Channel Modelling (6GPCM). With the flexibility of this concept, channel characteristics may be changed to suit certain frequency regions and surroundings. Moreover, examples of traditional fifth generation (5G) network layouts are shown, highlighting its flexibility and compatibility in the past with current systems. The suggested 6GPCM is developed, simulated, and tested using a range of channel information to guarantee accuracy, completeness, and practicality. All in all, this study offers a thorough and extensive theory of channel modelling that is capable of accurately describing wireless channels in a variety of bandwidths and application situations. A versatile and accurate modelling tool for creating and analyzing 6G wireless communications infrastructures is the 6GPCM.

articleTitle: Enhancing Face Emotion Recognition through LBP, SIFT boosted CNN Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Emotions are crucial because they allow wordless communication, guide decisions based on values, and support social connections. Face Emotion recognition (FER) technology has gained significant importance in various sectors, like human-computer interaction, healthcare, entertainment, etc. This technology enables machines to interpret human emotions from facial expressions, transforming interactions and experiences. This paper delves into FER methodologies, particularly focusing on refining accuracy through feature extraction by integrating Local Binary Pattern (LBP), Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and with only CNN. CKplus and FER2013 datasets are used for evaluation. The primary finding is that the LBP-CNN model was more accurate than SIFT-CNN (90.86%) and CNN without feature extraction (98.98%) on the CKplus dataset, with a 99.49% accuracy. On the FER2013 dataset, CNN without FE was 52.53% more accurate than both LBP-CNN and SIFT-CNN. This study demonstrates the potential of feature extraction methods with and without deep learning model by considering the impact of dataset complexity.

articleTitle: 5G Technology Empowering Wireless Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Wireless Communication is the means of transferring data from one point to another without the use of any wired means. With reference to wireless communication, wireless sensor Networks (WSN) have also developed in recent times. It can be referred as an infrastructure-less system of wireless devices which can gather and exchange information with the help of a wireless link. The information which is gathered is sent respectively to the base stations and sinks for further developments. Recently, the 5G generation network, the latest Wireless Communication Network operates at a higher frequency range than its predecessor. In this paper, a detailed analysis on the 5G generation cellular network, which is expected to be a key instrument of wireless technologies in the near future is outlined. Also a comparative analysis of different kinds of networks in context to wireless scenario is discussed. It was found that 5G provides the best outcome in terms of high speed and network spectrum bandwidth.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Application for Children Suffering from Autism Spectrum Disorder using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Autism is a complex neuro developmental disorder that affects the way a person communicates, relates to others, and processes information. It is characterized by difficulties with social skills, verbal and non-verbal communication, and repetitive behaviors. The examined papers evince conspicuous gaps, notably in the absence of curative implementations and a marked deficiency in achieving optimal machine learning accuracy. Regrettably, their scope remained confined to the domain of autism detection, with a notable oversight in addressing post-detection therapeutic interventions for individuals affected by autism. This paper endeavors to underscore the imperative for an efficacious platform designed to facilitate the catharsis of emotions experienced by individuals afflicted by Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). Through the utilization of emotion-centric technologies such as Image Recognition, coupled with a user-friendly mobile application interface, substantial challenges can be ameliorated by means of early detection, followed by constructive dialogue facilitated by dedicated conversational modules integrated within the application framework.

articleTitle: A Novel Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Alzheimer's Disease Prediction using MRI Scans
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurological disorder that worsens over time and affects cognitive function and memory, making it difficult to carry out daily tasks. The buildup of amyloid plaques and tau protein tangles in the brain leads to the demise of brain cells and the disruption of neuronal connections, ultimately causing the disease. Common symptoms of AD include memory loss, confusion, and difficulty communicating. The suggested improvement entails employing a deep CNN for the automated extraction of features from MRI scans. Deep learning models have achieved astounding results in a variety of picture categorization tasks in recent years. In my research, I examine how the cutting-edge EfficientNetB0 architecture could be used to achieve high-performance picture classification. EfficientNetB0 has gained significant attention due to its efficient and effective design, making it suitable for resource-constrained environments without compromising accuracy. The proposed approach combines the power of EfficientNetB0 with global average pooling and a dense layer to predict class labels. By leveraging the pre-trained weights of EfficientNetB0, the model benefits from the learned representations of a diverse image dataset, enhancing its ability to generalize to unseen data. Fine-tuning is employed to adapt the model to the image classification task. Results showed that the suggested method worked well, with an overall accuracy of 97% across four courses. This research makes a valuable contribution to the domain of image classification by showcasing the capabilities of the EfficientNetB0 architecture and its potential to achieve high-performance results.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Breast carcinoma is the biggest cause of mortality for women worldwide. Early recognition and proper diagnosis can significantly enhance breast tumour survival rates and treatment results. As technological advances occurred, breast cancer prediction models were built utilizing techniques using machine learning and artificial intelligence. This study aims to determine whether it is possible to reliably predict breast cancer using data visualization and machine learning techniques. Moreover, data visualization techniques are used to explore and analyze the dataset, which helps identify the significant features affecting the prediction performance. Feature importance is calculated using a permutation-based approach and visualized using bar plots. The study demonstrates the effectiveness of ML algorithms and data visualization methods in predicting breast cancer accurately. In this paper, six algorithms with different logarithms, namely logistic regression, Support Vector Machine, k Nearest Neighbour, multi-layer perception, XG BOOST, and Random Forest. XG BOOST has the greatest accuracy of 98.6%, and Random Forest achieved an accuracy of 96.55%, indicating a relatively lower performance compared to the others The results can provide valuable insights for healthcare professionals to develop better diagnosis and treatment strategies for breast cancer patients.

articleTitle: The Meta-Analysis AI in Cervical Cancer Detection and Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: One of the most important aspects of cervical cancer early diagnosis and therapy is the prompt detection of abnormal cervical cells. Computerized approaches have become a viable alternative to get beyond the drawbacks of human classification procedures, which depend on pathologists with specialized knowledge and are prone to mistakes. The purpose of this systematic review is to evaluate the diagnostic effectiveness of artificial intelligence (AI) systems about of precursory lesion detection, cervical cancer detection, and screening. The results show a notable improvement in detection reliability, with AI-based methods exhibiting predicted accuracy scores of 70% to 100% for the detection of cervix lesions that are malignant or precursory. AI is particularly good at differentiating between Pap Smears that are malignant and those that are not, with precision levels varying from 80% to 100%. AI integration offers a chance to help doctors make accurate clinical assessments, and it may wind up being a very useful tool for healthcare practice. The documented accuracy and precision of AI in diagnosing CIN2+ in the field of colposcopy, which ranged from 51.8% to 96.2% and from 71.9% to 98.22%, respectively. Notably, this study highlights the outstanding effectiveness of AI systems in prediction, screening, and detecting activities linked to cervical cancer and malignancies, even in areas with restricted access to specialized medical resources. By combining AI-enabled insights with human experience, it is possible to improve the understanding of cervical smears and pictures and ultimately improve diagnosis accuracy.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Models can help Early Disease Detection in Medicinal Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Medicinal plants are susceptible to a variety of pests and diseases. One of the most difficult tasks in agriculture is early diagnosis of diseases. If pathogens are not detected early on, they can have a significant influence on overall yield, resulting in lower income of farmers. However, as technology has advanced, the effectiveness and precision/accuracy of recognizing plant diseases has improved. This paper discusses the comparison between the traditional methods and modern techniques of machine learning for early disease detection. The difficulties of recognizing plant disease and pests, and also the benefits in early disease detection using machine learning pest detection methods are discussed. The review includes the opportunities for enhancement in the current plant recognition databases/systems.

articleTitle: Improved Deep Learning Laryngeal Tumour Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Laryngeal cancer incidence has significantly increased recently all over the globe. There are several difficulties in correctly diagnosing and treating laryngeal cancer, especially when it is advanced. This kind of cancer affects patients’ head and neck areas and is a complicated malignancy. Researchers have created a number of diagnostic techniques and instruments throughout time to help clinical specialists accurately diagnose laryngeal cancer. However, these currently available techniques and methods show a number of performance-related drawbacks, including reduced early-stage laryngeal cancer detection accuracy, increased computational complexity, and extended patient screening periods. Furthermore, our suggested methodology greatly accelerates the real-time screening of patients by successfully catching and recognizing even small laryngeal cancers. The time saved by the professionals due to this efficiency allows them to screen more patients each day. When tested utilizing the ImageNet dataset, the outcomes of our suggested model are more accurate and useful, boasting a rate. Numerous research on laryngeal cancer detection have been conducted recently, each using a different methodology. Future research has a lot of chances to investigate innovative methods for detecting laryngeal cancer by using varied and substantial medical picture databases.

Index Terms: Head And Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare Delivery in India: Emergency Medical Care and Patient History Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In India, the current healthcare system faces significant inefficiencies, resulting in poor healthcare delivery and patient outcomes. This system lacks comprehensive records of patients' medical histories, leading to critical delays in emergency situations, such as road accidents. The urgency to enhance the healthcare system has heightened in the post-COVID era. This research proposes an innovative solution to address these challenges—an Android-based healthcare application. This application aims to bridge the gap in emergency response and the lack of medical history knowledge among healthcare professionals. Key features include 'Ride Mode,' which assists in detecting accidents and identifying accident victims, and seamless access to patients' medical histories. The application, developed using Android Studio, leverages Firebase for secure data storage. By providing immediate access to critical medical information, it empowers healthcare providers to make informed decisions swiftly, ultimately improving healthcare delivery and patient safety.

articleTitle: Location-Based Measure for Relative Influence of Papers in NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Assessing the influence of research papers is paramount in understanding the evolution of scholarly knowledge. In this paper, we introduce a novel and comprehensive approach to measure the influence of research papers in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP). Our work builds upon traditional citation-based metrics and extends them to consider the location and context of citations within research papers. The novelty of our approach lies in the integration of three distinct models: the Baseline Model, which employs citation counts as a primary indicator of influence; the Similarity-Based Model, which leverages semantic similarity between papers and their references; and the Location-Based Model, which accounts for the location of citations within the text. We use the term location and position interchangeably to refer to the location of citations in a paper. Notably, the Similarity-Based Model exhibits a remarkable 60% improvement over the baseline, while the Location-Based Model charts a substantial 70% enhancement, highlighting the robustness and efficacy of our approach. Through an extensive evaluation using standard metrics such as Precision, Recall, and F1-score, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our models in identifying influential research papers in NLP. We uncover that considering not only the quantity but also the context and location of citations leads to a more accurate representation of influence. Our findings offer valuable insights into the significance of influential papers in NLP, providing researchers with a powerful tool for discovering seminal works and guiding future research endeavors. This work contributes to the field by presenting an innovative framework for assessing research paper influence, addressing the limitations of traditional methods, and paving the way for more nuanced bibliometric analyses in NLP and beyond.

articleTitle: Content Based Movie Recommendation System Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A recommendation system grounded in user preferences can be applied to suggest various types of content such as web runners, books, pictures, television shows, and songs. The objective of a movie recommendation system is to recommend movies to individuals based on their interests, helping them save time searching the internet for movies amidst the overwhelming options available. A content-grounded recommendation system utilizes specific characteristics to determine suitable recommendations for users. By analyzing attributes present in previously liked movies, the system predicts which movies a user is likely to enjoy. Recommendation systems can utilize one or a combination of multiple attributes to generate recommendations. When designing a movie recommendation system, factors such as genre, ID, keywords, title, director, and actors are taken into account. This paper presents a movie recommender system based on cast, keywords, crew, and genres. A unified tag is created by combining these seven attributes, serving as the primary tag for the movie recommendation system, which guides the selection of recommended movies. This system aids users in saving time by providing personalized movie recommendations, eliminating the need to sift through countless options online. A content-based recommendation system is employed to identify items that are likely to be of interest to users. By leveraging a dataset, the system predicts user preferences based on various attributes.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Scheduling and Optimization Paradigms in Cloud Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The increased adoption of cloud computing applications can be attributed to the improved availability of broadband speeds over the past decade. With the increasing adoption of cloud platforms by individuals and companies, there is a rising need for more efficient approaches to work schedule management. Conventional work scheduling methods strive to identify the optimal sequence for task execution in order to minimize resource utilization, encompassing time, computational capacity, memory, and other factors. Customers generally anticipate supplementary services and a notable degree of effectiveness. An efficiently organized scheduling technique enables the most effective exploitation of resources. This document provides a comprehensive examination of techniques for organizing and overseeing work in the realm of cloud computing, with specific emphasis on several hybrid adaptations of metaheuristic methodologies. The scientific study also includes a section that examines several approaches for assessing productivity based on the current body of information.

articleTitle: Recommender Systems and Analysis of Large-Scale Online Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: People today see social networking as an essential part of business, communication, and getting information from one place to another. Each of these applications produces a lot of information sharing. Many large organizations spend a lot of time processing, analyzing, and looking for patterns before deciding. This research analyzes the different recommender systems used in online social networks that help organizations make better decisions since a vast amount of information is generated daily. When the number of social networks continues to grow, it is expected to have a recommender system that gives more accurate and reliable results. This research also aims to analyze and compare the different design challenges of using the recommender system in social network applications. This research looks at and compares different datasets for recommender systems to find problems and possible opportunities in how they are designed. The analysis and challenges of distinct large-scale online social networks with the heterogeneity of information and structures are also addressed in this research.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning and Cloud Computing for Observing Health Status of Patients Remotely in Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Strategies that may gain insight from both labeled and unlabeled data as well as from their environment are being developed through the use of machine learning. Machine learning is applied in many domains, but it is most commonly used in the healthcare sector, where it offers substantial benefits through suitable decision- and prediction-making techniques. A online system which can continuously monitor the individual’s condition and generate an alert when needed is introduced by the proposed work. This suggested methodology uses cloud computing and various machine learning algorithms to store data continuously. To identify risks and provide the right treatment and diagnosis, physicians analyze medical data using machine learning techniques and tools. The range of remote healthcare services includes monitoring elderly patients, premature children, patients with chronic illnesses, and victims of accidents. The current study investigates how machine learning technologies can be used to monitor patients who are located remotely and provide real-time alerts about their condition via a remote system.

articleTitle: AI-IOT: Integrating Artificial Intelligence & Internet of Things for Healthcare Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: AI technology has made healthcare far more efficient, usable, and available. Artificial intelligence (AI) is a present day method of developing algorithms and programs to make computers intelligent and effective at performing jobs that frequently need competent human brains. Machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), classic neural networks, fuzzy logic, and speech recognition represent just a few of the artificial intelligence (AI) subsets with distinct characteristics and functionalities that might improve medical science performance. These cognitive technologies make it easier for humans to participate in clinical diagnostics, medical imaging, and decision- making. Around the same time period, the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) emerged, which is a cutting-edge bio-analytical tool that integrates network-connected biomedical devices with a software program to improve human health. The paper will address this integration as AI-IoT approach. The paper addresses the scientific, engineering, and business opportunities for creating effective patient care biomedical systems that are appropriate for next-generation intelligent healthcare using AI-based integrated personalized IoT devices.

articleTitle: Personalized Recommendation after Classification of Tweets to Predict Depression using Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The task of extracting user profiles from unstructured and informal data obtained from social networks is a challenging endeavor. The study aims to construct a user profile utilizing Twitter data, which can subsequently facilitate the provision of individualized recommendations to the user. The study involves the retrieval and categorization of tweets pertaining to mental health, followed by the extraction and standardization of the sentiments conveyed within said tweets. The present study employs a domain-specific seed list for the purpose of categorizing tweets which involves conducting semantic and syntactic analyses to mitigate any potential loss of information along with integration of random forest classifier. Through a meticulous process of categorization and sentiment analysis, the paper proposes a user-friendly system by closely examining the user’s Twitter activity to discern their specific fields of interest. Lastly, the proposed system is evaluated by comparing the performance of classifiers namely KNN and Naïve Bayes.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of CNNs and DNNs for Emotion Detection from text using TF-IDF
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With several applications in fields including sentiment analysis, human-computer interaction, and mental health monitoring, emotion identification from text has emerged as a crucial job in natural language processing. The task of emotion recognition from textual data is examined using a comparison of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). We investigate and assess the performance of these two well-known neural network designs by using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) as a feature extraction technique. The widely-known ISEAR dataset is one of the benchmark datasets used in the study. The preparation of text data and use of TF-IDF to convert the text into useful numerical representations serve as the basis for the comparison analysis. Following this, we design and implement tailored CNN and DNN models, each optimized for the specific task of emotion detection. Our findings show that the CNN and DNN models have different advantages and disadvantages. While DNNs offer flexibility and resilience in modeling com-plicated relationships, CNNs excel at capturing local characteristics and spatial hierarchies within the text. The comparative evaluation considers several metrics, including recall, accuracy, precision, and F1-score, to provide a more in-depth knowledge of the performance of the models. We al-so investigate the performance impact of model complexity and hyperparameter tuning, offering insights into the best configuration for both architectures in the context of emotion detection. The results of this study provide important new understandings regarding the relative merits and applicability of CNNs and DNNs for emotion recognition from text, employing TF-IDF as a feature extraction technique.The paper ends with concrete suggestions for researchers and practitioners trying to choose the best architecture for certain applications and future possibilities for improving the efficacy and efficiency of emotion detection from text using neural networks

Author Keywords: Neural Networks and Text Emotion Recognition

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Sentiment Analysis of Tweets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis is one of the computer science study areas that is expanding quickly, making it difficult to keep up with all the activity to fit in the business needs .Sentiment Analysis is used in fields of Stock Markets, Social sites like Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, elections, disasters, medicine, Sentiment Analysis in Arabic languages, software engineering to analyse the products based on the polarity scores that are classified in Positive Sentiments, Negative Sentiments and Neutral Sentiments. Here we also analysed the Sentiments of peoples outside the eco places such as park are more positive than peoples inside the park. We here used NLTK, VADER module, some deep learning modules like Roberta, Text blob and a Tweepy API. Based on the dataset utilized, the domain covered, the Arabic language type, the pre-processing techniques, the features used, the word representation, the methodology employed, and the evaluation metrics used to evaluate the suggested techniques, the included research were examined. Using the input given by Twitter popups and characterizing impressions, we present an economic analysis and responses to the wildfires that occurred in Portugal and Spain. We employ methods for machine learning technique to find the info in this text. We calculate a value for the relationship between attitudes toward wildfires and air quality and exposure are determined by Euclidean distance from the catastrophic event.

articleTitle: Incorporation of Deep Learning (DL) Techniques to make Intelligent and Adaptable Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The emergence of Deep Learning (DL) was a response to the widespread availability of mobile data and the growing complexity of wireless networks. It is a subfield of Machine learning that has been proposed in academic literature. This technology is regarded as a breakthrough in the management of mobile data traffic. Wireless systems generate a significant amount of varied data, which presents computational issues. In order to tackle this problem, a variety of optimization methodologies are being investigated. DL increases wireless communication by enhancing its intelligence and adaptability. This paper offers an overview of the DL platform and several methodologies employed to enable deep learning in wireless communications. Wireless networking involves various disciplines, including networking, routing, and scheduling, all of which incorporate DL. This text encompasses a comprehensive range of topics. The topic encompassed several optimization methodologies and the latest breakthroughs in this domain.

articleTitle: Designing IoT-Enabled Circuits for Non-Contact Liquid Infusion in Infectious Patient Care
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology into the field of healthcare has revolutionized patient care and monitoring system. To improve the functionality and connectivity of non-contact liquid infusion essential medical devices. The purpose of this work is to create a system that provides real-time data on a patient's Liquid Infusion level, to enable healthcare professionals for remotely monitor and ready to respond in any life-threatening condition of admitted patient in health care unit. The main focus of this work is to make smart circuit for the non-contact IOT enabled infusion system having very less response time. The circuitry will incorporate sensors and wireless communication protocols to ensure accurate and timely data transmission. This smart circuit will allow for precise control of medication or liquid delivery, with added capability of remote adjustments and monitoring. By implementing secure IoT connectivity, patient safety and reduces the human errors in medication administration. The circuitry will include sensors to measure liquid volume level, the conclusion of this work represents a significant step towards the field of IoT-enabled medical devices to improve remote monitoring capabilities, and streamline healthcare facility.

articleTitle: OIDS: A Smart Framework for Intrusion Detection in 5G WSN’s by using Ontology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The increasing depth and applications of 5G wireless sensor networks also raise the possibility of network intrusions. In this research, a network intrusion detection system based on the ontology notion is proposed. As it creates ontologies and maintains the relationships among sensor nodes in a network, it is referred upon as a smart system. This proposed system finding is able to secure data in 5G networks. The current detection technique’s parameters such as patrol nodes, live nodes, hop, sensor nodes, and energy (in joules) are used to gauge how well the suggested system performs. Attack estimation rate (AER) and precision are the types of metrics in use.

articleTitle: Impact of Machine Learning on Sales Forecasting Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The majority of commercial industry depends largely on their knowledge bases to forecast sales trends. The accuracy of sales projections significantly affects business. Author have created a model using these machine learning methods that helps anticipate market products more accurately and with a lower mistake rate. This model can be highly helpful for both buyers and sellers because it can provide predictions that are warranted. Here three distinct data sets have been taken to use for model training and comparison in order to examine the effects of trend and seasonality. Models are evaluated according to them for predicting a test data set over time steps of one day and one week. surpass current predicting techniques. Decision trees and basic linear regression are found to be best suited for sales forecasting.

articleTitle: An Extensive Review of Optimized Energy Saving Approaches for Green Cloud Computing (GCC)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The proliferation because of cloud computing has resulted in inefficient power usage in the areas of data transmission, storing, and handling. This activity is environmentally detrimental due to the release of emissions of carbon. Hence, the implementation of green IT is necessary in order to preserve the surroundings. The environmentally conscious computing in the cloud (GCC) method is an element of green IT that tries to minimize the ecological impact of information centers by reducing the amount of energy they use. The GCC, or Global Climate Change, is a vast and captivating area for scientific investigation. Several studies have been conducted to enhance the utilization of computing resources in line with the GCC vision. The given paper concentrates on diverse facets, encompassing approaches for optimizing software, hardware, and network systems. Also, this paper summarizes and categorizes various GCC approaches. In order to make meaningful comparisons between GCC methods, it is helpful to first identify the central implementation strategies and the problems associated with each.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Based User Concentration Alert System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Nowadays, due to more social platform usage, the user concentration on major activities has been declined. It can be seen in the education sector as the students are unable to pay attention in online sessions. Therefore, there is a need of an automatic alert system to make a student engaged. This paper focus on implementing face detection, face recognition and face emotion recognition in the education sector. With the concepts of Machine Learning and Neural Networks such as ResNet, AlexNet, VGG-16 as pretrained network helps in recognizing the human face. The emotions of the recognized face are then analysed through the machine learning model i.e. face emotion detector which detects facial emotions like happy, sad, confused, focused, angry, etc. This facial expression system help to send alert to the parents and students for evaluation and for preventing them from getting distracted during sessions.

articleTitle: AI Based Chatbot for Healthcare using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) and automation have exploded in the space across many industries, including healthcare. One of the most popular forms of artificial intelligence and automation in healthcare is the use of chatbots. Chatbots in healthcare are computers designed to simulate conversations with human users and provide personalized and supportive services. There exist some applications (Chat bots) have non-user-friendly environment, inappropriate responses, less control over created content. To overcome these gaps a new application has been proposed that enables the users to access interactive content for an school going students. The application is able to answers the frequently asked questions (FAQ) in a hierarchical way and allow user to inerate with the system using front end interface whereas the user can get the solution of small problems of healthcare. The application was developed using Google Dialogflow as a simple way to generate and train a natural language model and other advantage of this is its ability to automatically collect the data that is potentially useful for learners. The main purpose of this work is to discuss the methodology and system implementation so that it can be reproduced in different healthcare contexts. There are currently many articles, news and blogs discussing the possibilities, uses and effects of chatbots in general, but there is almost no information about their replacement for treatment. In this case, we created four main elements that model the content of the class and focus on quick implementation, ease of Modification and extensibility.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prediction System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Diabetes is long-lasting disease to causes a health care crisis , but it is challenging to predict without medical tests According to the International Diabetes Federation, there are currently 537 million people living with diabetes worldwide. By the year 2045, this number is projected to double, reaching 783 million. Diabetes is a disorder triggered by the abnormal increase in blood glucose levels. This excess blood glucose produces the symptoms of urination, inceased thirst, and improved hunger. Diabetes is a significant contributor to various health complications, including blindness, kidney failure, amputations, heart failure, and strokes. When we consume food, our body processes it into sugars, or glucose. Machine learning algorithms can process vast amounts of data in medicine, revealing confidential information. The aim of study to investigate how machine learning algorithms can used to predict disease. Decision Trees, Numpy, Support Vector Machine are used to predict the diabetes using machine learning techniques. All these machine learning methods/algorithms can examine vast amounts of data, enabling medical practitioners to make more cost- effective judgments. By analyzing clinical data, establishing connections among multiple diagnostic variables, building a predictive model, and comparing it to a new dataset, the study found that the Support Vector Machine Classifier predicted diabetes illnesses with 80% accuracy. The study found that employing a larger dataset for train and test can improve the model's accuracy and modify different hyperparameters. The study concludes that artificial intelligence using ML modeling can categorize people with or without diabetes.

articleTitle: False - Face Challenge Response Authentication Automated Test Using Anthropomorphic Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Captcha is the reverse Turing test done by the machine to verify the human online automatically. This proposed work presents a method to use anthropomorphic (human outer cover morphed with monkey images) images for designing captchas. A set of false – face (morphed) images displayed in the grid with another group of images where the generated human-like pictures need to be as close as possible to human faces but not entirely. Such anthropomorphic captcha secure high score than other captchas while differentiating the human and machine. In the second level, clicked images are replaced by obfuscated, deformed, distorted and noised text images to decrease the machine recognition rate remarkably, compared to previous work while human recognition increased likewise. In addition to that, deep neural network model (proposed False-face model) trained with animal, human, morphed and alphabet images in a powerful way to classify the images. These images are tested with existing face classification algorithms like DeepFace, FaceNet, and TBE-CNN. This algorithm could not produce significant success in the prediction of anthropomorphic images. It helps to improve web security significantly while using this proposed captcha design.

articleTitle: Evolution and Advancement of Quantum Computing in the Era of Networking and Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Over the past decade, we've witnessed a remarkable and rapid surge in the realm of high-performance computing. The entire computing landscape, encompassing cloud and fog computing, has seen an unprecedented surge in popularity. Cloud computing, a system interconnecting myriad components, delivers application, data, and storage services over the internet. Quantum computing, on the other hand, harnesses the remarkable phenomena of quantum mechanics like superposition and entanglement for computational purposes. This paper serves as an expansive introduction to the fundamental principles, historical evolution, and breakthroughs in quantum computing, shedding light on its applications in network technology and cryptography. Moreover, it delves into the exciting potential for future game development empowered by quantum technology. In particular, we'll uncover the latest strides in cognitive networking and cryptography, drawing attention to the cutting-edge developments. Finally, we'll scrutinize the on-going research endeavours and lingering questions demanding further exploration within the dynamic realm of quantum computing.

Author Keywords: high performance computing and fog computing

articleTitle: Comprehensive Study on ChatGPT Sentiment Analysis and Visualization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) is poised to reshape industries and societal aspects, driven by its ability to simulate human intelligence and perform tasks requiring humanlike thinking and learning. ChatGpt has been leading this growth since its inception, enhancing user experience and garnering over 100 million users by February 2023. Social Networking sites have been a source for sharing the sentiments. This research explores tweets on ChatGpt in the field of sentiment analysis and its integration with data visualization techniques to enhance the comprehension of textual data. The research proposed a holistic approach by exploring the methodologies such as data collection, data preprocessing, tokenization, sentiment analysis using Natural Language Processing, accuracy assessment and visualization. For training and testing a dataset has been gathered from Kaggle which daily gets updated. The proposed study gives comprehensive results about sentiments on ChatGPT and explores different visualization techniques.

articleTitle: An Intelligent System for Vehicle Collision Avoidance System Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
