abstract: The increasing number of vehicles on the roads has resulted in a higher risk of accidents and collisions. To address this critical issue, this research proposes an intelligent system for vehicle collision avoidance using the Internet of Things (IoT). The system aims to enhance road safety by providing real-time monitoring, analysis, and proactive collision avoidance mechanisms. The system operates in three main stages: perception, decision-making, and action. In the perception stage, sensor data from vehicles and infrastructure are collected and processed to gather relevant information about the surrounding environment. This includes detecting the presence, position, and velocity of nearby vehicles, pedestrians, and obstacles. In the decision-making stage, the collected data is analyzed and evaluated using machine learning techniques. The system generates real-time predictions and risk assessments based on the analyzed data to determine potential collision scenarios and prioritize the most critical situations. This system also has an over-speed detection feature that monitors speed and notifies the driver when the car exceeds a certain speed restriction.

articleTitle: Identification of Individual from Group Photo Using Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In today's digital world, the prevalence of group photos in the realm of photography and social media is unquestionable. Identifying specific individuals within these group images, particularly in larger gatherings, presents a notable challenge. Addressing this challenge, computer vision, a technology enabling computers to interpret images, has been employed to develop an intelligent system capable of accurately detecting and recognizing individuals within group photos. This system serves a versatile purpose, finding applications in various contexts, including event photography, surveillance, and social media tagging. It offers an automated and efficient solution, leveraging cutting-edge algorithms and machine learning techniques to simplify a process that would otherwise be intricate and manual. The literature review conducted as part of this project underscores the significance of face recognition and the extraction of faces from group photos. Consideration of factors like facial expressions and pose has emerged as pivotal in improving the accuracy of recognition. Techniques such as skin detection algorithms and the Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) have been employed to achieve face detection and feature extraction. The methodology for this project involves the utilization of essential tools such as Python, OpenCV, Face Recognition, and Tkinter. This process is depicted in a comprehensive flowchart, encompassing the steps of loading the photo, encoding known faces, comparing these encodings to ascertain matches, and framing the matched faces. The results obtained in this research affirm the efficacy of the system in accurately identifying individuals, even under challenging conditions characterized by obscured faces, varying poses, and diverse lighting conditions. The system's potential applications are far-reaching, promising enhanced efficiency in event management, augmented security through advanced surveillance, and improved user experiences on social media platforms, particularly in the domain of tagging.

articleTitle: Identification and Analysis of Email Spam using Filtering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The majority of transactions and commerce in this e-world use emails. Due to the time and money savings, email has developed into a strong tool for communication today. However, the majority of emails now include spam, which is undesired information, thanks to social networks and advertisements. Although several algorithms have been created for the classification of email spam, none of them can categorise spam emails with 100% accuracy. In order to investigate the most effective classifier for email spam classification, the spam dataset is examined in this research utilising the TANAGRA data mining tool. Fisher filtering, FCBF, MOD tree, and MIFS are some of the classifiers used for identification and analysis. Finally, based on calculation time in seconds, the top classifier for email spam is determined.

articleTitle: Sleep Apnea Detection – A Comparative study and efficient solution with modified LeNet-5
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sleep apnea (SA) is a common sleep disease that, if neglected, can have serious cardiovascular and neurological effects. The standard diagnostic method, polysomnography (PSG), involves some professional, multiple electrodes, and cables. Researchers propose using a single-channel signal like electrocardiogram(ECG), easily captured with wearables. However, current ECG-based SA detection methods require expertise. This study suggests employing a modified LeNet-5 convolutional neural network (CNN) to address this challenge. The network considers neighboring segment effects, automatically learning efficient features from training data. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach in SA identification, achieving results comparable or superior to traditional machine learning methods.

articleTitle: Implementation of Different Technologies for Detection of Accident-Spots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Individuals lose their lives as a result of traffic accidents. These circumstances result from a lack of coordination among the participating organizations. Additionally, failing to properly practice the necessary procedures and methods causes the graph to enlarge. In this paper different methods suggested previously on accident detection has been discussed based on the technology employed. A few research studies also recommend other strategies for rescuing the injured passengers in addition to accident detection. There are certain methods that are estimated and planned with current road accident circumstances in mind.

articleTitle: Interactive Data Visualization Platform to Present Effective Teacher Performance with Power BI
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research paper focuses on the development and implementation of a platform for interactive data visualization using Power BI to present teacher performance effectively. The study proposes a novel approach to data visualization that offers educational stakeholders a visually compelling and user-friendly interface to access and understand teacher performance metrics. The research highlights the importance of effective teacher performance evaluation and the potential benefits of using interactive data visualization platforms. Additionally, the paper discusses the technical implementation and architecture of the developed platform and presents results from a usability study conducted with a group of educational stakeholders. The findings suggest that the interactive data visualization platform having the capacity to significantly improves the accessibility and usefulness of teacher performance data. The study concludes by highlighting the significance of the developed platform for enhancing educational decision-making processes and improving teacher performance. Effective teacher performance evaluation is crucial for raising student success, fostering teacher growth, and improving education as a whole. However, traditional approaches to teacher performance evaluation often rely on manual data analysis and reporting, which can be time-consuming and challenging for educational stakeholders to access and interpret. This research report suggests the development and deployment of an interactive data visualization platform utilizing Power BI to effectively present teacher performance in order to address these issues. The platform provides an intuitive and visually compelling interface for educational stakeholders to access, analyze, and interpret teacher performance metrics in real-time.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation of the World Happiness Report: The Effect of Reliogisity, Suicide Rate and Human Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The relationship between economic indicators of progress and happiness is complex at best and paradoxical in some instances. Happiness does not keep increasing with the country’s rise in income when viewed over a long period. Empirical literature finds a positive correlation between happiness and religiosity whereas there is a negative correlation between religiosity and income. Suicide rate and happiness are both high in developed economies. This paper is chiefly an empirical investigation of religiosity and suicide rate as a window into a country’s happiness. This paper does not find an association between three levels of religiosity and happiness. Suicide rate is associated with countries at the middle and lower end of the happiness. A substantially higher suicide rate is found for the latter. The result is consistent with literature that finds a paradoxical association between happiness and suicide rate. Literature is far from conclusive on these associations. This work contributes to the empirical research on subjective well-being as an important indication of a country’s progress.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Prediction of Colon Cancer Disease with the Handling of Outliers and Overfitting through Neural Network Clustering and Optimal Tuning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: One serious public health concern is colon cancer. The early detection and accurate prediction are crucial for effective treatment and improved patient outcomes. By addressing two important issues—managing outliers and reducing overfitting—this research presents a novel method for colon cancer prediction.The proposed model consists of three main steps: data preprocessing, neural network clustering, and neural network modeling. The data preprocessing step includes handling outliers, selecting features, and balancing the classes. The neural network clustering step trains a self-organizing map (SOM) on the preprocessed data to generate a feature map that captures the relationships and similarities among the instances. In the neural network modeling step, a feedforward neural network is trained on the feature map to predict the probability of colon cancer.A dataset of 10,000 patient records—equally divided between those with and without colon cancer—was used to evaluate the study model. On a held-out test set, the model's accuracy of 93% is a notable improvement over that of conventional machine learning models. This suggests that the new model could be used to improve the early detection of colon cancer.The following measures contributed to the performance improvement. The use of neural network clustering to identify distinct groups of patients with similar disease characteristics. This information can be used to personalize treatment strategies. The use of optimal tuning techniques to reduce overfitting. This ensures that the model is generalizable and robust.The proposed model is a valuable source for colon cancer prediction as it is accurate and robust It can be used to personalize treatment strategies and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Driver’s Drowsiness Detection System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The structure focuses on the eyes to prevent accidents. In the proposed system, a video is first recorded by a camera. The camera is placed in front of the driver to better capture the driver's face. To create a 2D image, frames of the video are extracted. Faces are detected in images using histogram of oriented gradients (HOG) and linear support vector machine (SVM) for object detection. In this case, SVM (Support Vector Machine) was used to classify the components of the video input. To do this, we first need to develop a bounding box and classification system to recognize pupils initially. Following facial recognition, it marks facial points on the image, such as eye positions. Eye aspect ratio (EAR) and mouth aspect ratio (MAR) are measured using facial landmarks. These features and machine learning approaches are used to estimate driver fatigue. If it detects drowsiness, it sends an alert to the driver to alert them. This system uses the SVM (Support Vector Machine) approach which is achieving an excellent accuracy score of 92.85%. This approach improves model performance and helps to reliably detect driver fatigue and prevent fatal crashes.

articleTitle: Smart Recycling Robot: Vision-Driven Autonomous Water Bottle Collection System using YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The growing concern for environmental sustainability has led to an increased focus on waste recycling and management. Many initiatives have been taken to promote waste recycling and garbage management. In this research, an idea of an autonomous water bottle collector is presented that combines computer vision to detect, approach, and pick up water bottles for recycling. This smart recycling robot can move around in the surroundings, detect the bottles lying on the ground, autonomously moving towards the detected bottle, and pick it. The system utilizes the YOLOv5 for object detection. It efficiently detects the bottles. Jetson Nano is used for processing the data and ESP 32 is used as a controller for the robot’s movement. Experimental results demonstrate the system’s ability to autonomously detect, approach, and pick up bottles with high accuracy and efficiency. The proposed water bottle collector robot offers a promising solution for automated recycling processes, reducing manual labour and promoting efficient waste.

articleTitle: An Abstractive Summarization and Conversation Bot using T5 and its Variants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Abstractive summarization and conversation bots powered by Large Language Models have gained significant attention currently with respect to their ability to generate humanlike text and facilitate natural language interactions. Models like RNN, LSTM, GRU are not capable of performing these tasks effectively. This article explores abstractive summarization and question-answering methods by using Large Language Models with respect to the key components, challenges, and applications of such systems. It emphasizes the usage of Large Language Models, like GPT-3, for abstractive summarization and conversational AI. The study highlights the importance of fine-tuning these models for specific tasks, such as summarization and chatbots, to enhance their performance and ensure coherent and contextually relevant responses. In this article different versions of models like Flan T5 and LaMini Flan T5 are used. Additionally, it discusses ethical considerations and the responsible deployment of these technologies, emphasizing transparency, bias mitigation, and user privacy. Finally, this article offers insights into the potential future developments in this field, including personalized conversational agents and improved summarization accuracy, contributing to the ongoing advancement of natural language processing and AI-driven interactions in Natural Language Processing for the effective and efficient use of documents for obtaining knowledge.

articleTitle: Enhancing Traffic Flow Efficiency and Mitigating Congestion through ML-Based Traffic Management Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Urban traffic congestion remains a persistent and critical issue, leading to substantial economic and environmental consequences. This research paper introduces an innovative approach to improving traffic flow and reducing congestion by implementing machine learning (ML)-based traffic management strategies. Our study utilizes real-time traffic data, including vehicle counts, speed measurements, and historical traffic patterns, to develop ML models that can predict congestion hotspots and optimize traffic signal timings. Through rigorous simulations and empirical evaluations conducted in urban settings, our findings highlight the substantial efficacy of ML-driven traffic management strategies in reducing travel times and mitigating congestion-related emissions. Moreover, we investigate the potential synergies between autonomous vehicles and ML-based traffic management systems, presenting a comprehensive framework for their seamless integration while discussing the associated advantages and challenges. This paper emphasizes the significance of our research for urban planners, policymakers, and transportation authorities, offering a pathway towards creating intelligent, efficient, and sustainable urban transportation systems.

articleTitle: Movies Recommendation System Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Movie recommendation system is a type of recommendation engine that uses data on user preferences and characteristics of movies to provide personalized movie suggestions. It aims to enhance user experience and engagement by offering relevant and appealing movie choices, increasing the likelihood of users finding movies that align with their interests. When designing a movie recommendation system, various factors can be taken into account. These factors may include movie genre, actors, director, release year, ratings, and user reviews. In the paper, the recommendation system is built using a content-based filtering approach, specifically focusing on movie genres. Content-based filtering analyzes the characteristics or content of items (in this case, movies) to make recommendations.

articleTitle: ChatGPT: Exploring the Capabilities and Limitations of a Large Language Model for Conversational AI
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: This research paper provides a comprehensive review of the different versions of Chat GPT, a language model developed by OpenAI for natural language processing. The paper discusses the advancements made in each version, starting from the first version with 117 million parameters to the latest version with 175 billion parameters. The paper highlights the significant improvements in coherence, contextuality, and the ability to perform natural language tasks such as translation and summarization. The paper also discusses the implications of these advancements for various industries such as education, healthcare, and technology. Overall, the paper showcases the significant progress made in natural language processing through the different versions of Chat GPT, with the latest version showing great potential for future applications.

articleTitle: Swarm Optimization Framework for Energy-Efficient Allocation of Industrial IoT Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The IIoT, or Industrial Internet of Things, has recently emerged as a major topic of discussion in the context of technological innovation in the manufacturing sector. The IIoT lends a hand in production by promoting and implementing smart sensors or devices for use in industrial systems. Although it demonstrates an astonishing process, it still raises difficult questions about how to make the nodes more energy efficient and how to fairly distribute the available resources among them. Earlier models were used, but they were hampered by issues like a single communication route and artificial constraints. But congested communications, scarce materials, and power outages are the biggest stumbling blocks. Because of this, there is a need for a more efficient IIoT model that can improve the gearbox. To address the difficulties of the traditional methods, this paper proposes a new energy-efficient resource allocation model for the IIoT. The difficulties of channel estimation will later be reduced by employing energy efficiency requirements. Finally, system energy efficiency will be improved, resulting in an effective resource allocation rate.

Author Keywords: energy efficiency in the industrial IoT

articleTitle: IoT Driven Air Quality Surveillance and Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In order to lessen dependency on expensive sensors, this study introduces a low-cost model that makes use of computing power at the edge and the Internet of Things in an effort to develop affordable air quality monitoring and predictive platforms. The Raspberry Pi, also known as a device that provides edges with computing power, applies the Kalman Filter (KF) method to improve low-cost measurements by 27% at the boundary of the device. By combining data with related mistakes, the methodology uses the KF algorithm to predict the level of six pollutants in the air, including SO2, NO2, and PM2.5, with lightning speed. The KF procedure's higher predictive ability is shown by comparisons with three traditional prediction techniques: Autonomous Integrated Moving Standard, Increasingly Weighted Move Average, and Simple Moving Average, among others. The root-mean-square error measurement showed a significant decrease of 68.3% on averaged. These results highlight the system's potential to promote intelligent farming and are consistent with its potential for implementation in several domains where precise, immediate time quality of air monitoring is essential.

Author Keywords: Real-time prediction and Machine learning algorithms

articleTitle: Enhanced Safety in the Cloud through ECC and Admission Restriction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The objective of this research is to provide a cutting-edge security system intended to protect personal information of users in a cloud setting. Controlling access techniques, encoding, and decode procedures are all included in this complex safety framework. A novel key generation procedure that makes use of the cryptography of elliptic curves is presented in order to strengthen security precautions and guarantee the production of very secure keys. Furthermore, a novel Identity-based Elliptic Curve Access Control (Id-EAC) method is put forward for restricting user use of a variety of data kinds. To further improve user privacy in the cloud the surroundings, a novel binary-value-based a two-phase encryption as well as decryption technique is provided. Within the aforementioned safety A system, a Compact Virtual Signatures Mechanism built on a modulo value is presented to guarantee data consistency. Users are assured of high standards of data protection, ease of use, and integrity by the security framework. Research findings highlight the edge of the solutions recommended in the aforementioned framework, demonstrating improved reliability and safety over current approaches.

Author Keywords: lightweight digital signature algorithm and performance analysis

articleTitle: An Optimized Approach for Tumor Detection using Co-Occurrence Matrix and Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Brain tumours are a significant contributor to mortality rates in the population. The early detection and accurate classification of a tumour can significantly enhance the likelihood of survival. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is presently an essential diagnostic modality in the investigation of the human brain. A brain tumour is characterized as an anomalous proliferation of cells within the brain or the central spinal canal. The present paper introduces the Backpropagation network as an artificial neural network methodology. The classification of tumour types in CT or MRI images of patients with pituitary, glioma, and meningioma tumours is facilitated through its utilization. The given paper involves implementation of image augmentation and normalization techniques, followed by the extraction of image features through the utilization of Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM). The findings involve two distinct modes, namely Training/Learning and Testing/Recognition, which ultimately yield a classified output. The results present linear relationship between epochs and number of iterations thereby validating the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Investigating Efficacy of RNN and its Variants for AQI Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Because of human-made activities like urbanization, construction, and industrialization, developing countries are particularly concerned about air pollution. Human health is significantly impacted by the air humans breathe. The air quality index is a tool to gauge air pollution. Previously, statistical tools were used to forecast Air Quality Index (AQI), but these tools had inherent limitations. With advancements in deep learning techniques, many variants of recurrent neural networks are being used for AQI forecasting. In this study, various models such as Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and their bidirectional variations are investigated for two sites in Mumbai. The feature vector utilized as the dataset has a total of 15 variables that represent various air pollutants and meteorological parameters. A total of 5 forecasting models were trained and tested using a deep learning approach. All five models were compared using two performance metrics, Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), and it was discovered that bidirectional GRU outperformed at both stations. Due to the substantial variance in AQI levels at the Kurla station, even advanced deep models were unable to capture the pattern, resulting in lower prediction accuracy. Large amounts of historical data combined with advanced processing capabilities can produce better outcomes. Using a hybrid model or an ensemble of weak models, can too produce considerably better results.

articleTitle: Managing Cloud Networks: A Classification of SDN-Enabled Clouds
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The idea of separating the management plane from the data-forwarding gear was first introduced by Software-Defined Networking (SDN), which has brought about a revolutionary new age in networking. This innovation makes networks programmable, flexible, and dynamically reconfigurable. These characteristics have great potential for the field of computer science in the cloud, where dynamic adjustments and reconfiguration are essential owing to on-demand consumption patterns. The many simulation and empirical assessment techniques that have been created expressly for SDN-enabled cloud settings are also highlighted by us. Finally, study conducted perform a critical review of the state of the research, highlighting gaps and suggesting possibilities for further study.

articleTitle: Explore Deep Learning Trends By Decoding Activated Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The dynamic field of deep learning (DL) topologies has enabled deep neural networks to become powerful instruments in various fields, successfully handling complex real-world problems. Activated functions (AFs) are essential elements in these systems that facilitate calculations between both visible and layers that are concealed and are vital to attaining cutting-edge performance. This paper performs a thorough examination of existing AFs used in different machine learning software, highlighting common usage trends. Setting itself apart by covering a broad range of AFs used in DL, this paper highlights their practical uses and common trends and compares them with state-of-the-art results from research. This thorough collection makes it easier to make well-informed decisions and choose the best AF for specific needs. This study is very important because a lot of previous research on AFs tends to repeat previous findings and studies. By contrast, this paper is the first to combine current developments in AF use in real-world applications, which distinguishes it from the large corpus of deep learning research. This research offers a thorough synthesis that deviates from traditional techniques and repetitious findings, contributing to deeper comprehension and use of AFs amid the evolving ecosystem of artificial intelligence. It does this by providing a condensed insight on AF utilization and trends.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Techniques for Early Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection Through Comparative Analysis of Feature Engineering and Classification Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder affects how someone perceives and interacts with others, which can lead to issues with social interaction and communication. It is a condition related to brain development. It is preferable to declare that this disorder cannot be cured than to say that it can be averted at an early stage. This article provides a useful framework for evaluating several ML techniques for early ASD diagnosis. The Quantile Transformer (QT), Power Feature Scaling (PFS), Power Normalizer, Max Abs Scaler, and Transformer (PT) are employed in this proposed model. Eight effective classifiers including AdaBoost (AB), Gaussian Nave Bayes (GNB), XGBoost, Support Vector Machine (SVM) Ensemble method, K Nearest Neighbor(KNN) , Random Forest (RF) and Decision Tree(DT) are then used to categorise the feature-engineered dataset. Comparing categorization outcomes produced using different evaluation measures like Recall, Precision, F1 score, Kappa score, Mathews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) and Accuracy. After comparing the results of several ML classifier models, it was found that the ASD may be easily recognised using the ensemble technique since it produces the highest accuracy—99.22%—on feature-scaled ASD datasets.

articleTitle: Color Depiction and Push Notification System for Daily Sounds
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Human perception of surrounding events isstrongly dependent on sounds they hear, however there are some individuals who find it difficult or hard to hear. The main idea behind this project is to relive some discomfort to individuals with cognitive difficulties and impairments in hearing. There are some existing systems like Bed shakers, Olfactory alarm, Vibration Devices, Hearing-dog Robot etc.., but they are not fully functional. The Color Depiction and Push Notification system will provide a visual representation of various common events occurring in their surroundings through light emitted from the Smart Bulbs and through mobile notifications when they are lit on activation by surrounding sounds. Some common events being Dog Barking, Chirping Birds, Doorbell ringing, Door knocking, People calling, Fire alarm, Security alarm ringing, Overflow of water, etc… this is accomplished by providing the individuals to perceive the sounds around them through sight, this is expected to overcome the problems faced by the individuals with hearing impairments by using Artificial Neural Networks(ANN), therefore bridging the gap between hearing and non-hearing communities and improving their living standards by the application of science and technology.

articleTitle: Review of LoRaWAN Enabled Air Quality Assessment Systems for Smart Building Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Indoor air pollution is a critical area of concern for urban and rural populations across the world. As per WHO reports, repeated exposure to poor air quality in the indoor and outdoor environment leads to 7 million premature deaths per year. Therefore, accurate and efficient assessment of hazardous environmental pollutants is necessary to reduce mortality and morbidity rates. Recent studies state that the LoRaWAN communication protocol shows considerable potential in deploying Internet of Things-based sensor networks in field environments for real-time monitoring and assessment. This paper synthesizes the literature focusing on LoRaWAN-based air quality assessment systems for smart building applications. The authors further characterize the advantages of LoRaWAN communication system architecture for low-cost, power-efficient, and accurate air pollution assessment system design. Results state that LoRaWAN-based communication channels can reduce average error for packet transmission from the end node to the network server.

articleTitle: Performing Semantic Analysis of Short Descriptive Answers using NLP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The concept of semantic similarity has garnered significant attention within the domains of artificial intelligence and semantic webs. The quantification of similarity in relation to words, brief textual passages, paraphrasing, text summarization, and automated grading has garnered significant attention in contemporary times. This paper outlines a methodology for assessing student responses by comparing them to a teacher's exemplar response, and subsequently evaluating and validating machine-generated outputs against human assessments. The brief passage must align semantically with a modelled response in order to receive a corresponding grade. The present paper presents semantic measures that rely on the similarity between individual words, with the relatedness of two words being measured through the use of Word Net taxonomy. Also, the author aims to provide a comprehensive evaluation of the proposed system by implementing it on answers dataset.

articleTitle: Applying DMLP and HMM in Speech Identification Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Attempting to deploy high-precision speech recognition algorithms on mobile and embedded devices without doing a thorough evaluation of their computational resource requirements is impractical. This study utilizes techniques to minimize the computational resources required for an optimized voice recognition system implemented on mobile devices. A cutting-edge voice recognition technique, known as Dynamic Multi-Layer Perceptron (DMLP), has been created. This method is capable of functioning in real-time on a contemporary mobile device. When evaluated on the same dataset, traditional hidden Markov models (HMM) performed somewhat better than our method, but this came at the cost of significantly longer processing time. The provided Dynamic Multi-layer Perceptron (DMLP) achieves a remarkable accuracy of 96.94% and outperforms other approaches in terms of speed.

articleTitle: Integration of AI in the Realm of Software Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Software engineering has increasingly utilized "Artificial Intelligence" (AI) to improve self-organizing IT solutions. This research aims to fill the existing void in the thorough examination of artificial intelligence's (AI) impact on software engineering. To achieve this, the study used a combination of an extensive literature review and qualitative Conversations with software engineers. The objective of the study is to evaluate the present status of AI integration, possible progress, and the accompanying hazards in the realm of software development. The results demonstrate that artificial intelligence has made substantial progress in multiple domains. By employing algorithmic methodologies, it has automated time-consuming chores such as debugging and documentation, resulting in a more efficient software development and testing process. AI has facilitated the methodical examination of extensive datasets, detecting patterns and novel clusters of information. Moreover, the utilization of neural networks has enabled comprehensive analysis of these datasets. Hence, AI expedites progress, diminishes development expenses, and augments total efficacy in software engineering.

articleTitle: An Efficient Model to Detect the Presence of Hinglish Text in YouTube Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis is referred as text organization that is used to classify the expressed mind-set or feelings in different manners such as negative, positive, favorable, unfavorable, thumbs up, thumbs down, etc. Majority of the content available on various social media websites is in English Language. Due to advent of technology and access to Internet in huge populated country like India, people tend to share their views on a language that they are more comfortable in. This gives rise to users sharing their opinions in code-mixed languages such as Hindi mixed with English. Opinions in the form of tweets or comments are available all-over social media. These views/comments posted by the users can be analyzed for various purposes. This paper proposes a model that will find the percentage of Hinglish text present in the text retrieved from various social media platforms. The user can keep or discard the text for analysis depending on the percentage of Hinglish text present. The accuracy value attained is 83%, this can further increase when add more words in the dataset that is classifying the comments.

articleTitle: Predicting Sentiment on IMDB using ML and DL Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Sentiment classification holds significant importance in the field of nlp as it focuses on determining the sentiment polarity of text, namely positive, negative, or neutral. The widespread usage of IMDB as a platform for expressing opinions and emotions has made it a valuable source of data for sentiment classification. Here, we present a comparative analysis of diverse ML and DL approaches applied to sentiment classification using IMDB data. Specifically, we evaluate the performance of Bayesian classifier, Log. Regression, SVM, Recurrent Neural Systems (RNNS), and Transfer Learning with BERT. Through our experimentation, we find that while Bayesian classifier and Log. Regression exhibit reasonable accuracy in this task, SVM and RNNS surpass them, with Transfer Learning using BERT achieving the highest level of accuracy. This study offers valuable insights into the efficacy of different ML and DL techniques when applied to sentiment classification on IMDB data, serving as a valuable resource for both researchers and industry practitioners in this domain.

articleTitle: Migration and Scheduling of Virtual Machines (VM) using Priority Based Load Balancing in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The cloud technology is rapidly gaining prominence in both the IT industry and research domains. Virtualization is a crucial technology in the realm of cloud computing that enables the isolation of applications and provides service providers with the capability to transfer virtual machines (VMs) from one physical device to another via a process commonly referred to as VM migration. The process of migration involves several sequential stages, which comprise the selection of the source physical machine, selection of the virtual machine, selection of the target virtual machine, and the ultimate step of transferring the virtual machine data. Based on previous studies, the process of migrating virtual machines (VMs) presents notable difficulties, mainly attributable to the dynamic nature of VM demands, particularly in terms of their selection and placement. The given paper proposes a load balancing tactic that accords priority to the migration and scheduling of virtual machines contingent upon their designated profit-based priority. The findings shows the performance of the proposed approach via calculation of round trip time and throughput metrics.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique for Hand Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The research on human computer interaction (HCI) in recent years has been limited to methods based on the usage of a graphics display, keyboard, mouse, joystick, etc. The interaction has developed from punched cards, which were only used by experts, to the graphical interface paradigm. The interaction with a graphical user interface involves pointing a device directly at graphic items like windows and icons. With the advent of systems based on recognition of vision, sound, speech, projective displays, etc., this tendency has recently shifted, offering a far deeper and natural way of interaction between humans and machines. Most computer programmes need to be more interactive in order to be used effectively. As a result, over the past few years, HCI research has been very active. In a similar vein, numerous gesture recognition systems have been developed and put into use for effective HCI, and ongoing research is being done to strengthen these systems. The design, implementation, and analysis of a single hand gesture recognition system is compared with graphical representation. The innovation of the suggested hand gesture recognition system resides in the gesture recognition that was carried out based on three innovative and effective features of the human hand, namely the quantity of flaws, the hand’s orientation, and its movement. The suggested method has been put into practice and tested for several desktop programmes, including the VLC media player. Thus, the proposed method contributes to the development of an effective, understandable hand gesture recognition system.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Status Quo of Artificial Intelligence: Society
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Every technology has its advantages and disadvantages, but in order for the technology to thrive in the market, the advantages must constantly outweigh the negatives. But with AI we are unsure if the benefits will outweigh the disadvantages in the long run or not, and if this is not the case, AI can be proved very dangerous for mankind and our existence. As the development in AI accelerates, more robots or automatic systems are being manufactured to replace human labor. In this research paper, the primary field in which AI has a substantial impact on human existence in both positive and negative way is discussed. A survey of 67 participants was conducted from which 40 participants were male and 27 participants were females. 43, 23 and 1 participants are between the ages 13-20, 21-30 and above 30 respectively. 39 (58.2%) participants think that artificial is needed for society, 12 (17.9%) participants think that artificial is not needed for society and 3 (4.5%) participants can’t say. From 67 participants 44 (65.7%) participants use Google Assistant, 16 (23.9%) participants use Siri and 5 (7.5%) participants use Alexa. 24 (36.9%), 31 (47.7%), 7 (10.8%) and 3 (4.6%) participants from 67 participants use Face Detection, Fingerprint, PIN/Pattern and Password respectively as a safety feature for their smartphones. From 67 participants 23 (34.3%) participants think that chatbots save people’s time by not directly interacting with them, 17 (25.4%) participants don’t think that it saves people’s time and 10 (14.9%) participants can't say.

articleTitle: Liquid Neural Networks: A Novel Approach to Dynamic Information Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs) are an innovative class of neural architectures that employ dynamic reservoirs to process temporal data. Unlike traditional feed forward networks, LNNs incorporate a dynamic "liquid" layer, which enables them to capture and utilize intricate temporal dependencies in input sequences. This research paper provides a concise overview of LNNs, emphasizing their core principles, training strategies, and real-world applications. We delve into the structure and operation of the liquid layer, showcasing its capacity to generate rich, context-aware representations of input data. LNNs are trained using a variety of techniques, including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning, making them adaptable to diverse tasks. We present experimental results demonstrating the effectiveness of LNNs in applications such as time-series forecasting, natural language processing, and speech recognition. By offering a dynamic perspective on neural computation, LNNs offer a promising avenue for solving complex problems involving sequential data. This paper serves as a valuable introduction to LNNs and their potential to advance the field of machine learning.

articleTitle: A Review on Zero Knowledge Proof Vulnerabilities in Zcash
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The Zcash cryptocurrency is the first well-known application of zk-SNARKs in the blockchain. The role of Zk-SNARK is to provide privacy and confidentiality. As blockchain is incapable of providing privacy in the blockchain system, the researchers are banking at Zero Knowledge Proof protocols as the solution to the privacy problem. The Zero Knowledge Proof is a relatively new technique. Hence, currently, it comes with many risks and vulnerabilities. This paper mentions risks in cryptocurrency with Zero Knowledge Proof, primarily of Zcash. The discussed vulnerabilities are information leakage in transactions, trust risk, implementation vulnerability, and other security issues.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach to Aquatic Environment Monitoring: IoT-based Smart Aquarium System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Aquaculture comprises a complex ecosystem involving aquatic organisms and their caregivers. Effective management of aquaculture significantly influences the well-being of aquatic life. With the continuous advancement of IoT (Internet of Things), AquaVision emerges as a potential catalyst for transforming aquarium management, establishing new benchmarks for both aquatic health and caretaker experiences. This research paper explores the conception, benefits, and limitations of AquaVision. The paper subsequently outlines the approach adopted for the creation and deployment of AquaVision, succeeded by an assessment of its merits and drawbacks. Current methodologies and trends in this domain are overviewed, while persisting challenges demanding resolution for successful adoption are underscored. Through the outcomes of the testing phase, AquaVision's efficacy as a tool for monitoring and controlling crucial aquarium parameters, encompassing pH, temperature, and water level, is substantiated. The system's successful integration and examination highlight its real-time monitoring competencies and remote-control functionalities. The discoveries from this study accentuate the expansive potential of IoT solutions in upholding public health and ensuring the accessibility of potable water. By elucidating AquaVision's evolution and benefits, the aspiration is to ignite fresh investigation and ingenuity within the realm of aquatic science and technology, ultimately fostering deeper comprehension, preservation, and admiration for the submerged world.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Detection and Alert System using DLib
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Drowsiness refers to sleepiness due to fatigue and it is the enemy on roads as statistics show 25% to 40% of accidents are fatigue related. Accidents caused by drowsiness are deadly but preventable if an intelligent system detects and alerts the driver using an alarm. For solving this real time problem of driver drowsiness detection and alert this project focuses on the technology of computer vision by using python, OpenCV and DLib. This project works by analyzing the facial features which drowsy drivers show such as yawning, eye closure, and head movements which can be used to measure the level of drowsiness. Alerts are divided according to level of drowsiness and actions are taken accordingly. System takes real time video input through a camera which monitors driver’s eyes and yawning frequency, if eyes are continuously closed for 8 frames, alert is given by an alarm to caution the driver, if the driver is still sleeping alert message notification is sent to its emergency contact.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cloud Security: A Deep Cryptographic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Cloud computing has transformed data storage, processing, and access. However, as cloud-based services grow more popular, protecting sensitive data is crucial. Cryptographic algorithms provide strong encryption, safe key exchange, and data integrity, improving cloud security. Cloud computing uses Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA), Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA), Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC), Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), and the Diffie-Hellman algorithm key exchange. For verifying data integrity Cloud computing uses SHA. SHA protects data during transmission and storage by creating a unique hash value for each block. This prohibits cloud data manipulation, ensuring data integrity. Asymmetric cloud encryption algorithm RSA is commonly used. Public and private keys ensure data transfer and secrecy. Cloud service providers and customers may securely share private data using the RSA algorithm. ECC's computational efficiency and security are making it desirable in cloud computing. Elliptic curves provide fast key creation and safe data transfer in ECC. Secure communication, encryption, and authentication in cloud settings protect data. Symmetric encryption method of AES is used in cloud computing. Cloud computing requires Diffie-Hellman key exchange for safe communication.

articleTitle: Analyzing Bitcoin Blockchain Data: Insights, Coefficients and Model Adequacy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The investigation examines the analysis of data derived from the Bitcoin blockchain with the aim of uncovering noteworthy facts pertaining to its behavior. The present research used regression analysis as a methodological framework to investigate the relationship that exists between the median confirmation time, the logarithm of the number of transactions that occur in a block, and the average transaction cost. This was done in order to determine whether or not there is a correlation between these three variables. The model's coefficients 0, 1, and 2 provide insightful information regarding the influence that these factors have on the confirmation times experienced by users of the Bitcoin network. Nevertheless, the study demonstrates that the chosen indicators, when examined in isolation, do not provide a comprehensive rationale for the observed variations in confirmation durations during the entire year of 2015. This observation implies the existence of uncontrolled variables that have not been taken into consideration. Further investigation is required to determine these variables and enhance the model's explanatory power. The procedure may involve the inclusion of additional variables, the analysis of non-linear transformations, and the evaluation of potential outliers. This study highlights the complexity of Bitcoin's confirmation time dynamics and underscores the need for a deeper understanding of the factors at play inside this growing cryptocurrency ecosystem.

articleTitle: Potato Disease Detection through Leafs: Leveraging Deep Learning Algorithms for Accurate Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The classification of potato diseases is significant for a number of reasons. Diseases can severely lower potato crop output and quality. Early disease diagnosis can assist farmers in taking the necessary steps to stop the illness's spread and lessen its effects on crop output and quality. Farmers can save money by using less costly pesticides and other treatments if diseases are detected early. It can also help prevent the loss of entire crops due to disease. The use of pesticides and other chemicals can have negative impacts on the environment, including water and soil pollution. Early detection of diseases can reduce the need for these chemicals, helping to protect the environment. Potatoes are an important staple food crop worldwide. Disease outbreaks can have a significant impact on food security, particularly in developing countries. Early detection of diseases can help prevent crop losses and ensure a stable food supply. This paper is about the implementation of the CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) models that can help in the detection of various potato diseases with the help of potato leaf. By using some of the deep learning models like VGG16 and VGG19 we will predict whether the potato is diseased or not.

articleTitle: Ethical and Social Consequences of Computer Vision and AI-Integrated IoT Technologies in the Medical Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Computer vision and artificial intelligence (AI) advancements have transformed the healthcare industry by integrating Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. Computer vision and AI-powered IoT technologies can potentially enhance medical diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment, improving patient outcomes and increasing healthcare delivery efficiency. However, ethical and social implications need to be considered along with the benefits. This paper explores the moral and social implications of computer vision and AI-integrated IoT technologies in the medical ecosystem. It examines privacy, data security, bias, accountability, and the doctor-patient relationship’s impact. The paper also discusses potential solutions and recommendations to address these ethical concerns, ensuring responsible and ethical use of computer vision and AI-integrated IoT technologies in healthcare.

articleTitle: Leveraging knowledge of Previous Baskets to Anticipate online Buyer Behaviour
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Customer behavior prediction is an important task for any company to improve the sale of product. Retailer used Market Basket Analysis pattern of customer to identify the behavior of customers. On the basis of previous basket analysis one most important feature suggestion for customer for next purchasing. Market Basket Analysis was successfully applied to evaluate a large amount of data to understand customer behavior of purchasing patterns. To facilitate reordering and maintaining adequate product stock, this paper will explain how Instacart can use its consumer transaction history and concentrate on descriptive analysis of customer buying habits, objects frequently purchased around each other, and units purchased from of the shop. Additionally, to locate client subsets and cluster with similar purchasing habits and to visualize the data to make useful recommendations geared toward enhancing revenue and satisfaction using segment and forecasting framework. In this paper design a machine learning framework to forecast whichever previously purchased item will be in the customer future purchasing. Proposed model has high accuracy on the same data set is 74.16 percent.

articleTitle: IOT Enabled E-Vehicles for Developing Smart Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The combination of IoT technology and electric vehicles (EVs) is reshaping transportation systems. This study explores how IoT-enabled EVs align with SMART (Sustainable, Multimodal, Adaptive, Resilient, and Technology-driven) transportation systems. The collaboration between these concepts promises to redefine urban mobility, improve efficiency, lower environmental impact, and enhance user experiences. IoT-equipped EVs have sensors for real-time performance, energy, and location monitoring. They form a network, generating valuable data streams for various uses. Simultaneously, SMART transportation integrates dynamic traffic management, data-driven choices, and diverse transport modes for comprehensive mobility. The incorporation of Internet of Things (IoT) technology into electric vehicles (EVs) has a substantial impact on transportation networks. This study investigates how IoT-enabled EVs interact with SMART (Sustainable, Multimodal, Adaptive, Resilient, and Technology-driven) transportation systems, which have the potential to revolutionise urban mobility, improve efficiency, minimise environmental impact, and improve user experiences.The emphasis has recently been on constructing smart cities; however, it is critical not to forget the need for efficient parking management. Finding a good parking location and saving time are perennial issues for city drivers. This study introduces a revolutionary parking toll system that connects users via a mobile app and allows them to make parking payments in real time. The system scans the car’s RFID tag with an RFID reader, giving admission to and leave from the parking space. Parking period is estimated as a cost, which users may monitor and pay using the app. Furthermore, the app informs users about the availability of parking spaces. Additionally, users can charge their electric vehicles during the parking period.

articleTitle: Interpreting Scope of Predictive Analytics in Advanced Driving Assistant System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Distracted driving, caused by various factors such as human emotions or reading distracting messages on the roadside, has become a leading cause of traffic accidents today. Ensuring the safety of both individuals and vehicles while minimizing maintenance costs poses a significant challenge for the automotive industry. Fortunately, recent advancements in machine learning offer a potential solution. One promising method is the further development of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), for which machine learning serves as an ideal solution. The proposed model develops an advanced predictive learning enabled driving assistance system with prediction capabilities like traffic light behavior and parking availability detection. The model gave an optimum accuracy of 98.2% with 50 epochs count and the validation loss retains a constant value of 0.3 over epochs.

articleTitle: Emerging QoS Strategies: A Comprehensive Overview of Clustering Techniques in IoT-Equipped WSNS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) with Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) is a collection of mechanical nodes known as sensors and actuators. The actuators and sensors are connected to each other with restricted battery life. Sensor networks begin to deplete their energy after installation through various activities such as detection, transmission, and aggregation during the transmission of data. Several energy-efficient solutions were developed to extend the lifespan of networks. One of the solutions to this problem is Clustering that plays a crucial function in reducing transmission energy needs. One of the key challenges with large-scale Internet of Things (IoT) is the lack of an efficient routing protocol that can manage thousands of devices while also providing a low-power forwarding mechanism for massive amounts of data. The present paper discuss approaches and protocols are used by various clustering algorithms like Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH), Fuzzy C-Means (FCM), Hybrid Energy Efficient Distributed (HEED), Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm (FFOA) etc. The paper proposes the need for an efficient routing protocol to manage thousands of devices with low power forwarding mechanisms on a big scale.

articleTitle: A tour of DDoS attack using Machine Learning Techniques under one umbrella
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: A distributed denial of service (DDoS) attempt is a sort of cyber-attack in which the perpetrator attempts to starve a network/server of services by flooding the network/server with unnecessary requests, rendering it unable to process valid requests. This attack is the most dangerous in the security domain because this attack denies the availability of the service. The false requests are done by a hacker using the bots army which makes the system busy and service unavailable for the genuine user. Bots can be devices that are connected to the internet i.e., Webcam, mobiles, laptops smart citv, etc. As these cyberattacks grow more common, it is becoming more difficult to identify them and protect online businesses against them. Every day, the rate of cybercrime is increasing. Many sorts of cyberattacks are becoming increasingly widespread, including ransomware, phishing, and DOS / DDOS attacks. Researchers are working hard to figure out how to defend against these attacks. Machine Learning contributes to training models to identify attacks and prevent them from causing maximum harm. Many machine learning algorithms for detecting DoS/DDoS threats are covered in this research. As discussed in recent years' big cyber-attacks and their peak traffic. As this paper discuses distinct datasets that are widely used by researchers and their accuracy which contribute for the further study. This paper concludes with the insights of the latest datasets to combat the DDoS attacks and also reveal the analytical approaches for the detection of DDoS attacks under one sight to ease the detection or identification.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Resume Parser and Matcher using RegEx and NER
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In the context of a competitive job market, this research addresses the challenge of efficiently identifying suitable candidates among a vast pool of applicants. Leveraging machine learning and deep learning techniques, we propose a solution to expedite the candidate selection process. Our approach involves scoring resumes based on extracted information and presenting them in descending order of relevance to the job description, thereby streamlining the recruiter's initial contact efforts.Two primary tasks are undertaken: information extraction and resume scoring. Information retrieval is achieved by a hybrid approach combining rule-based methods and Named Entity Recognition (NER) using Natural Language Processing (NLP). Key attributes such as Name, Phone number, Email id, University, Experience, Skills, and Organization are extracted using a combination of RegEx and Spacy's pre-trained transformer model.To calculate the score, we employ cosine similarity between the candidate's resume and the job description. This similarity metric measures the candidate's suitability for the specified job role. Notably, we utilize Sentence Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (SBERT) for resume and job description vectorization, achieving an impressive parsing accuracy of 70%. In summary, our research offers an automated solution that significantly enhances the efficiency of candidate selection by prioritizing applicants based on their suitability, saving valuable time for the organization and recruiters.

articleTitle: Aqua Forecast: Machine Learning for Water Quality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: An analysis of multiple bodies of water using ML algorithms is presented in the research paper. The primary focus is developing and evaluating predictive models for pH, dissolved oxygen, and turbidity: key water quality indicators. Various monitoring stations across a specific region collected comprehensive measurements of water quality. This research assesses the efficacy of some of the ML algorithms for predicting water quality parameters accurately. A rigorous test of the prediction performance of Decision Trees and K-Nearest Neighbours was conducted. It was found that KNN consistently outperformed DT in forecasting water quality parameters. In addition to providing greater insight into how water quality dynamics work, this study also offers practical implications for policymakers and researchers. KNN performs better than DT, demonstrating the importance of algorithm selection. Using KNN enhanced prediction accuracy, demonstrating its potential as a preferred algorithm. Using the latest ML technology for prediction of the water quality, this research provides valuable insights. The integration of ML techniques, especially KNN, can enhance the precision of water quality forecasting, providing crucial information for informed decision-making in the management of various bodies of water.

articleTitle: Battlefield Health Surveillance with Soldier Tracking: A Privacy-Preserving Encrypted Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: In this paper, a system is designed and implemented, keeping in mind the safety and efficiency of the soldiers. The system will monitor various vital signs of the soldier to ensure his safety and will also help him to execute his mission. Location tracking is also embedded in the system to know about a soldier's exact location. The system is implanted in a wearable jacket for the convenience of soldiers. In the system, the ESP 32 cam module is used with various sensors like heart rate sensor, DS18B20 etc. Data collected by the system will be sent to the server and stored in databases. This is very sensitive data, and thus, if it gets into the enemy's hands, it can be fatal. So, for transmitting this data, encryption is used. This data will be analyzed and will be displayed on a private website in graphical formats, adding accuracy, complexity, results etc.Addressing the statements and issues discussed above, this paper was designed to overcome all of them. In this paper, a system is designed and implemented, keeping in mind the safety and efficiency of the soldiers. The system will monitor various vital signs of the soldier to ensure his safety and will also help him to execute his mission. Location tracking is also embedded in the system to know about a soldier's exact location. The system is implanted in a wearable jacket for the convenience of soldiers. In the system, the ESP 32 cam module is used with various sensors like heart rate sensor, DHT11 e, etc. Data collected by the system will be sent to the server and stored in databases. This is very sensitive data, and thus, if it gets into the enemy's hands, it can be fatal. So, for transmitting this data, encryption is used. This data will be analyzed and will be displayed on a website in graphical formats, adding accuracy, complexity, results, etc. This paper describes the necessity of a consolidated soldier system that includes and safeguards the health and well-being of a soldier. It elucidates the design, implementation, and further discussions regarding the same. In the upcoming chapters, an in-depth literature survey is discussed, which serves as the basis of the research and development of this project. After reviewing multiple papers, a strategic way of implementation and novelty were understood. In further sections, an in-detail description of the implementation and working of the model is given, with the required diagrams. Along with that, a section also covers the results obtained from the implementation, in an illustrative way.

articleTitle: Analysis of Computational Intelligence Techniques for COVID-19 Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Following the COVID-19 pandemic, the RT-PCR test, being the gold standard for diagnosing COVID-19 presented a significant challenge in implementing widespread testing. However, the facility for RT-PCR tests is limited, and overwhelmed healthcare systems with limited testing facilities make early diagnosis of the disease difficult. Therefore, this paper investigates the use of popular machine learning and deep learning techniques for predicting COVID-19 based on the X-ray images of the lungs of the patients. The study compares the machine learning techniques, SVM and KNN, with the deep learning technique, CNN (VGG-19 in particular). SVM has demonstrated a percentage increase of 5.97% compared to VGG-19 in terms of precision, accuracy and F1-score. Thus, the study’s results (based on the performance metrics, precision, accuracy, F1-score and MCC) promote the use of SVM for predicting COVID-19.

articleTitle: Image Decomposition for Object Detection in Low-light Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Object detection is one of the most popular and explored vision-based applications. Most object detection approaches focus on the classification and localization of objects in images with proper visibility. However, the visibility of the image may sometimes degrade due to the unavailability of proper lightness (low-light), haze in surroundings and many other environmental conditions. This paper focuses on analyzing the performance of object detection methods in low-light conditions. RetinaNet, FCOS and generalized focal loss are considered to analyse the impact of low-light in object detection out of many object detection methods. In this work, SA-OD, and DSE-OD (decomposition-based methods) are developed for object detection in low-light conditions. SA-OD method estimates a structure-aware reflectance followed by the detection method. DSE-OD estimates the reflectance using the deep network followed by the object detection method. These methods achieve better detection performance in low-light conditions. The low-light images are generated using multiple gamma values and then used for object detection to analyse the performance.

articleTitle: Service-Centric Architectures in Cloud Security: An In-Depth Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Due to its affordable and high-quality services, cloud computing has lately attracted a lot of interest. Due to the on- demand, pay-per-use characteristics that cloud services provide, which encourage companies to outsource parts of their operations with better service delivery and more value, they have become an essential component of both businesses et people's everyday lives during the last ten years. In the next years, a continued migration towards cloud-based services is predicted by the current market trend, which started in 2019. Despite the many benefits that the cloud computing paradigm offers to both enterprises and consumers, security issues are expected to be the biggest cloud computing challenges in 2020. Security problems are a result of a number of variables, including the streaming nature of these solutions and the technology that support cloud computing, which includes hybridization and multitenancy. This research examines security concerns in service-driven cloud computing in order to shed light on the situation of the industry at the moment. This paper's main contribution is an analysis of cloud security over the last ten years and the presentation of a thorough taxonomy of security concerns throughout the three-layer architecture, which includes Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), Platform-as- (PaaS), and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS).

articleTitle: BERT-Based Natural Language Processing System for Online Social Information Retrieval on Illness Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: With the growing rise of digital platforms such as facebook, twitter and others that attract billions of people around the world, it has gained a lot of traction as a source of unstructured data. The volume of unstructured data is expected to expand at a 60 percent annual rate in the future years. The emergence of social media has facilitated the expansion of unstructured data. Thanks to social media, everyone may now express and share their thoughts and opinions on a wide range of topics. Infodemiology is one such popular and rapidly expanding information retrieval method (i.e., information epidemiology). As per the concept, a set of approaches that study data, particularly health data on the internet, for the purpose of public health studies and policy. Web data is analyzed to detect disease outbreaks faster than traditional surveillance in infoveillance (also known as information surveillance). This research has created a prototype software model for extracting spatiotemporal diseases from diverse data sources in this vein. To identify prospective sickness instances, the proposed method gathered tweets and other postings and used NLP semantic algorithms with transformers called BERT. The prototype system is tuned to improve disease detection using rules given by dissimilar semantic similarity algorithms. The prototype’s output is a visual representation of likely disease forms and spread, which is a straight IE produce from Twitter and other sites.

articleTitle: Generative AI for Software Test Modelling with a focus on ERP Software
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: Generative AI in this context refers to the type of artificial intelligence that can generate content or give new information based on patterns it has learned. In the case of software testing, it refers to the use of generative AI to model or for the creation of test scenarios, test cases or objects for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) software. The special focus on ERP software means that generative AI-based techniques have been particularly designed and optimized for the purpose of software testing. It does take into account the unique features and complexity of the ERP systems which allows for more effective and accurate testing. The problem with the existing chatbots is that they are not integrated with generative AI and the training is either not properly done or the data used for training is biased. The objective of this work is to develop a chatbot integrated with the generative AI-based framework and develop training data to cater to user needs. Methods and tools used in this approach are the OpenAI's API used for integrating chatbot with the generative AI-based software, Postman API has also been used to send and receive API requests and prompts and completions to be generated using Python code. The result of this approach is that a chatbot has been developed which develops test cases and scenarios, requests sent and received successfully and prompts and completions have been successfully generated using Python code. To state it simply, generative AI for software test modelling with a focus on ERP software means creating test cases and scenarios using AI and generating them automatically which helps testers ensure that the software is working correctly and meets the needs of the business operations.

articleTitle: Emperical Study of Energy-Efficient Routing Protocol for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advances in Computation, Communication and Information Technology (ICAICCIT)
abstract: The emergence of the Internet of Things (IoT) can be attributed to the convergence of the Internet, sensor networks, and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) systems. By enabling things to detect, reason, and interact with many objects, IoT can associate common objects and transform them into extraordinary entities. Similarly, RFID technology makes it possible to track a product and give it a unique ID. The Internet of Things (IoT) allows for constant, universal network connectivity between smart devices. Any large-scale network must have an information routing system in place to move data from source to sink. By offering little congestion, little packet loss, and a low delay rate, this network increases reliability. There isn't much network utilization because network equipment is frequently installed in multiple locations. Networks' use of energy is hence exceedingly inefficient. Energy utilization is inconsistent and there aren't enough energy resources to go around, which leads to the creation of new routing algorithms and protocols most of the time.
